1༄mobe/ /mgon khyod lang cho gzhon nu'i tshul gyis skye dgu'i tshal du mkhyen gnyis rkang pas 'degs 'jog g.yo/ /legs pa'i yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma tshul khrims bslab pa'i ska rags gle/ser gyi phreng bas bcings/ /chos nyid rnal ma shing rta bzang mor rig pa ye shes stobs/ ldan dgra bos 'o byed pas/ /rtogs pa'i 'dod chags chu 'dzin 'khrigs te ye shes glog 'khyug 'jam dpal dbyangs des bdag skyongs chag /bde chen brjod med rnam sad lha yi bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'ching mngar ba'i ro/ /'thung bas byings rkyen rtsa mdud brgya yi pi wang rgyud pa gsar du bskrun/ /rnam dpyod blo yi sor mo g.yo bas sgra snyan dbyas rnga'i rol mo 'khrol / / ka dag spros bral skyed mos tshal du rtogs pa'i glu len lha mor 'dud/ /dbyangs can mkhyen rab 'dzam bu'i shing 'bras daṇ+ḍi'i ngag gi rol mtshor tshi / /rtogs pa'i tso gter gser du gyur nas srid gsum skye dgu'i dpal du shar/ /

2snyan ngag chu klung stong gsum brdal bas grags snyan chu yi 'khri shing g.yo/ /blo gros gshog rtsal rab 〉rgyas te mkhas pa'i rtser son dakhrir 'dud/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i me tog mngon du 'thor nas/ 'dir skabs su bab pa gzhung dang rig gnas kun gyi rgyan du gyur pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i gnas chung lnga'i ya gyal/me long ma'i gzhung 'di yod na 'dis chog pa med na thabs chag pa med du mi rung ba zhig yin pas na/ gzhung 'di 'chad par byed pa la thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa las/ skabs 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni le'u bar pa don rgyan so lnga'i nang tshan las/ thog mar rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ brjod par 'dod pa'i dngos po de'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de nyid la sgro btags dang skur 'debs sogs med par gnas tshul dzi lta ba bzhin dngos su gsal bar byed pa ste/ 'di la dbye ba bzhi las dang po rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa'i dpe ni/

3dper na sku mdog dmar ser mdangs ldan 'dzum pa'i zhal// /gsung dbyangs drug cu theg chen chos kyi sgra/ /pha thugs kyi dgongs pa zag med 'dzin rtog bral/ /ye shes rang gzugs/ 'jam mgon khyod la 'dud/ /yang na rnam mnges yid 'ong mdangs ldan 'dzum pa'i zhal / /dbu skra lcang lo zur phud lnga dang ldan / /bgres rgud mi mnga' lang tsho rgyan gyis spras/ /smra ba'i mchog rab khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /yang na spangs rtogs yon tan ldan pa'i mtshan dpes mdzes / /gsung gi dbang phyug sems dpa' zol mi mnga'/ /gdod nas sgrib gnyis mthar phyung gzung 'dzin bral/ /smra ba'i gtso bo khyod la bdag dga' bo/ /

yang na dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang yan lag drug cu ldan/ / mi shes blo rmyongs sel ba'i mthu mnga' ba / /bta na pa'i 'khor lo khyed la snying nas dad/ /kunang na rmad byung mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mnga' zhing / /yang dag ma rig las sangs mkhyen pa rgyas/ /ji lta ji snyed chos rnams kun gzigs pa/ /tshad ma'i skyes bu rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis pa bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ dper na sku yi rdzu 'a phrul gdul bya'i ngo bor byon/ /gsung gi rdzu 'phrul 'gro rnams thabs kyis 'dul/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa 'gro drug yongs la gzigs/ /'gro rnams 'dren pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud/ /

5yang na zag med ye shes bden gnyis rjen par gzigs/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gdul bya smin par mdzad/ /cigang zag skal ldan khrod du chos sgra sgrogs/ /rdo rje rnon po mchog la snying nas 'dud/ /yang na legs pa'i yon tan kun gyi rtser son te/ /ye shes chen gros stong gsum chabs cig gzigs/ /gzhal yas 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca' nas/ /sgrib gnyis sel byed khyed la bdag dad do/ /yang na mtha' bzhi bral ba'i chos sku rab bsgrubs te/ /gegs med byang chub lam la bder gshegs kyang / /ma rig rtsad nas bcom par zhal bzhes nas/ /ral gri 'dzin pa khyed sku gcig pur snang / /

6pagang na brgyad gnyis lang tsho 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs nas/ /gsung gi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pas gzhan yid 'phrog/ /brtse ba'i thugs rjes blo mongs sel byed pa/ /zla ba'i sring mo khyod la mi dga' su/ /yang na gang gi 'dun pa'i rtse la rab zhugs te/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis rnam grol lam ston nas/ /byang chub bar du thugs rje'i gzigs pas bzung / /glu dbyangs len ma tshangs pa'i sras mor 'dud/ /yang na go bin+da yis rgya mtsho bsrubs byas pas/ /zhal 'dzum spyan zur g.yo zhing rgyan gyis spras/ /steng du gshegs shing sgra snyan glu len nas/ /phar tshur rgyu ba dbyangs can lha mo yin/ /

7gsum pa yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ dper na ye shes kun gyi rang gzugs yin pa la/ /nyon mongs bral bas spangs pa 'gran med kyi/ /ma rig zhi zhing shes rab gong du 'phel/ /gdeng thob shes bya kun la 'jigs bral gyur/ /kunang na smra ba'i gtso bo rkang gnyis yongs kyi lha/ /ma rig zad cing shes bya lhag par rgyas/ /gang gis mjal mod dwangs shing blo yi mchog /thob pas srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam par grol/ /lugang na dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi blo yi gter/ /legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i khungs/ /gzhan gyi yid bsgyur thub pa'i blo yi mthu/ /myong bas spangs rtogs yon tan rtse ru son/ /

'uyang na ye shes phung po rgyal kun 'dus pa'i lha/ /mtshan tsam rna lam thos pa'i skal bzang 'dis/ /log rtog gnyis 'dzin rmyongs pa'i snang cha ra gzan/ /rab 'byams shes bya mjal ba'i blo gros skyes/yang na bka' drin kun las lhag pa'i mtsho byung ma/ /ci bsam 'dod mgur 'jo ba'i blo yi lha/ /'gran zlar dben pa'i spobs pa cha shas tsam/ /mjal bas rig pa'i gnas la blo gros skyes / — /lugang na ngo bo spros bral chos sku 'dus ma byas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal longs sku'i mdzes chos mnga'/ /rnam pa 'gags med 'char ba ma rig pa/ /bcos pa'i mthu ldan ngag dbang lha mo kye/ /

9yang na 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras mngon sum ma mjal yang / /mtshan tsam brjod pas blo yi shes yon rgyas/ /phas rgol mu stegs tshogs las rgyal 'gyur na / /mngon zhal mjal ba'i dpal yon bshad ci dgos/ /yang na srab 'jam yangs pa 'dab brgya'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'chi med tshe la mi 'jigs mnga' rnyed nas/ /'gro kun 'chi bdag tshe las bskyab nus na/ /bdag kyang 'chi med tshe yi sku thob shog /bzhi pa rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ dper na phun tshogs rin chen dpal gyis rab mdzes shing / /lhab lhub dar sna'i gos kyis 'phyang 'phrul g.yo/ /phyag g.yon glegs bam g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar/ /lcang lo'i zur phud lnga ldan blo yi gter/ /

10yangan sku gzugs mnyen lcug shin dugazhon sha ldem/ /lha rdzas dar dang rgyan sogs rab skyomadzes/ /mtshan bzang yon tan phul byung yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /dbyangs can ngag gi dpal mo'i khyad chos yin/ /yang na ral pa'i dbu skra gyen du shig se shig /mgul na rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lolo/ /g.yon par rkang gling g.yas pas ḍā ru bsnams/ /sgeg pa'i gar 'cham gsang sngags rnal 'byor pa/ /kunang na ca co bral ba'i gnas dben brag phug tu/ /phyag la mchod rdzas rdo rje dril bu 'chang / /mdun du khru gang stegs pa'i cog rtse bzhag /sku la chos gos la sogs du mas brgyan/

11yang na rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing / /thos grol dbyangs ldan rgyud mang phyag skyobasnams/ /dbu la gser gyi dprog zhu khor yug tu/ /'khyud pa taskru ra yi chung mar 'dud/ /lugang na dug sprul srin pos gang ba'i gling de na/ /phyogs kun gzigs pa'i spyan zung rnam par g.yo/ /kha ṭam rdo rje 'chang zhing sdigs pa'i mdzub/ /bstan pa 'di ni pada' byung ya mtshan che/yang na zag med gdod nas spros dang bral na yang / /ltar snang mdzes ched rgyan cha du mas spras/ /shang lang 'phyar zhing sna tshogs skur bzhengs nas/ /gzhan don mdzad pa de la e ma mtshar/ /

gnyis pa dpe rgyan ni/12 dpe dang dpe can gnyis khyad chos la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'dra ba'am mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras gsal bar rtogs nus pa'i ngag ste/ 'di la dbye ba so gnyis yod pa'i dang po chos dpe ni/ dper na rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur mtsho byung ma'i/ /gsung dbyangs chos rnga bzhin du cha shas snyan/ /thugs kyi ye shes dri med shel sgong bzhin/ /mjal mod kun yid 'phrog pa'i lha mor 'dud/ /yang na rgyal ba kun gyi rang gzugs zla sring ma'i/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dpyod ku'i zla rgyas bzhin/ /lus can kun yid 'phrog pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra/ /bdag gi rna lam snyan zhing 'jebs par gyur/ /

13yang na sgeg pa'i ngag gi dpal mo dgyes pa'i zhal/ /gangs rir sna tshogs shing rtas 'khyud pa ltar/ /yid 'ong gzhon nu'i 'dzum dkar can ma de/ /bdag gi mig la mngon sum snang bar mdzod/ /yang na gang sku bcu drug lon pa'i zhal ras 'di/ /pad+ma gzhon nu bzhin du cung zad dmar/ /lta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i ngo mtshar de/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig la bstan du gsol/ /yang na gang gi mkhyen rab phyogs kun rgyas pa 'di/ /chur sgrog 'dagam sbubs grol bzhin du mtshar/ /mgrin pa'i glu dbyangs lha yi rnga 'dra bar/ /snyan 'gyur 'bum ldan dri za'i bu mo kye/ /

14kusdong na 'gro ba'i don kun 'byung ba'i blo yi gter/ /zad med lha yi dpag bsam ljon shing ltar/ /gang gi blo gros rab yangs dkar ba de/ /mngon sum bdag gi snang byed skal bar stsol/ /05nga na sa gsum ngo mtshar dpal dang ldan pa'i sku/ /dpyod dpal rkang 'thung gzhon nu bzhin du mdzes/ /rtag tu'agro la gzigs pa'i zag med thugs/ /snying rje'i yul du dgongs nas sdong grogs mdzod/ /lugang na ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin lhun grub 'di/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i rin chen rdul brtsegs 'dra/ /brtan brjod gang des ngoms med blo yi mchog /rtag 〉rol pa'i go skabs bdag la stsol/ /

15gnyis pa dngos po'i dpe ni/ dper na 'phags pa khyod zhal bco lnga'i zla ba bzhin/ /sku yang mi 'gyur ri rab lhun po mtshungs/ / gsung yang mi 'gag chos rnga chen po ltar/ /thugs kyang mi 'khrul chu gter chen po 'dra/ / yang na bka' drin gzhal med rdo rje rnon po mchog /mthu ldan dwangs byed ke ta ka dang mtshungs/ /lus can kun gyi 'dod pa 'jo ba ni/ /lha yi sa brtol ljon shing rjes su 'gro/ /lugapar na nam mkha'i nor bu dang mtshungs zhal dkyil 'khor/ /'dzum pa'i tshems phreng mu tig phreng ba bzhin/ /'khyog pa'i spyan zung mdzes par g.yo ba'i tshul/ /rkang drug bung ba gzhon nu'i rjes su 'gro/ /

16yang na tshad med yon tan me zhal lam dang mtshungs/ /zad med blo gros gser gyi ri bo bzhin/ /'gro ba'i mi shes ma rig sel ba'i tshul/ /'di ni nam mkha'i nor bu'i rjes su 'gro/ / gsum pa zlog pa'i dpe ni/ dper na ngag gi dbang phyug khyod kyi sgra dbyangs bzhin/ /dre za lha yi gling bu snyan par 'gyur/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor phrin las ye shes bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu'i ye shes bdo bar 'gyur/ /yang na tshangs sras lha mo khyod kyi gzi byin bzhin/ /pad+ma'i rtsa lag snang ba ches bkra la/ /gang gi mchu sgros dang mtshungs dpyid ma'i dpal/ /rim bzhin sa la 'khyud 'di mthong ngam kye/ /

17lugang na ye shes me long khyod kyi mtshan bzang bzhin/ /me zhal lam gyi rgyu skar rab dumatshar/ /gang gi 'od 'khor dang mtshungs dbang po'i gzhu/ /srid pa'i mig la shar ba'i tshul 'di mdzes/ /kunang na dkar mo khyod zhal 'dzum pa'i mchu sgros bzhin/ /ngur pa sgra 'byin ze'u 'bru rab spyadamar/ /gang gi gsung dbyangs drug cu'i rgyud mang bzhin/ /ka la wing ku'i mgrin blu lhag par snyan/ /bzhi pa phan tshun gyi dpe ni/ dper na khyod sku 'gyur med ri rab dzin po bzhin/ /'gyur med ri rab bzhin du khyod kyi sku/ /gsung dbyangs mi 'gag dri za'i gling bu bzhin/ /dri za'i gling bu bzhin du khyod kyi gsung / /

18yang na rkang gnyis gtso bo'i sku yi 'od 'khor bzhin/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba'i tshul 'di mdzes/ /'ja' tshon mkha' la bkra brji bzhin du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la 'od 'khor 'khyud pa mdzes /ya nga na nges pa lnga ldan mtshan dpe'i bkod pa bzhin/ / thun mtshams sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i tshul 'di mdzes/ /mtshams sprin mkha' la yal ba ji bzhin du/ /ye shes phung po chos sku'i dbyings su zhi/ /yang na lta bas mi ngoms zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /'dam skyes 'char khra grol ba'i dpal 'di mdzes/ /chu skyes rkang drug gzhon nus spyo da pa bzhin/ /gang gi blo gros las can skyes bus spyod/ /

19lnga pa nges pa'i dpe ni/ dper na 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i lung rtogs shes rab ste/ /ma rig mun sel snang byed khro nar mtshungs/ /de dang gzhan ni 'ga' yang mtshungs pa min/ /'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug khro na yin/ /yang na mu dang zad du med pa'i lus can la/ /'khyud pa'i ma rig log rtog mun pa'i smag /khro na'i gnyen por rkang pa 'jog pa ste/ /dper 'os 'di 'dra srid pa gsuman med/ /yang na spangs rtogs yon tan kun gyi rtser son cing / /ma rig 'bur 'joms shes rab rnon po mchog /nam mkha'i rlung gi spu gri nyid mtshungs kyi/ /dper 'os gzhan 'ga' stong gsum 'di na med/ /

20yang na legs pa'i yon tan kun gyi mthar son cing / /sna tshogs thabs kyis lam ston khro bo'i rje/ /'phags bod mkhas pa'i shing rta nyi da mtshungs kyi/ / gzhan ni dus 'dir rjes mthun tsam yang med/ /drug pa nges med kyi dpe ni/ dper na ltar mi mngon pa lha mo'i bzhin ras dang / /yar ngo tshes pa'i kun phan 'od snang nyid/ /re zhig mtshan nyid thun mong de 'dra ba'i/ /dngos gzhan srid na mchis kyang rjes su 'gro /yang na rgyal ba 'jig rten byon pa byin che ba/ /zag med sku 'di u dum wa ra dang / / dus dang mdzes chos la sogs mtshungs pa bzhin / /dngos gzhan mchis kyang de yi rjes su 'gro /

21yang na gnas lugs 'khrul med gsal ba'i ye shes dang / /phyi dngos gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu nyid/ /re zhig mtshungs chos la sogs de 'dra ba/ /gzhan du gsal yang de yi rjes su 'gro /lugang na thos dka'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang / /lha yi gar mkhan gling bu bus pa'i sgra /re zhig snyan cha mtshungs pa de 'dra ba'i/ /sgra gzhan mchig kyang de yi rjes su 'gro /bdun pa bsdus pa'i dpe ni/ dper na dbyangs can khyod zhal mtshar dzug ldan khro nas/ /gtsuge gi nor bu'i rjes su 'gro min te/ /kun gyi yid 'phrog thub pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /lus can kun la bde ba ster bas kyang / /

22yang na rje khyod bla gos gsol ba kho na yis/ /shākya seṅga'i rjes su 'gro min te/ /rnam dkar lhag bsam ldan pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las 'dren pas kyang / /lugang na lhag bsam rmad byung sa yi tshangs pa khyod/ /gtan du 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i tshul tsam gyis/ /gsum rtsen rko shi ka yi dpal mi 'phrog /g.yo sgyus pha rol gzhan sde gnon pas kyang / /pagangange skyon khru/sa phra khyod gzugs mdzes sdug ldan khro nas/ /dri za'i bu mo'i rjes su 'gro min te/ /kun gyi yid bsgyur thub pa'i gar mdzes shing / /skye rgu'i mig la dga' ba ster bas kyang / /

23brgyad pa phul byung gi dpe ni/ dper na khyod kyi gzi brjid dpal ni khyod gzugs la/ /mthong zhing pad+ma rgya mtsho'i khrod na gnas/ /gzhan pa'i khyad 'phags 'byed chos zhib mo'i blos/ /grangs med brtags kyang tha dad yod min no/ /yang na dri za'i gling bu bsgyur ba'i sgra dbyangs dang / /mtsho byung lha mos rgyud mangs bsgrengs ba'i gsung / /rten yul tsam zhig tha dad dbyeb las/ /gzhan du brtags kyang dmigs su yod min no/ /yang na rgyal ba'i chos gos rnam sbyar sku nyid la/ /snang zhing lha lam thun mtshams snang ba 'char/ /rten yul so sor snang ba tsam zhig las/ /bkrag mdangs mdzes chos la sogs tha mi dad/ /

24lugang na gang sku'i 'od zer sna tshogs bkra ba dang / /rol pa'i gnas la 'char ba'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /snang yul zung du dbye ba tsam zhig las/ /nan gyis brtags kyang tha dad mi mnga' 'o /yang na me zhal lam gyi rgyu skar phreng ba dang / /lha mo'i sku la mnga' ba'i mtshan dpe'i rgyan/ /ltar snang yul tsam so sor gsal ba las/ /don la legs par brtags kyang tha mi dad/ /yang na ston pas don bzang khrol ba'i legs bshad dang / /dkar mos tshangs dbyangs sgrogs pa'i snyan 'gyur gnyis/ /sku mchog so sor snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ /gzhan du brtags kyang tha dad dbyer ma mchis/ /

25yang na mkhas pas zhu dag byas pa'i legs bshad dang / /ke ta ka yis dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho'i chu/ /dmigs yul tha dad mnga' ba tsab rtsazhig las/ /lan brgyar bltas kyang gtsang cha tha mi dad/ /lugang na tshangs ma'i gzigs byed dpal ni khyod zhal la/ /snang zhing rkang drug steng 'phyo'i sbubs su ste/ /rten yul tha dad dmigs pa tsam khyig las/ / zhib mor brtags kyang so sor 'byed mi nus/ /dgu pa rab btags kyi dpe ni/ dper na lha yi bu mo'i mthon mthing lcang lo ni/ /nga la yod ces cang shes snyems mi dgos/ /srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'dzam gling na/ /lus phra la yang lcang lo yod pa'i phyir/ /

26yang na lus phras skye dgu'i mig la dpal ster ba/ /mtshon phyir ngang pa'i bu mo khengs mi rigs/ /dngos med sgyu ma mkhan gyi 'phrul 'khor la'ang / /skye dgu'i mig la dga' ba ster phyir ro/ /yang na yid 'ong dpyod dpal mtha' kun mi brtan par/ /mtshon phyir dal 'gro'i lbu bsnyems ma byed/ /me zhal lam la 'char ba'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /yud tsam mi brtan g.yo ba'i chos can no/ /yang na ston pas chos kyi phung por longs spyod pa/ /mtshon phyir dpyod ku'i bung ba rgyags mi rigs/ /'jig rten khams 'dir bla ma'i gsung la yang skye dgu rnams kyis longs su spyod phyir ro/ /

27bcu pa mad byung gi dpe ni/ dper na u dum wa rar rin chen sna tshogs kyis/ /brgyan nas rgyud mangs bsgreng ste rgyu byed la/ /'gro ba'i ma rig blun tshul bsal nus na/ /tasbu ra yi chung ma khyod dang mtshungs/ /yang na dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ston zla gsar pa'i dpyod/ /smin 'khyog zur mig g.yo ba'i tshul ldan la/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu 'brug ltar sgrogs nus na/ / mtsho byung lha mo'i bzhin dpal yang dag gsal/ /yang na rkang 'thung lha shing ljon par mtshams sprin gyirme/ /'khyud nas har gyis stong gsum skor byed la/ /blo dang 'tshams par legs bshad 'doms nus na/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /

28yang na nam mkha'i sdings la sgrogs pa'i dbyar rnga dang / /dpyod dpal khu byug gzhon nu myos pa'i skad/ /rgyud mangs dbyangs su byas las chos thos na/ /gshin rje sring mo'i dge legs rab zhugasal/ /bcu gcig pa rmyongs pa'i dpe ni/ dper na shākya seṅge'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ / me tog u dum wa rar rnam 'khrul te/ / shākya seṅge'i zhal yin 'du shes kyis/ /u dum wa rar mchod de gus phyag 'tshal/ /yang na rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs chos kyi rje/ /tshe 'dir 'gog med bdag gis mjal ba'i blos/ /bsil zer ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ /dal trī nub rir 'phags pa'i rjes su bsnyegs/ /

29lugang na brgyad gnyis lang 'tsho 'bar ba rgyal ba'i yum/ /yang yang 'dzum zhal mjal bar 'dod pa'i blos/ /dpyid dpal rkang 'thung gzhon nur rnam 'khrul te/ /bdag gi yid rab dad pas rtsa bar 'dud/ /yang na tshe 'dir bka' drin che ba'i snying gi grogs/ /yid la rtag dubasil chab 'dren pa yis/ /ri dwags mtshan mar rab 'khrul snying sdug ma'i/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bsam pas mdun sar rgyu/ /bcu gnyis pa the tshom gyi dpe ni/ dper na lus can kun gyis dga' ba'i pad+ma la/ /ro bcud len pa'i bung ba 'khor ram ci/ /yang na lus phra'i gdong la mig g.yo 'am/ /'dzin med bdag gi sems ni rnam par g.yo/ /

30yang na rgyu skar lam du legs bris gzhon nu ma/ /skal ldan gzhon pa'i khrod du gshegs sam ci/ /byams pa'i yid kyi mdza' mo khro bo'i grogs/ /rang yul phyogs nas bltas sam 'phyang mo phyug /yang na ldem ldem 'khyug 'khyug 'phar ba'i 'od dkar can/ /ne'u gsing yid 'ong dkyil na gshegs sam ci/ /yang na ngag dbang lha mos zhal gzigs sam / /bdag gi sems ni som nyi'i lam du tshi / /lugang na thor tshugs ldan pa'i gsang sngags rnal 'byor pa/ /grong khyer khrod du slong mor gshegs sam ci/ /yang na sna tshog mig gis gar khrab bam/ /bdag ni blo rtse gnyis kyi bar du 'thoms/ /

31bcu gsum pa gtan la phebs pa'i dpe ni/ dper na srid gsum blo mongs sel ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /'byung bzhi ma rig lcags khams ma lus pa/ / rmyongs pa kun sel nyi zla ma larges te/ /de phyir ye shes rang gzugs 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /yang na mdzes sdug dri zhim zla ba'i dpal bkra zhing / /'gro la 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i phung po 'di/ / mi shes rmyongs pa'i rang tshul sel ba'i phyir/ /bsil zer ma yin shes rab lha mo kye/ /yang na stong gsum dpal gyi phung po snyil byed pa'i/ /khyod zhal mjal mod 'khor ba'i 'dziṭa pa las/ / bde blag skyob phyir dran pa'i dgra min te/ /de phyir dge ba'i 'byung gnas khyod nyid do/ /

32yang na brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i mtshar sdug cher 'phros shing / /kun la phan bde ster ba'i ye shes thugs/ / mtha' yas kun gyi nyon mongs bsregs pa'i phyir/ /rta bdun ma yin ye shes phung po'i gter/ /bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ dper na rtsam bkra kun nas dkar mdzes mdangs ldan pa'i/ /dpal dang dri ngad ldang ba'i rnam pa yis/ /ku/na la dga' mgu'i bde ba rab skyed pa/ /lha ga pa'i lha mo chu skyes pad+ma bzhin/ /yang na 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i dpal 'byor ches bkra zhing / /ma ma smin re ba spangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /'gro la dam chos ster ba'i mgon po mchog /lha yi phun tshogs rkang 'thung ljon pa bzhin/ /

33kunang na dpal dang dri bzang ldan pa'i bzhin ras can/ /skal ldan snying la dga' ba gsar pa'i ro /sbyin byed blo gros 'phel ba rtsom pa yi/ /ngag dbang lha mo dpyid dpal gzhon nu bzhin/ /yang na legs byas srid pa'i dpal 'byor rnam bkra zhing / /rnam smin re ba bcas pa'i 'dod dgu yi sa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir dbang ba'i sa skyong khyod/ /lha yi dbang po mkha' lding rgyal mtshan bzhin/ /bco lnga pa mnyam nyid kyi dpe ni/ dper na rgyal ba'i legs bshad 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mchog /srid pa gsum gyi mes po dam pa bzhin/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas/ /phyogs bzhi'i gdul bya 'dren pa'i ngo mtshar mtho/ /

34lugang na mdzes ldan reg bya 'jam pa'i lus phra ma/ /lta bas mi ngoms dpyid dpal gzhon nu bzhin/ /lus can kun gyi yid dbang cig car du/ /'phrog cing ba spu'i tshogs rnams g.yo bar nus/ /lugang na dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gter/ /'dod 'jo sa brtol ljon pa'i ngo mtshar bzhin/ /dpal 'byor kun gyi byed po de lha min/ /re ba ji ltar skong la mkhas pas so/ /yang na dpal dang grags pa'i yon tan ma lus kun/ /yongs su rdzogs pa kun mkhyen shākya'i tog /'chi med gtso bo gser gyi thig le bzhin/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyug thob/ /

35bcu drug pa smad pa'i dpe ni/ dper na dkar kha dwangs ba'i gangs ri nyi mas bzhus/ /rab mdzes 'ja' tshon mtshar yang brtan med yal/ /smra ba'i seṅge ye shes chen po'i gter/ /gting zab mu med gzhal phyir ga la rigs / /yang na dal 'gro kha zheng che yang rnyog mas 'gos/ /dbang phyug byed por grags kyang 'khor bas bcings/ /shes rab 'khor lo khyod thugs ye shes gter/ /dzi bzhin gzhal phyir 'gran zla ga la yod/ /yang na dri ngad ldang ba'i dpyid dpal ba mos bcom/ /nam mkha'i nor bu sprin pa'i gzhan dbang —gyur/ /de dag las ni shes rab lha mo'i sku/ /mtshungs pa las kyang khyad chos du mas 'phags/ /

36lugang na sa brtol 'dod pa 'jo yang blo mi ldan/ /rgya mtsho gting mtha' che ba ba tshwas brnyogs/ /smra seng khyed thugs blo gros 'byung ba'i khungs/ /tshul de tsam gyis gzhal phyir ga la rigs/ /bcu bdun pa bsngags pa'i dpe ni/ dper na pad tshal ljon pa'i me tog kun nas mdzes / /de la bung ba 'khor ba'i sgra skad kyis/ /rna ba'i dbang por snyan 'jebs sgra sgrogs pa/ /de dag ngag gi dpal mo'i rnam rol mtshungs/ /yang na pha mas bskyangs pa'i bka' drin gzhal mi phod/ /yongs 'du sa brtol 'dod pa 'byung ba'i khungs/ /de dag nyid dang ye shes phung po'i thugs/ /na ma par mtshungs so smra ba'i rgyal po kye/ /

37yang na spangs rtogs yon tan kun gyi rtser son cing / /blo gsal tshogs la dam chos 'doms byed pa'i/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen bzhin rje bla ma/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon du rnam par mjos/ / yang na ti ma'i mdzod kyi kha zheng mthil mi rig /mkhas pa yon tan sna tshogasa'abyung ba'i gter/ /de dag nyid dang 'jam dpal khyod kyi thugs/ /rnam pa kun dumatshungs so lhag pa'i lha/ /bco brgyad pa brjod 'dod kyi dpe ni/ daster na sgrib gnyis ye nas dag pa'i chos kyi sku/ /gdul bya'i khams su sku'i sprul don mdzad pa/ /snang ba'i nyin byed che dang rab mtshungs zhes/ /de ltar brjod 'dod bdag gi yid la yod/ /

38yang na phyi nang zang thal rnam par dag pa 'am/ /mi shes bem po'i skyon gyis 'gos kyang rung / /khyod thugs ye shes dri med shel sgong bzhin/ /snang zhes brjod 'dod kho bo'i yid la bsti/ /lugapar skyon bslab gsum 'dzin pa skal ldan yongs kyi rje/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis rnam grol lam ston pas/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen dang mtshungs so zhes/ /bdag blor rnam pa kun skyobarjod 'dod mchis/ /yang na thar lam bgrod pa'i blo gros nyer ston pa'i/ /zur phud lnga pas dzi ltar mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /num mkha'i nor bu nyid mtshungs brjod pa la/ /ji ltar gyur kyang yid kyi snang ngor shar/ /

39btsu dgu pa 'gal ba'i dpe ni/ dper na srab 'jam yangs pa'i ka tsa len+da dang / /dri med dwangs pa'i nor bu be+eḍūr+ya/ /ngag gi dpal mo'i bzhin dang gsum po ni/ /yul dus dngos po'i rnam pa tha dad do/ /yang na me zhal lam la 'khrigs pa'i ka dam pa/ /srid pa'i mig la 'khyud pa'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /rngon pa'i mdun sar rgyu ba'i tshe dang gsum/ /mtshungs kyang phan tshun rnam pa so sor 'gal/ /yang na rab gsal ston ku'i zla dang dpyid ku'i dpal/ /mtsho ldan lha mo'i sku yi mdzes chos rnams/ /gcig kyang tha dad snang ba'i ngang tshul la/ /bltas pas so sor 'gal bar bdag sems so/ /

40yang na dri bzhon gseb skyoganas pa'i mar me dang / /chu bur bzhin du 'jig pa'i nam mkha'i glog /dmag gi g.yul ngor 'jug pa'i tshe dang gsum/ /rings par bsgrin kyang rnam pa tha dad 'gal/ /nyi shu pa dgag pa'i dpe ni/ dper na 'dzin med lung ston chos rnga chen po'i sgra/ /gzhan yid bslu ba'i pi wang sgra snyan la/ /ngag gi dpal mo'i gsung la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /spobs pa cha shas tsam yang ga la yod/ /yang na bslab gsum nyams bzhes mthil phyin chos kyi sku/ /dmigs med 'gro la brtse ba'i ye shes che/ /rnam par bral ba'i sna tshogs shing rta yis/ /khro bo'i rje la 'gran pa'i nus pa dben/ /

41lugang na yan lag brgyad dang mi ldan ba tshwas brnyogs/ /gzhan phan kun slong bzang po'i sems mi mnga' /zla ba'i ma mas 'jam dpal khyod kyi thugs/ /cha tsam dpe ru mtshon pa'i nus pa dben/ / kugang na mi brtan 'phel 'grib gza' yi gzhan dbang can/ /bden gnyis gzigs pa'i mig gi dbang po bral/ /grib ma'i lus kyis lha mo khyod kyi zhal/ /bgres rgud mi mnga'i sku la ci zhig mtshungs/ /nyer gcig pa mdzes pa'i dpe'am ngo bstod kyi dpe ni/o rgyan pada' byung kha ṭas rdo rjes mtshan/ /rig grolabastan 'dzin mgon de rnam sbyar ni/ /ngur sprig kho nas sku nyid brgyan gyur mod/ / mtshungs pa'i khyad chos thun mong gyur la ltos/ /

42yang na spru lo ma dgra 'dren byed stong gis mtshan/ /rnam grol ār+ya bde ba spyan 'bras gcig /khro nas phyi rol snang zhing brgyan gyur mod/ /mtshungs pa'i chos la khyad par ci zhig bdog /yang na mgon khyod blo gsal gzhon nu 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /smin grol mdzad cing shākya'i khyu mchog ni/ /mtshan bzang la sogs yon tan mtha' yas kyang / /gzhan don nyid la khyad par yod pas stongs/ /yang na ngag gi dbang phyug ma rig yongs 'joms pa'i/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing tshangs pa'i sras mo ni/ /rmyongs sel 'phen pa'i mtshon cha mi ldan yang / /ma rig yongs su gnon la khyad ci yod/ /

43nyer gnyis pa de nyid brjod pa'i dpe ni/ dper na tshul gnas thos bsam yon tan rab bsgrags pa/ /dri za'i rgyud mang ma yin thub pa'i gsung / /ro bcud len pa'i bung ba kun 'dus pa/ /g.yu sbrang ma yin byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs/ / yang na brgyad gnyis lang tsho ldan pa lha mo'i zhal / / yin mod ston ku'i chu shel dbang po min/ /'dab chags khu byug skad min sgra snyan gyi/ / gsung dbyangs dbang por 'jebs pa'i gdangs snyan lags/ /yang na rnam par bkra ba'i mig ngor snang ba mdzes/ /gshin rje'i sring mo yin gyi dpyid dpal min/ /legs bshad nges 'byung rna lam sgrogs pa yang / /tshangs dbyangs drug cu yin gyi dbyar rnga ci/ /

44 lugang na reg bya rnam par 'jam 'di sgra sgrogs dang / /mtshungs kyang sprin min legs bris lha rdzas gos/ /shin dumatshar 'di dbang po'i gzhu 'dra yang / / ma yin ngag dbang lha mo'i sku yi 'od / /nyer gsum pa thun mong min pa'i dpe ni/ dper na kun+da'i 'khri shing gsar pa'i mtshar sdug dang / /kun yid 'phrog pa'i 'dab brgya las mdzes pa'i/ /khyod sku'i dpe zlar 'os pa 'dzam gling na/ /med phyir mdzes 'das rang nyid ma tshungs par gyur / /lugacadri skyes nags rdzing ut+pal sngon po'i mtshar sdug las/ /rnam par 'das pa lha mo'i zur mig gi /dpe zlar 'os pa stong gsum 'jig rten na/ /med phyir rang nyid mtshungs dper gyur la ltos/ /

45pya5nga na rab dkar 'dab chags ngang pa'i phreng tshogs dang / /ston zla mtshan mor mdzes pa'i cha tsam du/ /mtshungs chos 'gran zla bral bas mdzes pa'i dper/ /rang nyid legs bstan shes rab lha mo kye/ /yang na kun gsal sa bla steng gi 'dzig rten na/ /sa brtol lhag bsam mi mnga' re skong tsam/ /rnam smin re ba sparā pa'i dge sbyong che/ / rang nyid 'ba' zhig dpe ru bstan par gyur/ /nyer bzhi pa byung min gyi dpe ni/ dper na rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ye shes ma lus kun/ /snying po gcig skyobasdus pa'i phung po bzhin/ /zur phud lnga pa'i thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /snang ba tsam gyi nus mthu khyad par 'phags/ /

46yang na srid gsum dpal gyi phung po ma lus kun / /gcig 〉spungs bzhin gser zhal 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /ma rung bdud bzhi 'joms par byed pa la/ /stong gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i thub par grags/ /yang na ka cog zhang gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ / blo gros mtha' dag gcig dubasdus pa bzhin/ /be+e ro tsa na'i thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /snang ba tsam gyis 'dzam gling mdzes par byed/ /yang na skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan kun/ /ma lus gcig du'adzoms pa'i phun tshogs bzhin/ /snyigs dus mi rnam/sa blo gros ches phra bar/ /'jam dbyangs yid la mjal ba'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /

47nyer lnga pa srid min gyi dpe ni/ dper na srid gsum 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam las/ /lus can bde bar 'byung ba srid ma yin/ /khron chu las ni nor bu mi srid bzhin/ /drang srong ngag las rdzun tshig smra srid dam/ /yang na dge ba'i stobs las sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang / /stong nyid dngos por grub pa'i gtan tshigs bzhin/ /thub pa spangs rtogs yon tan ldan pa las/ /nyon mongs gsar du skyes pa'i tshul 'di ci / /lugang na ma la ya yi rlung las dri ngan dang / /mi gtsang ba las dri zhim mi 'byung bzhin/ /thos pas phongs pa'i skye bo blun po las/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad 'byung srid dam/ /

48lugang na gcan gzan dug sprul kha las gsos sman dang / /ri dwags 'chang las myos dug mi 'byung bzhin/ /rnam pa kun tu'atshe ba'i bshan pa las / /snying rje til 'bru tsam zhig ga la srid/ / nyer drug pa mang ba'i dpe ni / dper na be+eḍūr+ya dang chu shel nor bu dang / /gangs dang 'o mtsho seṅge kun+da sogs/ /de bzhin shes rab 'khor lo'i zhal dkyil ni/ / mngon par 'tshal lo ye shes me long kye/ /lugang na lus skye'i thugs mtha' grangs dang ngoṭa can gting / /'dzin ma'i rdul dang rgyu skar lam gyi mtha'/ /'khor ba'i thog mtha' tshad gzung mi mnga' bzhin/ /shākya seṅga'i phrin las su yis dpog /

49yang na khu byug myos pa'i skad dang sum rtsen gyi/ /gar mkhan stong gis rgyud mangs sgrogs pa dang / /thub pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsung bzhin du/ /ngag dbang lha mo'i tshangs dbyangs rna lam 'jebs yang na kha ba'i rdul dang khra che'i dmar brtan dang / / spos dang tsan dan lha shing shug pa sogs/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i tshul khrims dri ngad ni/ /gang du bzhugs pa'i gling 'dir yang dag 'gugs/ /nyer bdun pa rnam 'gyur gyi dpe ni/ dper na zur phud lnga pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /shar gyi thig le'i ngos nas mdangs len ltar/ /sku gzugs mdzes pa lta na sdug pa yang /dpyod dpal rkang 'thung tshogs las blangs pa bzhin/ /

50yang na rgyas byed ma yi zhal gyi mchu sgros spi/ /ngur pa sgra 'byin dbus nas bton pa bzhin/ /gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i tshangs dbyangs sgrogs pa yang / /rnam sad chos rnga che las blangs dang mtshungs/ / yang na dkar zhing rab skyodangs pa'i lha mo'i sku/ /'o ma'i mtsho las gsar du bltams pa 'dra/ /rin chen rgyan gyi 'phyang 'phrul g.yo ba ni/ /thun mtshams sprin las grub pa bzhin du mdzes/ /yang na rgyal ba kun gyi ma ma'i 'dren byed ni/ /dud 'gro ri dwags mig las phyung ba 'dra/ /sngar yod nyon mongs gsar du 'joms pa'i blo/ /rta ldang can gyi khrod las blangs pa bzhin/ /

51nyer brgyad pa phreng ba'i dpe ni/ dper na sngon byon nyi ma'i gnyen bzhin bla mas kyang / / 'chad bzhin de mthus 'khor ba'i sems can bzhin/ /blang dor gnad shes skye bo thar pa bzhin/ /gang zag skal ldan de yis gtong ba spel/ /lugajorngo na rlung gi shing rtas snang byed sgrib pa bzhin/ / srid pa'i mig gis sgrol byed 'od can bzhin/ /snar ma'i bdag pos pad+ma zum pa ltar/ /tshangs pa'i sras mos ma rig phung po 'joms /lugangur skyod yar ngo'i grib ma'i lus bzhin de yis kyang / /mun bzhin de mthus lus can yid dga' bzhin/ /bsil ba'i reg pas pho mo'i 'dod chags bzhin/ /'jam dpal thugs rjes bdag blo gsar du byas/ /

52yang na sdong po'i yal 'dab rgyas bzhin de yis kyang / /me tog la bzhin de mthus 'bras bu bzhin/ /legs par smin pas 'dab chags lus stobs bzhin/ /lha mo'i gsung gis bdag blo rnon por byas/ /nyer dgu pa ngag don gyi dpe'i bzhin sgra gcig pa ni/ dper yon khyod zhal dkar dmar mdangs ldan mig g.yo zhing / /'dzum dkar mchu sgros pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru 'di/ /kun+da'i gzhon nu g.yu sbrang g.yo ldan pa/ /ge sar rnam bkra'i 'dzum gyis mngon pa bzhin/ /yang na gang sku mtshan dpe'i brtsod pa rab 'phro zhing / /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la gzigs pa'i thugs/ /phyogs/ kyi mu khyud mkha' la mngon phyogs shing / /gling bzhir brdal ba'i 'od stong 'phro bzhin mdzes/ /

53yang na chos sku mnyam bzhag ngang las mi g.yo zhing / /'phyang 'phrul g.yo ba'i chos gos ngur sprig can/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs g.yo 'gul mi mnga' zhing / /srod ku'i thun mtshams lang long g.yo bzhin mdzes/ /lugang na rnam mdzes dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhal/ /gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i zur mig g.yo ba can/ /'o mtsho rin che na gter gyi phung po la/ /rgyu ba gser nya pho mo bzhin du mdzes/ /bzhin sgra du ma'i dpe ni/dper na yar ngo'i zla gsar ji bzhin mtsho ldan ma/ /margad gzhu dbyibs dzi bzhin g.yo mig can/ /pad+ma'i 'dab mji bzhin zhal g.yogs kyis/ /sgul zhing mgrin glu pi lngang sgra snyan bzhin/ /

54yang na dpyid dpal gzhon nu dzi bzhin zla mdzes ma/ /zhim mngar ge sar bcud bzhin legs gsungs chos/ /shi lī mu khra bzhin du bdag gis kyang //rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi spangs te kun duspyod/ /yang na ston zla gsar pa ji bzhin 'jam dpal zhal / /'od can mngon par bkra bzhin mtshan dpe'i rgyan/ /sprin gyis sgrib nus min bzhin nyon mongs dgras/ /gzhar yang mi g.yo bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal/ /yang na pad+ma'i rtsa lag ji bzhin lha mo'i bzhin/ /brtan med dbang gzhu bzhin du smin 'khyog can/ /gling bzhi mun pa'i sdug bsngal bsal ba bzhin/ /gang gis lus can rmyongs pa'i gdung ba sel/ /

55sum cu pa zla bo dngos po'i dpe ni/ dper na gangs can ljongs der skad gnyis smu ba'i dbang / / ji tsam byon kyang thu mir 'gran nus su/ /rkang 'thung skyed tshal phal pa mang mchis kyang / /phun tshogs sa brtol ljon shing skye ba dkon/ /yang na gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len pa/ /mang yang mthar son gyur pa pada' byung rje/ /rtsen dus rnam par bkra ba'i snang byed ni / /srid pa'i mig las gnyis pa yod re skan/ /yang na ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu mang byon kyang / /ral gri 'chang ba khyod kyi do zla med/ /thams cad skad du bden bzhi'i chos ston pa/ /shākya seṅge gnyis pa su zhig mchis / /

56yang na gzhung rig kun la brtson pa ches mang yang / /mthil phyin rtse mor 'phags pa shong ston rje/ /dpyod dpal sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan mang skyes kyang //me tog u dum wa ra thob pa dkon/ /so gcig pa mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe ni/ dper na pad 'byung rnga yab 'od kyi pho brang zhing / /'dzigs bral rdo rje 'jig rten khams 'dir mdzes/ /de yis rig 'dzin lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ /gang gis bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i tshogs la dbang / /yang na thub pa'i dbang po theg gsum ba /dul bya dang / /grags pa'i mu khyud lha mo'i yod na ngoms/ /mnyam med rgyal bas byang chub lam ston zhing / /gang gis dmag gi g.yul ngor lam sna ston/ /

57yang na ye shes me long nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbus/ /lho yi phyogs skyong las mkhan gseb na dpa' / /de yis 'gro ba skal ldan mtho ris dang / /gang gis las ngan sems can dmyal bar 'phen/ /lugang na dbyangs can bskal bzang 'dren pa stong gi dkyil/ /sna tshogs shing rta tshogs bzang mdun na 'jebs/ /de yi yan lag drug cu ldan pa'i dbyangs/ /gang gi mgrin blus gzhan yid rab 〉'phrog /so gnyis pa rgyu'i dpe ni/ dper na rnam mdzes mtshan dpe'i longs skus gangs ri dang / /rnam dkar lhag bsam thugs rjes 'o mtsho'i gter/ /bla med zab gsal myur ba'i mkhyen rab kyis/ /snang ba'i mu khyud mtshungs so zla mdzes ma/ /

59yang na gang gi bzhin ras dkar bas bsil zer dang / /kun yid 'phrog pas dpyid dpal gzhon nu ste/ /zur mig g.yo bas skad cig 'od mtshungs pa/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo khyed la khro bo dad / / yang na gang sku gzhon nur gyur pas 'dab brgya dang / /zab rgya'i yon tan 'dzin pas ge sar bcud/ /blo yi 'dod pa 'jo bas sa brtol gyi/ /'gran zlar bzod pa smra ba'i rgyal po kye/ /yang na 'jam dpal khyod snyu mdzes pas kun+da dang / /gsung mchog dbang por snyan pas tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs klong rnam par bkra bas 'ja' 'od kyi/ /gur khyim mtshungs pa khyod la bdag dga' 'o/ /

59dpe'i skyon sel las rtags tha dad kyang skyon med pa ni/ dper na 'jam mgon khyod ni tshangs pa'i sras mo ltar/ /rmyongs mun sel byed sgron mer gyur pa ste/ / rgyal ba'i yum gyur dbyangs kyi rgyal mo yang / /rta ljang can bsnyen srid pa'i mun 'jotshwa nyid/ /yang na 'jam dbyangs skyod tshul chos kyi dpal mo bzhin/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'phags ma tā re yang / /bdud lco bzhin du dbul ba'i gdung sel nyid/ /yang na thub dbang khyod ni rin chen char ldan ltar/ /'gro ba'i re skong tshad mar gyur pa ste/ /dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma'ang / /sa brtol bzhin du dzi ltar 'dod 'jo nyid/ /

60yang na smu ba'i seṅge'i phrin las dbyangs can bzhin/ / ma rig phung po snyil byed gyur pa ste/ /dbyangs kyi bdag nyid zla ba'i sring mo yang / /bsil zer bzhin du lus can yid dga' nyid/ /tshig tha dad kyang skyon med pa ni/ dper na thub pa'i dbang po gser gyi ri bdun bzhin/ /zad med gter gyi yon tan 'byung ba'i khungs/ /rnam dkar mtshan dang dpe byad brgyad cu sogs/ / ston zla gsar pa'idakyil 'khor gcig pus mtshon/ /yang na kho bo'i bla ma 'dzam gling rgyan drug ltar/ /bstan pa'i bya ba grangs med mdzad pa ste/ /dzi lta dzi snyed mkhyen pa'i yon tan rnams/ /tshad gzhal mi mnga' ngogs can nyid dang mnyam/ /

61yang na mtsho byung lha mo dpyod ga'i dpal rnams dang / /gzhan yid 'phrog par byed la mthun pa ste/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dri ngad rnams/ /ma la ya yi rlung gzhon gcig pus mtshon/ /yang na pad+ma 'byung gnas skye rgu'i srog rnams bzhin/ /dus gsum mgon du shin dugaces pa ste/ /rnam dkar lhag bsam mdzad phrin bzang po sogs/ /tshad med lha yi rdzing ring nyid dang mnyam/ / dpe don mchog dman byung yang skyon med pa ni/ dper na rnam grol nges pa lnga dang ldan pa bzhin/ /mdo sngags lam la zhugs pa'i bshes gnyen mchod/ /rgyas byung ma yi rgyud mangs sgrogs pa'i tshul/ / dpyid ma'i khu byug skad bzhin rna lam 'jebs/ /

62yang na 'dun pa'i rtse la gnas pa'i dbyangs can bzhin / /bsil zer mkha' la shar ba'i tshul mdzes la/ /spyan zung rnam par 'phrul ba'i rnam 'gyur yang / /phur lding rkang drug bzhin du kun skyogayo/ /yang na dag pa'i zhing gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa bzhin/ /'phags bod mkhas pa'i paṇa grub rab tumadzes/ /sku la mtshan dpe'i bkod pa shar ba'i tshul/ /mtshe 'ur pad dkar bzhin du yid khar 'ong / /kunang na rgyu skar lam gyi legs bris gzhon nu bzhin/ /gshin rje'i sring mo mnal lam mjal ba mdzes/ /rnam par 'tsher ba srid pa'i mig gi 'od/ /gang gi mtshan bzang 'od kyis mog mog byed/ /

63gnyis pa dmigs bsal skyon du brtsi ba ni/dper na lus phra ma bzhin skyes pa dpa' rtsal che/ /dngos po rnams bzhin lha lam 'dus ma byas/ /wa skyes bzhin du sprin zhon rnam par rgyal/ /byang sems ji bzhi na so skyes rnam par grol/ /yang na srin mo bzhin du khrag 'thung snying stobs che/ /lus phra rnams bzhin dbyangs can bgres rgud med/ /'ug pa bzhin du sa skyong kun las mdzes/ /nyan rang ji bzhin kun mkhyen srid las rgyal/ /yang na om mdzad ma bzhin 'phrog byed gtong sems che/ /khron pa rnams bzhin sgra ldan mtha' mi mngon/ /ne tso bzhin du lo tsā ngag smra mkhas/ /ri rgyal bzhin du gangs ri mngon par mtho/ /

64yang na lha mo bzhin du 'jam dbyangs spobs pa che / /dpyod dpal tshogs bzhin gang sku 'phel 'grib med/ /byi la bzhin du dge sbyong 'gros la mkhas/ /bka' bstan bzhin du mkhas pa'i legs bshad zab/ /gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i don de dpe dang dpe can tha dad pa'i 'dra mtshungs su ma byas par/ dpe can nyid dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa yin te/ 'di la dbye ba'i rnam grangs nyi shu yod pa las/ dang po bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi dpe ni/dper na rnam par 'gying ba'i gshin rje kun gsal ngos/ /zhal dkyil chu khur smug nag rab 'khrigs shing / /khre ba'i gad rgyangs dbyar rnga sgrogs pa yis/ /ngan 'gro'i sems can rnam 'phyo zug rngu skyed/ /

65yang na khyod zhal 'o mtsho mchu sgros rba rlabs g.yo/ /tshims phreng ngang tshogs spyan zung chu nyal rgyu/ /mtshan bzang rin chen sna tshogs rab brgyan ma//rgyal ba'i yum gyur dbyangs kyi bdag mo yin/ /lugang na spros bral chos sku ri rgyal mngon mtho zhing / /'dren byed nyi zla phyogs kun g.yo zhing mdzes/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje chu 6khris 'bar ba yis/ /nyon mongs dug lnga rol mtsho ngang gis zhi/ /yang na rab dkar 'dzum zhal snang byed cha rdzogs shing / /'od 'khor dbang gzhu'i gur khyim phub pa mdzes/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'begabyed ma/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /

66gnyis pa ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ dper na sku yi 'khri shing lcang lo'i yal 'dab rgyas/ /mchu yi me tog tshems kyi ze'u 'bru dkar/ /'gags med gsung gi sbrang rtsi la chags na sa/ /mjal 'dod dad pa'i bung ba kun tugayo/ /yang na mdzes sdug sku yi ljon shing gsar pa la/ /sor mo'i yal ga phyogs mtha' kun durgyas/ /mtshan bzang dpe yi me tog rnam bkra bas/ /theg pa gsum gyi bung ba ngang gis 'khor/ /yang na zag med sku yi go 'byed klong yangs shing / /rab dmar mchu yi thun mtshams lang long g.yo/ /tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i sgra brgya sgrogs pa yis/ /skal ldan pho mo'i mgrin sngon zlos gar bsgyur / /

67 kunang na yid 'ong brla yi keng shu ka yi sdong / /le brgan r+bha ga'i me tog ge sar bcud/ /myang 'dod lisgo'i ce spyang ldem sdem 'phar/ /dbang med skyed tshal 'di ni snying re rje/ /gsum pa bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ dper na gzhung rig sgra mang thos pa'i ngogs can 'khyil/ /bsas pa'i nor bu ke ta ka yis dwangs/ /sgos pa chu yi shing rta rab dkrugs nas/ /srid zhi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha mthar so na/ /lugang na blo dang 'tshams par 'chadra pa'i sa brtol dbang / /rtso〉 pa'i mtshon chas phas rgol rnam par 'joms gzhung rig rtsos pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro/ /'thung 'dod skal ldan g.yu sbrang rab tu'atshang / /

68yang na sku yi chu sgrog bzhin ras ku mud dgra/ /sgrib gnyis rlung gi shing rtas rab 〉'khyud/ /gdung dbyangs dbyar rnga sgrog cing spyan chab kyi/ /brong char lhur bas blo yi lo tog rgyas/ /yang na brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i go bi dā ra las/ /srab 'jam zhal gos lo 'dab rnam par g.yo/ /snyan 'gyur gsung gi chos rnga cher sgrogs pas/ /theg gsum gdul bya dbyangs 'dems glu gar bsgyur/ /bzhi pa mtha' dag gzugs can ni/dper na myang myang lus kyi lcug phran gzhon nu'i rtser/ / mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i zhal gyi ston zla tshes/ /rnam dkar sen mo'i rgyu skar phreng ba can/ /tshapa sras sku yi me zhal lam 'di mdzes/ /

69yang na yid 'ong zhal gyi ku mud gyes pa'i dbus/ /mig gi rkang drug gzhon nu kun skyogayo/ /legs bshad gser gyi glegs bam 'dab ma can/ / dbyangs can sku yi nā la rnarma par mdzes/ /yang na spangs rtogs rdzogs pa'i bzhin ras nya gang zla/ /ris med thugs rje'i 'dzum dkar 'od stong 'phro/ /mngon mtho'i nges legs bdud rtsi'i phung po can/ /bu ram shing pa'i gzugs sku'i kun gsal mdzes/ /yang na dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhal gyi me tog ngos/ /tshems kyi ze'u 'bru gcig skyobastar ba'i phreng / /ljags kyi bhaṅga gzhon nu g.yo 'gul can/ /zla ba'i sring mo'i sku yi sdong bu mdzes/ /

70lnga pa cha shas gzugs can ni/ dper namang du thos pa'i yal 'dab rab skyobakra/ /legs par bsas pa'i me tog cher gyes shing / /ting 'dzin sgos pa'i 'bras bzang g.yur ba las/ /legs bshad 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i dge sbyong che/ /yang na rnam dkar dge ba'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs shing / /gnas lnga rig pa'i lo thog legs par skyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i me tog rgyas pa las/ / blo ldan gzhon nu dga' ba'i dpal du chas/ / yang na dgyes zhal ston zla'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shing / /mtshan dpe'i mu tig phreng bas legs brgyan pa'i/ /zag med dbyangs can sku yi mdzes sdug 'di/ /mthong ba tsam gyis srid zhi'i mtha' las grol/ /

71yang na phul byung mkhyen rab dpyod dpal rab rgyas shing / /gsung rab mang gzigs mig gi gser sbrang can/ /'gro ba kun gyi dga' ba'i ro gcig pu/ / rnam grol thub pa'i dbang po de khro na/ / drug pa cha shas can gyi gzugs can ni/ dper na rab dkar tshangs sras mdzes sku sa 'dzin che/ /'jo sgeg zur mig g.yo zhing 'dzum dang bcas/ /tshangs dbyangs sgrog cing sna tshogs rgya na gyis spras/ /lta bas mi ngoms mdzes sdug rmad du byung / / yang na dbyangs can bzhin ras puṇ+ḍa rī ku'i ngos/ / shes bya kun la gzigs pa'i 'dren byed dang / /'gags med legs bshad sgrogs pa'i mgrin gyi ngag /'dzum pas skal ldan rgyud la dga' ba ster/ /

72yang na khyod gsung ca co mi mnga'i rgyud mangs la/ /tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu mi ldan ci/ /zag med thugs las skyes pa'i mkhyen rab kyis/ /shes bya kun la 'jug cing len par byed/ /yang na tshangs sras zhal gyi ga pur 'dzin pa'i ngos/ /rab skyodwangs pa'i spyan zur rnam mdzes shing / /dmar zhing snum pa'i mchu sgros 'dzum pa las/ /sgra dbyangs snyan 'gyur 'dzoms pa'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /bdun pa yan lag gzugs can ni/ dper na gcig gzugs rab 〉spro ba'i 'dzum zhal rnam mdzes shing / / thugs rje'i nyi ma kun gsal ngos la 'khyams/ /ye shes rang gzugs tshul gyis phrin las kun/ /gzhal yas 'gro la brdal ba'i rnam thar mdzes/ /

73gnyis gzugs ni 'jig rten khams 'dir rnam sprul mang byon cing / /skyes bu gsum la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ /gsung gi 'brug sgras nam mkhas khyon gang zhing / /snying rje'i thugs kyi 'ja' 'od lham mer 'char/ /gsum gzugs ni khyod gsung pi wang rgyud pa gcig pa las/ /legs bshad gser gyi chu bo ya la la/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus gdul bya la btab ste/ /'dren par nus pa rgyal ba'i myu gu kye/ /mtha' dag gzugs ni dbyangs can khyod kyi snying ga'i pad tshal na/ /mkhyen pa'i yon tan bung ba sheg rtsal can/ /snyan 'gyur gsung gi rgyud mang sgrogs pa yis/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyi sbrang char zim zim 'beb/ /

74brgyad pa ldan pa'i gzugs can ni/ dper na rnam dag zhal dkyil nam mkha'i nor bu la/ /smin 'khyog dbang po'i mtshon chas legs klubs shing / /ngag gi rol mtsho rnam par rgyas pa'i dbus/ /ro 'dzin gser mig 'khyil ba kun tu'aphyo/ /yang na zhal gyi thig le chu shel dbang po'i ngos/ /nag cing snum pa'i mig gi ri bong mdzes/ /na bza'i thun mtshams dkyil nas mtshan bzang 'od/ /'phro bas bdag blo'i ku mud rab 〉grol/ /yang na dbyangs can yal ga lnga pa'i me tog rtser/ /rgyud mangs g.yu sbrang myos pas mgrin blu blangs/ /mgor nyal ut+pal gcig du'akhyud pa'i dbus/ /bltar mi mngon pa'i gtsug tor ze'u 'bru mtshar/ /

75lugang na gang sku bo dri dru ma'i 'khri shing 'di/ /lang tsho'i zha lu gsar pa phyogs brasargyas/ /zhal gyi me tog ci gar bzhad gyur nas/ /man ngag 'bras bu sbyin ces mkhas rnams sgrogs/ /dgu pa mi 'os pa'i gzugs can ni/ dper na thags bzang puṇ+ḍa rī kya'i phreng tshogs dbus/ /ro 'dzin chu yi bud shing ldem ldem 'khyug /'khril ldem mig gi rkang drug phur lding can/ / smin 'khyog bskal me 'khrigs pa'i ngos su 'phyo/ /lugang na mig gi chu 'khris rab skyodamar ba'i ngos/ /rdzi ma'i nags klung stug po rab 〉rgyas/ /'dzum pa'i mchu sgros ngur pa sgra 'byin dbus/ /smra ba'i 'bab stegs spu ring kun 〉rgyu/ /

76yang na rgyal yum khyod sku'i 'dab brgya 'bar ba'i rtser/ /mdzes zhal ston zla'i dkyil 'khor rab tshes shing / /mtshan dpe'i rgyu skar srad bur brgyud pa'i phreng / /kun+ta la yi ne'u gsing dkyil na mdzes/ /yang na khyod zhal lo yi shing rta rab bzhad par/ /tshems phreng mar gyi zhal zas rnam par dkar/ /gsung dbyangs dri za'i gling bu bus pa yis/ /sgeg 'gyur mig gi mdong mtha' zlos gar bsgyur/ /bcu pa mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can ni/ dper na mdo sngags 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dbyangs snyan cing / /mkhyen brtse'i chu bdag lha yi phun tshogs 'phel/ /gzugs sku'i chu skyes dre za'i dbyangs 'dems kyis/ /'jig rten khams 'dir thar pa'i dge tshogs bskrun/ /

77yang na nag cing snum pa'i smin 'khyog rab mdzes shing / /mchu yi ge sar sos ku'i thun mtshams g.yo/ /dbyangs can khyod zhal ston zla gsar pa yis/ /mthong thos dran reg skye bo kun yid 'phrog / yang na tshangs sras khyod zhal mkhur chos rab dmar zhing / /mig gi ut+pal en+d+ra nī la mtshar/ /zag med sku yi sa brtol rgyas pa yis/ /gang 'dod skye bo kun la yid dga' ster/ /yang na rab dkar yid 'phrog tshems phreng rnam bkra zhing / /smin ma'i ne'u gseng dga' tshal rab 〉rgyas/ / zhal gyi 'o mtsho chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa yis/ /skal ldan pho mo'i gtsug ldan zlos gar bsgyur/ /

78bcu gcig pa khyad par gyi gzugs can ni/ dper na chu shel dbang po be+eḍūr+ya yi tog /me yi khu ba'i gtsug gi rgyan bkod pas/ /srog chags rol mtsho bsrub pa'i rdugs bral zhing / /lha rnams rgyal mtshan tog gis shis gyur cig /yang na sto 'gro gser gyi nyag thag phreng ba can / /skya rengs nu bo'i mchu sgros rtser ldan pas / /gdengs ka can rnams gtse ba'i skabs bral zhing / /'dagachaṭa tshoṭa rnams dga' ba'i shis pa bsgrub/ /lugang na 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs sor 'phyang 'phrul ni/ /phas rgol mu stegs kla klo'i mgor nyal rtser/ / bkod nas nyan rang kun dga'i rgyal mtshan cher/ /btsugs pas 'dzam gling rgyal bstan khyab gyur cig /

79yang na brgyad gnyis lang tsho ldan pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /thugs kyi ye shes ral gri 'phyar ba na/ / g.yul ngo'i dmag tshogs 'jig pa'i rdugs bral zhing / /skye 'gro'i sems can dga' ba'i shis pa bsgrub/ /bcu gnyis pa 'gal ba'i gzugs can ni/ dper na chu 'dzin tshang tshing khrod du mi rgyu zhing / /mdongs ldan chags pa 'phel ba'i rgyu mi byed/ /smra seng khyod thugs legs bshad dbyar rnga yis/ /bdag gi blo gros nyi ma gsar du skrun/ / yang na rlabs phreng can gyi steng du mi 'phyo zhing / /dkon mchog rin chen nor bu mi blangs pas/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje'i mnyan pa yis/ /sems can sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byed/ /

80yang na gling bzhi grang ba'i sdug bsngal mi sel zhing / /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan khra sbubs 'grol mi byed/ /dbyangs can khyod zhal sna tshogs shing rta yis/ /gdul bya'i nyon mongs dug lnga'i srog rnams 'phrog /yang na srid gsum skye rgu'i srog rnams mi 'phrog cing / /dmyal ba'i sems can khram la mi sbyar la/ /'jam dbyangs khyod sku ma he'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /sgrib gnyis ma rig phung po snyil bar byed/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs can ni/ dper na 'jam dpal dpa' bas lho yi phyogs skyong dang / /phas rgol g.yul las rgyal bas khyab 'jug ste/ /rnam par bkra bas gzi brjid nyin mo'i 'od/ /snyan par grags pas 'chi med lha yi rnga / /

81yang na 'di phyi phan bde grub pa'i dam pa 'di/ /34khas grags kun 04 khyab pas lha khu4myo4 dang / /dri ngad ldang bas ma la ya yi rlung / / legs bshad yongs su rdzogs pas chu shel dbang / /yang na mtshan bzang rnam par bkra bas dbang po'i gzhu/ /ma rig mgo bo gcod pas ral gri ste/ /rdzu 'phrul kun durgyu bas rdo rje'i mchu/ / lta ngan srog rtsa gcod pas be con 'chang / /lugang na gang sku 'gag med 'char bas ro hi ta/ / rang bzhin stong pas sprin bral 'chi med lam/ / thugs rje nye ring mi mnga' pagro'i gnyen/ /zad med blo 'dis chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /

82bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can ni/ dper na yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung gi dbyar rnga la/ /mgrin sngon can gyis rab skyobastod par 'os/ /snyan 'gyur snga na med pa'i ngo mtshar 'di/ /sgra 'dzin dbang po ldan pas nyan par rigs/ /lugang na 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i mkhyen rab gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /thub pa'i dbang po dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyis bsten/ /skyon gyis ma gos rnam par dag pa'i dpal/ /lus can bde bar 'tsho ba'i gzhi ru ngom/ /yang na lha mo'i mkhyen rab ku mud zum pa 'di/ /skal ldan bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pas gyes/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i dri ngad 'thul ba yis/ /raḥyig gnyis pa kun du'akhor ba'i yul/ /

83yang na mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i pad mutsho 'di/ /yid 'phrog ngang pa'i bu mo rtsen pa'i gnas/ /snyan 'gyur blu gar dbyangs kyi ngo mtshar 'di/ /sgra 'dzin rna yi dbang pos gsan par rigs/ /bco lnga pa dpe'i gzugs can ni/ dper na mang thos nam mkha'i glang po 'khrigs pa las/ /bsamya pa'i legs bshad sbrang char nyer phab ste/ / sgos pas blo gsal myu gu rab bzhad pa'i/ / rnam dpyod 'di ni dbyar ku'i dus dang mtshungs/ /yang na smra ba'i khyu mchog gzugs sku'i bkod pa'i mdangs/ /rab du'atsher ba'i 'od stong g.yo ba 'di/ / rnam bkra dbang gzhus 'khyud pa'i zhing khams su/ /snang byed gzhon nu'i dpal 'byor bzhin du mdzes/ /

84kugang na gang sku lang tsho rgyas pa shrī khaṇ+ḍaḥ/ / blo yi shing lo kun dugayo ba'i nyams/ /phan bde'i dri ngad stong gsum gang ba yis/ /ma la ya yi dpal gyi dum bu mtshungs/ /yang na lung rtogs yon tan byur bur gtams pa'i mtsho/ /thugs rje zab yangs gting mtha' kun nas bral/ /lhag bsam nor bu rin chen ldan pa las/ /'gro don rlabs chen gaṅgā 'dzin dang mtshungs/ / bcu drug pa ldog pa can gyi gzugs can ni/ dper na rnam sad tshogs rnams yongs 'du'i dpal 'byor la/ /rtag skyobasten yang thar pa'i dge tshogs dben/ /bdag gis legs bshad man dā ra sten pas/ /gtan gyi bde mchog bla med gang bu rnyed/ /

85 riyang na raḥyig gnyis pas 'dab brgya'i steng du 'phyo/ /bdag gis mkhyen rab 'dab brgya'i khrod du 'khyams/ /de ni mi rtag chos kyi gzhan dbang can/ /khyod ni srid gsum dpal gyi bdag mo yin/ /yang na g.yu sbrang kun 〉sprang rtsi spyod pa yis/ /re zhig myos kyang skad cig nyid la sangs/ /bdag gis blo gros sbrang rtsi spyod pa yis/ /byang chub ma thob bar du yal mi 'gyur/ /yang na gshin rje'i ral gris sems can srog rtsa gcod/ /'jam dpal ral gris nyon mongs srog rtsa gcod/ /de ni dmyal ba'i khams su grags pa tsam/ /gang gi grags pa stong gsum khyon gru gang / /

96bcu bdun pa 'gog pa'i gzugs can ni/ dper na 'jam dbyangs khyod kyi mkhyen rab bsil byed kyis/ /ma rig gzhon nu'i 'dren byed long gyur nas/ /gzhan sde'i dpung gyi snying la bzod dka'i zug /ster phyir mtshan mo'i nor bu gang gis 'grub/ /yang na rab mdzes tshangs sras sku yi sa 'dzin gyis/ /srid gsum dpal gyi phung po ma lus kun/ /zil gyis gnon cing lus can kun gyi yid/ /'phrog phyir sprin gyi so can ci zhig lags/ /lugapar 'di thub pa'i ma chu sgros rba rlabs g.yo ba yis/ /skal ldan sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byed/ /rab thim bar du 'khor bar skye ba'i sgo/ /'gog phyir chu yi 'khri shing ji ltar yin/ /

87lugangange skyon dam pa'i lung rigs ri dwags mtshan ma yis/ /phas rgol mu stegs rnam par sreg byed pas/ /rab dkar bsil ba'i bdud rtsi'i phung po zhes/ /'khor bar grags pa'i gtam 'di rdzun par mthong / /bco brgyad pa mnyam 'jog gzugs can ni/ dper na tshangs sras blo yi bdud rtsi mngar ba yis/ /dran pa myos shing mi rtag lam du thal/ /las ngan bskal pa grangs med bsags pa yis/ /'thung ba'i snod du mi rung ba yi skyon/ /yang na dbyangs can skru yi ston zla gsar pa yis /blo ngan phal cher smag rum gnas su 'thums/ /gdod nas ngar 'dzin blo yis cher bslus te/ /phyi dngos rtag dang bden 'dzin nyid kyi skyon/ /

88yang na ngag dbang lha mo'i zhal gyi steng 'phur gyis/ / rmyongs ldan 'ga' zhig tsha ba'i reg pas gdungs/ /ring nas mi dge'i bya bar cher goms shing / /bsags pa'i las 'bras nus mthu che bas kyang / /yang na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab chu gter spyod pa yis/ /lus can kun gyi lho ba rab du'atshig /sngon nas bden 'dzin srad bur 'jus pa yis/ /chags pas myos shing gzir ba nyid kyi skyon / /bcu dgu pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can ni/ dper na mdzes sdug sku yi lus med khang bzang nas/ /mkhyen brtse chu 'dzin gsar pa'i dbyangs 'dems ma/ /rnam dpyod bde 'thung sor mo g.yo ba yis/ /rgyud mangs dbyar rnga'i tshangs dbyangs drug cu sgrogs/ /

89lugang cad gang gi legs rtogs snang byed sa 'dzin dbang / / shes bya dbang gzhu'i chu bo rab 'khrigs te/ /legs bshad chu 'dzin rab bsgos tshang tshing du/ /skal ldan gar mkhan mdongs mtha' zlos gar sgyur/ /yang na mtsho ldan gzugs sku'i do ra'i skyed tshal nang / /rin che na rgyud mang sa brtol 'dab brgya'i dbus/ /gsung snyan rnga dbyangs rkang drug myos pa'i gdangs/ /dal gyis sgrogs pa'i tshul 'di snying la 'jebs/ /yang na dbyangs can sku yi 'khri shing ne'u gsing du/ /spyan zur chu skyes dpyid dpal rgyas pa las/ /legs bshad sprang rtsi'i dga' ston cha shas tsam/ /thob pa'i blo gsal gzhon nu skal ba bzang / /

90nyi shu pa bston dor gyi gzugs can ni/ dper na gangs ljongs ma yin 'chi med lha yi grong / /thu mi ma yin blo ldan phur bu ste/ /mkhas grub tshogs min legs bris 'dus pa'i dbus/ /rig byed bstan bcos gzhung gi ngo mtshar stsal/ /lugang na rnam par bkra 'di mtshan bzang 'bar ba yi /kha dog ma yin lha rgyal mtshon cha ste/ /rab du'akhrigs 'di smin min ka dam pa/ /snyan 'gyur gsung min dri za'i gling bu'i dbyangs/ / yang na rab dkar khyod sku ma yin sa 'dzin dbang / /chos gos ngur sprig ma yin thun mtshams g.yo/ /gang gi legs bshad ma yin bdud rtsi ste/ /'khri shing ma yin dbyangs can lha mo nyid/ /

91yang na zhal dkyil ma yin 'o ma'i chu yi gter/ /thags bzang phreng ba ma yin ngang pa'i tshogs/ /zhal g.yogs ma yin chu yi 'khri shing ste/ / 'dren byed ma yin spu ring kun dugayo/ /bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan ni/ riṭa dang bya ba yon tan rdzas bzhi po brjod pa'i tshig de tshiṭa bcad gcig la soṭa pa'i ngag de'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung la yod pas ngag yongs rdzoṭa kyi don gsal bar byed nus pa zhigaste/ 'di la nang gses kyi dbye ba bcu gnyis yod pa las/ dang po rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ dper na rnam dpyod rig pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i don/ /ji bzhin legs par gtan la 'bebs byed cing / /log par rtog pa'i skye bo gzu lum tshogs/ /ming gi lhag ma tsam du byed par 'gyur/ /

92kusdong na 'ja ma dpal blo gros thob pa'i skal ldan yid/ /shes byar rmyongs pa'i sgrib gnyis byi dor byed/ /sridagasum dpal gyi phung po ma lus kun/ /de dag zil gyis gnon cing skyengs par byed/ /yang na ye ces spyan gyis shes bya'i dngos kun gzigs/ /rigamed lus can kun la lhag par brtse/ /chosaphung brgyad khri bzhi stong ston byed cing / /sgrigaganyis ma rig mgo bo 'bur ba 'joms/ /lugang na smra se nga dngos zhal gzigs pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /bden gnyis cig car rtogs shing lta ba la/ /'dzin med ngang gis bskyangs pa'i sgom byung 'bras/ /gnas lugs chos skur shar ba'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /

93gnyis pa bya ba thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ dper na rtson no sa mos 'khrigs pa'i ngogs can du/ /dregs ldan ngang pa'i mnyan pa tshogs rnams te/ /gang gi mgrin pa'i ne'u sing nyams dga' bar/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur dbyangs kyi rgyal mos so/ /lugang na rgyu 'o dga' tshal dbus kyi sgra ldan du/ /spung grung gser nya pho mo'i tshogs rnams te/ /gang gi mkhyen rab lha lam yangs pa las/ /lung rtogs yon tan lo yi shing rtas so/ /yang na 'khyams so na kha'i ngos kyi dpyid dpal du/ /ro 'dzin bcud la chags pa'i g.yu sbrang ste/ /legs par rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod khang bzang du/ /legs bshad yon tan shing rta bzang mos so/ /

94yang na sgrog go rlung gi shing rta rab 'khrigs pa'i/ /lha yi rdzing ring ngos su dbyar rnga ste/ / khrod snyoms dbyig gi blo gros ngos su yang / / lus phra 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin glu dbyangs len/ /gsum pa yon tan brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ dper na rab dkar nyid do rgyu skar lam gyi khyon/ /chu shel dbang po cha shas gang ba yis/ /rgya mtsho'i ska rags can gyi ngos su yang / /khor yug sprin gyi so can phreng bas so/ /yang na mthing kha nyid do chu gter 'khrigs pa'i ngos me tog ut+pal gzhon nu gsar pa yis /rnam par bkra ba'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor yang / /mthon mthing zur mig kun zhugayo bas so/ /

95yang na bsil ba nyid do ma la ya yi phyogs/ /lag 'gro'i snying po tshang tshing gtams pa yis/ /yangs dog med pa'i gzhal yas khang bzang yang / /tshul khrims dri ngad ldang ba'i gzugs skus so/ /yang na mdzes so phur byed rab du'akhrigs pa'i dbus/ /cha shas rdzogs pa'i ston zla gsar pa yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i khrod/ /ye shes rang gzugs 'jam dpal dpa' bos so/ /bzhi pa rdzas brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ dper na mgon khyod lung rigs dpal gyis phyug pa'i mthus/ /rgol ngan mu stegs gzhung lugs tshar gcod cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan la spro ba'i skal bzang gis/ /mi phyed dad pa'i shes rab gsar pa slong / /

96lugang na nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan rab 〉'khrigs pa yis /gser gyi snying po'i lo tog rnam par rgyas/ /gtsug phud can rnams 'khrigs pa'i 'dod chags 'phel/ /'jig rten so nam pa rnams dga' ba skyed/ /kunang na dbyangs can khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'bar ba yis/ /lus can rmyongs pa'i sgrib gnyis zil gnon cing / /legs bshad bcud la 'jug pa'i skal ba yis/ /blo gros mig gi sgo 'phar gsar du 'byed/ /lugang na rta bdun dbang po chu 'dzin la bzhon nas/ /rnam par bkra ba'i 'od stong phyogs su 'gyed/ /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan yongs bzhad ku mud 'dzum/ /gling bzhi mun pa'i tshogs rnams drung nas 'byin/ /

97rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ dper na 'khor ba'i bya ba snying po med gzigs nas/ / nges byung bstan pa'i sgor zhugs skyes bu mchog /ris med lus can kun la brtse ba yis/ /legs bshad 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i dpal 'di mtshar/ /yang na spangs rtogs yon tan mthar son byang chub cing / /bdud bzhi g.yul las rgyal la rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sems can kun la brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ /nye ring mi mnga' 'gro gam lus bskyabs/ /yang na srid zhi'i blang dor gnas la ches rmyongs shing / /brkams chags mi dge'i las la rab spro ba'i/ /lta ba log pa'i skye bo kla klo yis/ / sems can srog dbugs gcod la dge bar sems /

98lugang na srab 'jam yangs pa'i 'dab gshog legs ldan zhing / /mchu sgros dmar ba'i 'dab chags skad gnyis pa/ /dkar sngo dmar phreng 'chang ba'i mgrin pa can/ /dga' tshal khrod du rgyu zhing glu dbyangs len/ /bya ba brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ dper na shes ldan rnams la legs bshad zab don dang / /g.yu sbrang rnams la sbrang rtsi mngar ba yis/ /dga' bar byed do ke ke'i sgra can yang / /nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan rab tu'akhrigs pas so/ /yang na 'jig rten rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzi'i grab yis/ /thar 'dod rnal 'byor rnams la dug du'agyur/ /zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yang / /chu shing bzhin du snying po med par mthong / /

99yang na tshangs sras lha mo mtshan bzang dpe byad dang / /'byung po 'dzin ma dpyid dpal sna tshogs kyis/ /sgeg par byas so blo ldan mkhas pa yang / /zad med legs bshad rin chen gter gyis so/ /yang na rgyu skar lam du chu shel dbang po dang / /'jig rten khams su 6spya'i bstan pa yis/ /mdzes par byed do sna tshogs shing rta yang / /rgyan cha nor bu rin chen phreng bas so/ /yon tan brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ dper na gting mtha' bral ba'i rlabs phreng can gyi khrod/ /me tog ut+pal tshang tshing 'khrigs pa ni/ /sngo skyar snang ngo dug chu ha la nag /'thung bas sngon dmar can gyi mgrin pa yang / /

100lugang na rgya mtsho'i ska rags can gyi khyon yangs su/ /rkang 'thung dpyod dpal lang tsho rgyas pa'i mdangs/ /rnam par bkra 'o tshangs sras lha mo'i zhal/ / mjal ba'i skal ldan pho mo'i shes rab kyang / /lugang na kha zheng med pa'i 'chi med lam yangs por /thun mtshams chu 'dzin phreng ba gsar pa'i mdog /dmar 'od nyid do rnam sbyar 'dzin pa rnams/ /'dus pas gser gyi snying po'i ngos su yang / /yang na lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'dab brgya gzhon nu'i rtser/ /kun skyobacud la chags pa'i g.yu sbrang ni/ /nag por snang ngo g.yul ngor zhugs pa yi/ /skyes pa dpa' bo rnams kyi bzhin ras kyang / /

101rdzas brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed ni/ dper na dbu skra lcang lo mthon mthing zur phud kyi/ /cod pan legs par ldan pa'i mtsho byung ma/ /gang 'dul skur sprul chos kun glur len nas/ /skal bzang blo yi 'dod pa ci yang 'jo/ /yang na 'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal bstan legs spel zhing / / snyan ngag mngon brjod smra la zla bral ba'i/ /slob dpon daṇ+ḍis khra ba can gyi ljongs/ /snyan ngag tshig gi do shal phreng bas g.yogs/ /yang na kun gyi yid du 'ong ba dpyid ku'i dpal/ /skye bo sgeg 'chor can rgyu rtsen na yang / /me tog de nyid lhag pa'i lhar dbul na/ /lus can bsod nams grangs med gsog pa'i rdzas/ /

102kusdong na rta ljang dbang po rgyu skar lam gyi rgyan/ /ra hu la yis zas su longs spyad kyang / /'chi bar mi 'gyur 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon/ /rnam par bkra ba'i 'od zer lhag par mdzes /ri gas brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ dper na 'ga' zhig tshe 'di'i bya ba ring spangs nas/ /mi smra dben pa'i nags su brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /la la 'chad rtsod rtsom pas 'gro ba rnams/ /rjes su 'dzin pa de dag gtan gyi mgon/ /yang na chu 'dzin 'khrigs pas char rgyun kun du'athor/ /dbyar rnga sgrog cing mdongs mtha' gar gyis brel/ /lus la tsha gdung reg pa 'phel ba sogs/ /'dod lha'i dpung las gzhan du su zhig mchis/ /

103yang na bdud sde'i dpung tshogs rab 〉mongs byed cing / /skal ldan yid la rnam dpyod gsar du spel/ / mtshan dpe'i 'od 'phro snyan tshig mchog ster ba/ /dbyangs can ngag gi dpal mo las gzhan su/ /yang na tshangs dang brgya sbyin yon mchod 'brel ba dang / /skal ldan 'khor bzang sgo gsum 'dud pa sogs/ /chos phung ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /tshad ma'i skyes bu dag las gzhan du ci/ /bya ba brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ dper na mtshan mo'i nor bus nags kyi ku mud dang / /chu 'dzin phreng bas gtsug ldan chags pa'i khra/ /shākya seṅges chos phung brgyad khri'i sgo/ /shes rab 'khor los blo yi sgo 'phar 'byed/ /

104yang na lo yi shing rtas rgyu skar phreng ba'i tshogs/ /ma la ya yi rlung gis tsha gdungs dang / /gnya' ral can gyis ri dwags 'dus pa'i dbus/ /lha mos mkhas rlom mtha' dag zil gyis gnon/ /kunang na nam mkha'i glang pos sa gzhi'i lo tog dang / /dpyod dpal sbrang rtsis rkang drug bung ba'i lus/ /'dod pa'i mda' yis pho mo'i 'dod chags ro/ /'jam dpal blo yis bdag blo gsar du rgyas/ /yang na nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan 'khrigs pas gru char dang / /mgrin sngon ral pa'i tshogs las gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /zla shel las ni 'chi med bdud rtsi'i ro/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i ngag las legs bshad babs/ /

105yon tan brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ dper na ri bong gzugs brnyan 'chang ba'i chu shel dbang / /me tog puṇ+ḍa rī kus chu gter ngos/ / lang tsho rgyas pa'i mthu yis kho bo yi / /lus dang gdong gi ze'u 'bru rab skyodakar/ /lugang na legs bris dbus na grags pa'i mu khyud dang / /'phags pa'i yul du tsan+d+ra go mi mchog /gangs lcongs skad gnyis smra ba yongs kyi khrod/ /shong ston lo tsā'i rnam dpyod rab dumadzes/ /yang na gnyis skyes skar tshogs bcas pas lha lam ngos/ /dpyid dus rab bsgos skyes kyis sa 'dzin spo/ /gzhon nu'i lang tsho yol ba'i tshon mdangs kyis/ /rgan po'i mgor nyal 'di ni rab skyodakar/ /

106lugang na me zhal la34 la lha rgyal mtshon cha dang / /skyed mos tshal du rma bya'i spu ma dog ste/ /tshangs dbyangs lha mo khyod kyi bzhin ras la/ /rab du'akhrigs pa'i smin ma rnam par bkra/ /rdzas brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed ni/ dper na pu lo ma dgra'i yid dbang 'phrog byed cing / /mthong thos dran reg bsod nams bsag pa'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i ring bsrel mchod sdong grangs med cig /lha mi'i rten du yod pa a sho ka /yang na sprul pa'i tshul gyis 'phaṭa pa'i yul brtol nas/ /zla med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ / cha/ lus thuṭa su chud nas gangs lcongs su/ /sngon med rig lam gsar spel sam d+dha ṭa/ /

107yang na mthong ba tsam gyis yid dga' 'phel byed cing / /lus stobs gzi brjod rlung rta rgud pa'i rgyu/ /don med 'khrug rtsod sdug bsngal mtha' dag gi /gzhi dang rtsa bar gyur pa lus phra 'o/ /yang na mjal mod lus can kun gyi yid 'phrog cing / /zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros 'byung ba'i khungs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes rang gzugs smra ba'i khyu mchog go /yang na 'ga' zhig grong chos byed de 'gro don mdzad/ /la la sgom par brtson zhing dben pa brten/ /gang gi mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo yis/ /tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i glu len zla mdzes ma/ /

108yang na dbu skra lcang lo zur phud lnga g.yo zhing / /shes rab ral sri gleṭa bam phyag gramadzes/ /li khri'i dpal mnga' gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang nas/ /gzhan don mdzad pa 'jam dpal smra seng yin/ /lugang na la la 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gzhan rjes 'dzin/ /khra cig srog gcod sha khrag dmar gyis mchod/ /thad kur 'bras bu sngags kyi lam ston pa/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma ྅byung gnas yin/ /yang na lus kyi tsha gdung reg pa kun 'phrog cing / /nam mkha'i glang po 'khrigs pas char rgyun g.yo/ /gtsug phud can rnams snying la dga' ba'i dpal/ /ster byed kun gsal lam gyi dbyar rnga'i sgra/ /

109gnyis pa phreng ba'i gsal byed ni/ dper na 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thuṭa rjes rgyal ba'i blo/ /rab turgyas shing de yis ji snyed chos/ /des ni gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi thugs/ /des kyang ris med kun la brtse dga'i dpal/ /yang na smug nag tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i chu 'dzin gyis/ /dpyod dpal tsha bas nyog pa'i gdungs ba sel /de yis gser sbrang skom pas gdungs ba'i blo/ /des kyang mgrin pa'i skad kyi rtsa mdud rnams/ /yang na rgyal ba'i ma ma'i spobs pas bdag gi blo/ /rab turgyas des lung rtogs yon tan te/ /des ni 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad gter/ /des kyang lus can kun gyi phan dang bde/ /

110yang na rgyal ba'i rnam thar mthong bas dad pa'i yid/ /rab spya'aphel des rnam dkar dge ba'i son/ /des ni rtogs pa'i myu gu gsar rdol te/ /des kyang ngo mtshar gtan bde'i 'bras bu mchog /gsum pa 'gal don gsal byed ni/ dper na mtshan dpes yongs su 'khyud pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /ngag dbang lha mo'i mdzes sdug mthong ba 'dis/ /ma rig mongs pa'i mun nag 'joms pa dang / /shes bya'i gnas lugs lta ba'i blo mig rgyas/ / yang na tshe 'di'i bya bathams cad blos btang nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su 'khyams pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ri sul 'geng dus nag po bdud kyi phyogs/ / nyams shing dkar phyoṭa lha rnams dar bar byas/ /

111kunang na gdod nas spangs rtogs yon tan rtser son pa'i/ /chos sku'i snang brnyan yid la 'char ba'i mod/ / dkon mchog gsum la dad pa cher bskyed kyang / /'jig rten lha la zhen pa'i rnam rtog yal/ /lugang na snang srid 'khor 'das 'dus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /thub pas rdzun par gsungs pa'i leṭa bshad kyis/ /khro bo'i rnam dpyod myu gu gsar bzhad kyang / /mu stegs lta ba ngan pa phal cher nyams/ /yang na rgyal ba'i bka' bstan shin 〉zab na yang / /'jam dbyangs yid la dran pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /rang gi rdugs zon nang nas chod mod kyi/ /som nyi'i lam du lhung pa'ang mang du snang / /

112yang na thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'khyams na yang / /dge sbyong chen po'i bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyis/ /srid pa'i nor la brkams pa'i blo zad cing / /ma nyam med rgyal sar bgrod pa'i blo gros rgyas/ /bzhi pa don gcig gsal byed ni/ dper na snyiṭa dus mu na sprul byis pa'i blo can 'gas/ /chos min log par g.yem la ches brtson zhing / /sngar med rig lam ngan pa'i srol 'byed nas/ /bstan pa'i dgra ru 'jug la sems 'di skyo/ / yang na 'gro ba'i mgon po bu ram shing pa yis/ /rgyal srid dpal la gshed ma'i tshul mthong zhing / /nges par byung nas lo drug dka' thub spyad/ /bdud bcom mngon par rdzoṭa la e ma mtshar /

113yang na gzhung rig kun la sbyangs pa mthar son kyang / /nga rgyal dreṭa pas mi 'gos khengs bskyungs shing / / gzhan me gus pas gzengs bstod phyoṭa bcur sgroṭa/ /lus can kun gyis bkur ba'i gzhi ru ngom/ /yang na nam mkha'i glang po rab ṣ+pe'akhriṭa pa yis/ /phyoṭa bcu'i rnam dkar snang ba'i go skabs 'phrog /nyi zla skar tshogs bgrod pa'i lam bkag nas/ /gtsug phud can gyi snying la zug rdzu ster/ /lnga pa sbyar ba'i gsal byed ni/ dper na 'dzam gling yongs la 'od zer cher 'phros shing / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog duya mtshan can/ /nam mkha'i nor bu 'phur byed dbus na brjod/ /dge sbyong chen po dad pa rgya mtsho'i ngor/ /

114yang na rnam dkar dge ba'i mthu las rab 'phos shing / /'dod 'jo'i yon tan rdzoṭa pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /sa brtol ljon pa lha yi rgyan du ngom/ /zas gtsang sras po skal ldan 'gro la 'o/ /yang na ngogs can las byung dkyil 'khor ches bkra zhing / /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i 'od kyi rang gzugs can/ /snar ma'i bdag po rgyu skar lam du gnas/ /zla ba'i sring mo kho bo'i yid la 'o/ /lugang na 'phel 'grib g.yo 'gul med par rab brtan cing / /mngon mtho gzi byin phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs rol pa'i mcho yis bskor/ /sa yi tshangs pa mdun na 'don gyis so/ /

115lnga pa skor ba can gyi rgyan ni/ sngar bshad ma thag pa'i gsal byed kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gnas gang rung nyid du don nam tshig gam gnyis ka bzlos te brjod pa ste/ 'di la dbye ba gsum gyi dang po don skor ni/dper na gzhan la 'chadra pa'i legs bshad thos pa dman/ /mkhas par rtsod pa'i kun slong bsamya pa ngan/ /gzhung rig bstan bcos rtsosma pa'i sgos pa chung / / las 'bras log par lta ba'i rnam dpyod blun/ /yang na na phra byis pa'i dus nas bri klog sbyangs/ / pha mas bskul bzhin rig pa'i gnas lnga bslabs/ /bag chags 'jog phyir leṭa sbyar skad la brtson/ /bstan pa slar gso'i sems kyis gzhung luṭa mjal/ /

116yang na grib ma'i lus kyis kun+da'i ge sar bzhad/ /sna tshogs shing rtas pad+ma'i kha sbubs grol/ /sprin gyi myu gus sa gzhi'i lo tog rgyas/ /thub pas u dum wa ra rnam par bye/ /lugang na dbyangs can mgrin par bsten pas yid dga' brtas/ /gzhung rig kun la sbyangs pas spobs pa rgyas / /rtse gcig ting 'dzin grub pas nyams rtogs 'phel/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob la 'gro don che/ /gnyis pa tshig skor ni/ dper na tshe 'dir snyan graṭa 'dod pa'i skye bo rnams/ /yid la chog shes mi bzod gdung ba 'jin/ /'chi khar lus sems so sor bral ba'i tshe / /bu phrug shul du lus pas gdung ba 'jin/ /

117 lugang na rgyal ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi/ /dgongs pa mkhas rlom rnams kyis dpog bzod dam/ /bskal pa'i phreng bar brgyud pa'i skyes rabs rnams/ /snyigs dus skye bo tshogs kyis ci bzod dam/ /yang na rlung gi shing rta rab dugayo ba yis/ /kun gsal ngos su rim gyis 'khrig tshul ston / /'dod pa'i lha yis mda' lnga 'phangs pa yis /gzhon nu pho mo'i snying la 'khrig tshul snang / /pagang na sa bcu'i byang sems 'phaṭa pa'i spyod tshul gyis/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa dgyes pa'i dpyid/ /gzhan sems chos la bskul ba'i leṭa bshad kyang / /bung ba'i sgra sgroṭa tshogs kyis dpa' ba'i dpyod/ /

118gsum pa gnyis ka bskor ba ni/ dper na sa yi tshangs pas gzhan sde 'joms byed cing / /yid 'ong btsun mo'i khrod du dga' mgur spyod/ /rang srog g.yul ngor gcod pa'i phas rgol rnams/ /tshe 'phos lha mo'i khrod du dga' mgur spyod/ /yong na thub pa ma ga d+dha las gshegs pa'i tshe/ / 'khor bzang lnga sde snyim pa zum byed cing / /rtag gragazhan la 'tshe ba'i bdud sde yang / /rngam pa'i ngag dang spobs pa zum par byed/ /yang na lung rigs tshad mas lta ngan tshar gcod cing / /ngur sgrig 'dzin pa rnams la snyan par sgrogs/ /gang gi rtsod lan 'debs pa'i phas rgol yang / /mu stegs rnams la lta bzang snyan par sgrogs/ /

119lugangag skyon dri za'i bu mos nyon mongs 'joms byed cing / /skal ldan skyes bu rnams la brtse bar byed/ /chos kyi gnas lugs sgrib pa'i ma rig pas/ /laru'ibras log par lta la brtse bar byed/ /drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ yul dgag bya gang yang rung ba la de 'gog byed kyi tshig bkod pa bkag pa ste/ 'di la dbye ba nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa las/dang po byung ba 'gog pa ni/dper na pha gcig bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas zhes pa'i ming tsam mi thob pa'i/ /sngon byung gtam 'di shin+tu slu ba'i tshig /'on kyang bla ma'i thugs rje bsam mi khyab/ /

120yang na bcud len ro yi dngos grub thob pa yis/ /ri rab gling bzhi la sogs bskor ba'i tshul/ /ya mtshan sngon byung gtam 'di 'ud che yang / /sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pa bsam las 'das/ /yang na bla ma'i man ngag zab mo sna gcig gis/ /'khor 'das kun gyi chos rnams rtogs 'di rdzun/ /'on kyang slob ma snod dang ldan gyur na/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi rtogs pa su yis dpog /yang na brtan pa'i 'khor los sgra dbyangs ma lus kun/ /cig car gsungs pa'i rnam thar rdzun par mthong / /'on kyang rgyal kun skyed pa'i yab mchog gi /zab gsal myur ba'i mkhyen rab su yis rig /

121 gnyis pa mngon 'gyur 'gog pa ni/ dper na rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig dbyangs can ma/ /rgyud mangs dbyangs su byas pa'i tshul 'di ci/ /gang gi rjes zhugs lus can mtha' yas pa/ /khyod gsung thos pas yid dbang 'phrog par byed/ /yang na rdo rje theg pa'i srog shing pada' byung rje/ /rgyun du phyag la khra ṭam bsnams pas ci/ /bdud dang lha srin 'byung po yod do cog /phyag rgya'i khriṭa mdzub gcig gis bzlog par nus/ /yang na gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang rdo rje rnon po mchog / ral gri mkha' la 'phyar ba'i tshul 'di ci/ /yid kyi dbang po sgrib pa'i nyon mongs kun/ / khyod zhal mthong bas 'joms par ma dgongs sam/ /

12 2lugang na blo yis gzhan yid sel ba'i mtsho byung ma/ /sku la bcos ma'i rgyan chas gsol nas ci/ /gdod nas spros dang bral ba'i chos sku'i ngang / /longs sku'i mtshan dpe yod par ma gzigs sam/ /gsum pa 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa ni/ dper na nges 'byung brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i sdom brtson khyod/ /zang zing nor dang log g.yem la sogs pa'i/ /chos min grabar brtson na sbyin bdag rnams/ /dad log mig gis khyod gzugs mthong mi 'gyur/ /yang na sngon smon mthu las 'dzoms pa'i snying grogs khyod/ /nam zhig gzhan dang dga' mgur spyod pa sogs/ /snang bas mi bzod rang nyid 'chi 'gyur na'ang / /chaṭa pas mig dbang bsgribs nas mthong bar dka' / /

123yang na tshe 'dir 'tsho thabs kho nas yid tshigazhing / /dam chos khral du blta ba'i skye boyis/ /yostan kun gyi 'byung gnas rnam 'dren mchog /phyis nas gser zhal mjal ba'i skal ngasaphra/ /pagang na sa skyong khyod ni tshe 'dir chos brgyad kyi /bya ba khro nar mi tshe g.yeng 'gyur na/ /tshe zad 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba'i dus/ / spyi tshugs ngan 'gror 'jug ba su yis drang / /bzhi pa chos 'gog pa ni/ dper na ci 'jam dbyangs khyod thuṭa rtsub reg bralagayig /ris med kun la blo gros ster de rdzun/ /srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs ma lus pa'i/ /spobs pa lhag ma med par ci'i phyir 'phrog /

124lugang na rnam dkar snang ba'i ston zla gsar pa'i 'od/ /bsil ba'i rang bzhin yin pa slu ba'i tshig /gal te bden na 'dod ldan pho mo yi/ /snying la glo bur tsha bas gzir 'di gang / /yang na bdag cag ston pa bde bar gsheṭa pa yis/ /bya mas brtses 'gro ba bu bzhin skyong de rdzun/ /bden na bdud sde'i dpung tshoṭa rma lus pa/ /cig car bcom pa'i rnam thar graṭa de ci/ /yang na yid 'ong 'jo sgeg nyams ldan tshangs sras ma'i/ /sku la mtshan dpe yongs su rdzoṭa pa yi/ /mdzes chos phun tshogs mnga' ba shin+tu rdzun/ /bden na dpyod dpal mtha' dag ci'i phyir 'phrog /

125lnga pa chos can 'gog pa ni/ dper na tshoṭa gnyis dpal las bltams pa'i dge sbyong che/ /spangs rtoṭa phun tshogs ldan dang mi ldan zhes/ /brjod par dka' ste mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i 'od/ /lham mer tsam las sku nyid mngon sum min/ /lugang na rnam kun rgyal ba skyed pa'i dbyangs ldan ma/ /bdag gis mig sngar mjal lam ma mjal zhes/ /smra bar dka' ste tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i sgra/ /thos pa tsam las chos sku dngos ma yin/ /yang na 'gro kun skyob byed tshad ma'i skyes bu mchog /mnyam med rgyal sar bzhuṭa dang mi bzhuṭa zhes/ /dpag par dka' ste sku yi gzuṭa brnyan tsam/ /snang gi mtshan dpe'i longs sku dngos ma mjal/ /

126yangan 'jig rten byed po nam mkha'i skra can nyid/ /gakho gyi skyabs su 'os sam mi 'os zhes/ /dpyad par dka' ste sngon byung cal sgroṭa tsam/ /rna lam thos kyi dngos su mthong ba med/ /drug pa rgyu 'gog pa ni/ dper na khro chu khol zhing lcaṭa bsregs rab 'bar bar /mdung thoṭa gshin rje'i las mkhan khor yug zhu /bsdigs shing gsod gsod nga ro cher sgroṭa kyang / /mi dge'i las ma byas pas ga la 'jigs/ /lugang na khro bo'i bla mas zhal 'dzum mi ston cing / /'gag med gsung gi snang ba mi stsol la/ /zag med thuṭa rje'i lcaṭa kyus mi 'dren kyang / /dad log nongs pa med pas bdag mi 'gyod/ /

127yang na yud tsam bde ba'i go skabs mi mnga' ba'i/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal shin+tu bzod dka' yang / /mi dge'i las kyi dri mas ma gos pas/ / 'jiṭa pa'i rdugs zon tsam yang bdag la med/ /yang na bzod dka'i lus med me tog mda' lnga yis/ /lus la phog par rdugs pa'i dngangs skrag gis/ /gzhon na phal cher snying rtsa cher g.yos kyang / /༄chags pa spangs pa'i thub pa 'dziṭa re skan/ /bdun pa 'bras bu 'gog pa ni/ dper na yid la mdza' ba'i skyes pa rgyang ring gnas / /dbyar rnga sgrogs shing chu 'dzin nye bar 'ong / /dpyid dpal gzhon nu lang tsho cher rgyas pa'i/ /rnam 'gyur mthong bas bdag shi min pa ci/ /

128 yang na yid dbang sgrigapa'i nyon mongs thag ring bros/ /sa bcu'i rgyal sras rnams kyis nye bar 'khor/ /lha mo'i tshems kyi ze'u 'bru rgyas pa'i tshul/ /mthong bas mkhas pa'i go sa 'thob min ci/ /lugang na don kun grub pa gdod ma'i sa ru gshegs/ /dga'u ba brgya pa'i mda' lnga nye bar 'ong / /lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus phra du ma yis/ /mig zur g.yo bas sdom pa nongs min ci/ /yang na pad+ma 'byung gnas rnga yab gling du gnas/ /mgrin dmar can rnams ca co sgroṭa bzhin 'ong / /dug sprul gcane gzan lus stobs cher rgyas pa/ /nya mthong bas bdag srog mi gcad de ci yin/ /

129 brgyad pa rjes snang 'gog pa ni/ dper na rgyas byed ma khyod yang srid med zhing gi/ / bde ba myang 'dod mchis na myur du bzhud/ /shes bya'i gnas la rmyongs pa'i 'khros chung yang / /khyod dang bral ba'i gdung bas gson mi 'gyur/ /yang na dus gsum cig car gziṭa pa'i rnam 'dren mchog /mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed na de ltar mdzod/ /gang gi chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams/ /bdag po med pas yun du gnas mi 'gyur/ /tsho yang na le lo can khyod nyin mtsha na g.yel med du/ /mal stan bral mi phod na de bzhin gyis/ /rnam dasker leṭa byas phun sum tshoṭa pa'i dpal/ /cha tsam rgyud la 'thob pa'i go skabs dben/ /

130yang na rang rgyud bdud kyis brlams pa'i skye bo rnams/ /log pa'i bshes gnyen 'dod na ci dgar byos/ /yang dag rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu mchog /phyis su 'dren byed lam du mjal bar dka'/ /dgu pa dbang gis 'gog pa ni/ dper na gangs ljongs mun pa'i sgron me srong btsan rje/ /gar byon chos blon 'bangs 'khor bsam mi khyab/ /sku gsung thuṭa kyi mdzad pa'ang de 'dra mod/ /'on kyang ma bskyod e ma chos kyi rje/ /yang na bla ma'i dbang lung man ngag 'thob gyur cing / /dam pa'i chos kyi byin rlabs bsam mi khyab/ /kun la phan bde ster ba'i gzhi ru jom/ /'on kyang mdza' bo rab 〉byung mi 'tshal/ /

131yang na rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs bag yangs shing / /yid la gang 'dod 'byor pa bsam las 'das/ /shing rta bzang mo'i 'dzum zhal bzod dka' yang / /phan bde'i gzhi ma ragatubyung zhig ang / /yang na sna tshoṭa 'phrul 'khor rig pa gsar 'thob cing / /tshe 'dir snyan pa'i grags pa kun tukhyab/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor rnams kyang de 'dra bas/ /'on kyang bu khyod 'gro bar miga'o/ /bcu pa ma gus pas 'gog gni/ dper na bdag ni rnam smin rgyu 'bras leṭa par 'dzin/ /mi dge bcu yi chos la de ltar min/ /groṭa khyod gzhan la 'tshe 'am mi 'tshe yang /kho bo rang gi gnas tshul tsam zhig smos/ /
