132 yang na cho sa kyi gzhi ma bcas khrims mchog 〉'dzin/ /sdom med btsun tshuṭa 'chang ba'i tshul der min/ /sgo gsum leṭa par sdom mam mi sdom yang / /rgyal ba'i gnang bkag chos khrims drang por brjod/ /yang na dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam thar mjal la dga'/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i bya bar de lta min/ /groṭa khyod ngan spyod 'dor len ci 'dod kyang / /rang gi gnas tshul tsam zhig drang por bsnyad/ /yang na chos kyi don bzang sgrogs la mchog spya'adzin/ /ngan gshags 'thab rtsod byed la de ltar min/ /dpyod ldan khyod kyi bsam tshul ci gleng yang / /gdod nas rang gi ngang tshul de ltar lags/ /

133bcu gcig pa shis brjod kyi 'gog pa ni/ dper na mdza' bo rab dubyung na myur du bzhud/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams rtoṭa 'phel gyur cig /ring min gang sku gshegs pa'i gnas de ru/ /bdag kyang 'chi 'pho skye ba len par shog / lugang na tha snyad kun rdzob rig pa gal che na/ /bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing mkhas pa'i rtser son cig /'o cag don dam snying po 'tshol garnams/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par smon/ /yang na groṭa khyod bshan pa'i bya bar 'jug 'dod na / /'gal med rgyal garnams kyis rjes zungs shig /las kyi rnam smin chud mi 'dza' ba'i 'bras/ /rgyud la smin skabs cho nge mi 'don 'tshal/ /

13 yang na tshe 'di'i zhen chags bralabar mi phod na/ /srid pa'i dpal gyi graṭa ga'athob gyur cig /bdag gis chos nyid mngon sum rtoṭa pa'i tshe/ /khyod la 'khor ba'i ngo sprod zhu bar smon/ / /bcu gnyis pa rtsub mos 'gog pa ni/ dper na 'gro ba'i mgon po zhing der gsheṭa bden na/ /nye gnas rnams kyang rjes su bsnyeg 'gyur bas/ /yul 'di'i rten dang bstan pa'i bya ba sogs/ /med pas ngan song gsumalas gzhan du ci/ /yang na mi dbang yul gzhan bskyo da pa'i sta gon 'di/ / yang dag yin na blon po 'i tshogs rnams kyang / /mnyam du 'khrid pas yul 'di'i srung skyob soṭa/ /med pas 'bangs rnams yul gzhan 'khyams par 'gyur/ /

135yang na bslab ldan grong yul 'grim pa bden nyid na/ / khyod kyis 'phyon ma'i gdong la blta bar nges/ /dad sbyin rnams dang bstan pa'i bdag po bcas/ /thuṭa pham dbang gis chu'ingam 'da' bar 'gyur/ /yang na sgo gsum rnam par dag pas gus bzhin du/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i grabar mi brtson na/ /thos ldan yul bzang gzhan du 'gro bar 'tshal/ /phyoṭa bcu'i rgyal garnams kyang mnyes mi 'gyur / /bcu gsum pa groṭa kyis 'gog pa ni/ dper na ngur sgrig 'dzin khyod gnyis sbyor bde bal/ /rol par 'dod na da lta nyid nas mdzod/ /slad nas drang srong chen po'i bka' chad kyis/ /khyod kyi srog la bar chad nges par 'ong / /

136yang na groṭa khyod longs spyod 'dod na 'gangs chen gyi/ /dngos po yod tshad myur du lkog nas 'tshong / /gal te phyis na rgyal po'i bka' khrims kyis/ /'deṭa 'jog g.yo 'gul tsam gyi dbang mi 'ong / /yang na —8ba mchog gzhan gyi chung ma spyod 'dod na/ /myur du byi la'i 'gros kyis 'gro bar 'tshal/ /chaste lus skyed mnal lam sad 'gyur na/ /ngan gshaṭa tshig rtsub khyod kyi rna bar 'ong / / yang na gcung khyod sgo gsum mi dge'i bya ba la/ /sgrobar mthong na re zhig bag yangs byos/ /nam zhig pha ma nye du gcig sgril thog /ngan pa'i tshig gis smod skabs 'dod dbang ci/ /

137bcu bzhi pa 'bad pas 'gog pa ni/ dper na bu khyod dga' bar byed pa'i skyed tshal la/ /kun 〉rtse dgar rol zhes brjod 'dod kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya bar brtson dgos pa'i/ /tshig gzhan dbang med shor bas bdag ci byed/ /yang na rol pa'i gnas la 'char ba'i chu shel dbang / /spyi mthun bsod nams las byung ches bsngaṭa mod/ /'jig rten byed po khyu mchog rgyal mtshan gyis/ /rgya mtsho bsrubs las byung ba'i tshig 'di shor/ /yang na snyigs dus skye bo kun gyi rjes mthun du/ /tshe 'di'i snyan graṭa bsgrub par bya snyam yang / /tshe sngon chos la goms pa'i bag chaṭa kyis/ /phyi ma'i thar lam bsgrub ces kha nas thal/ /

138 yang na sna tshoṭa gzugs kyis ming du gdags pa'i gzhi/ /ma lus cig car gsungs zhes brjod 'dod kyang / /thams cad skad du bden bzhi'i chos ston pa/ /tshad ma'i skyes bur bsngaṭa pa'i gtam 'di shor/ /bco lnga pa gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa ni/ dper na bzhin bzang phyoṭa nas gtan groṭa dgos tshul gyi/ /brtse ba'i spring yig zab mo rlung ltar 'tshub/ /khro bo rang ni 'dod pa'i gzhan dbang can/ /de la khyed rnams bka' dri zhu bar 'tshal/ /yang na bla ma'i zhal nas 'khor ba'i bya'ib rnams/ /spangs nas rab du'abyung zhes nan du bskul/ / bdag ni mi bzod chaṭa pa'i dbang du gyur/ /de nyid gzhan du 'khrid dang bdag kyang 'dod/ /

139 yang na zab gsal myur ba'i blo yis nyon mongs kun/ /rmeg med bcom par chos min ca co sgrogs/ /gzhung luṭa yod du yun ring gnas pa'i 'bras/ /sbyangs pa'i spobs pa de la dre bar gyis/ /kusdong na mgor nyal rab spyadakar ba'i rgan po yi/ /mi tshe'i gtan groṭa chung ma bya dgos na/ /bdag lus mdzes kyang yid kyi gzhan dbang gyur/ /gtso bo sems kyis bzhed na bdag kyang 'dod/ / bcu drug pa thabs kyis 'gog pa ni/ dper na gtan du yid la mdza' ba'i khyim bdag khyod/ /tha dad 'bral ba'i gdung babazod par bgyi/ /ka dam pa dang 'dod pa'i mda' lnga yis/ / lus la zug skyomed pa'i go cha ster/ /

140gugangan tshe 'dir yan lag mchog ldan ma rnams kyi/ /khrod du rtse dgar rol zhing sdod tshugs sla/ /'chi bdag gshin rjes zhaṭa pa dpyangs pa'i tshe/ /gcod pa'i rno ngar ral gri bdag la stsol/ /kunang na rtsod rig shin 〉phyug pa'i rtog ge'i khred/ /mi tshe rtsod par gzhol yang bdag mi 'jiṭa/ /nam zhig lus dang srog gnyis kha bral dus/ /bgrod pa'i thar lam zab mo bstan du gsol/ /yang na tshangs sras lha mo rnam grol zhing mchog zhu /lhag med gsheṭa kyang bdag ni bzod bgyid mod/ /bral med gang sku'i gser zhal thogs med du/ /mjal ba'i mngon shes cung zad bdag la stsol/ /

141bcu bdun pa khro bas 'gog pa ni/ dper na snyiṭa dus lus can kun gyis brda sprod gzhung / /tshe 'di'i lto gos ched du 'bad par nges/ /shin 〉glen pa'i yid kyi kun slong gis/ /brtsams pa'i bya bas mtha' ma rang nyid phung / /yang na zang zing nor la rngam pa'i chos gzugs kyis/ /rtag tubadag 'gro zhes pa'i yus tshig brjod/ /chog med phan sems bral ba'i skye bo khyod/ /ma phyin na yang bstan 'gro'i don chen ci/ /yang na rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu mchog /mdo sngags kun la sbyangs pa mthar son cing / /lha mi kun gyis spyi bor bsngags zin pas/ /deng sang snyigs dus mi la dgos pa ci/ /

142 yang na lung riṭa du mas phyug pa'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /ngag las brda sprod nyan pa'i snyems pa sgroṭa/ /snyan tshig sdeb sbyor tsam zhig mi ldan na/ /tshig gcig ma thos pa dang khyad par ci/ / bco brgyad pa mya ngan gyis 'gog pani/ dper na don gnyer can rnams chos la ma bskul cing / /rang nyid byang chub bsgrub la ma 'bad la/ /gzhan gyis bstod pa'i yul du ma gyur pas/ /lung ma bstan gyi chos pa'i mi tshe zad/ / yang na thar pa'i lam la bgrod pa'i rgyu ma bsags/ / dgra bcom 'phaṭa pa dgyes pa'i las ma byas/ /thub pa'i grub thar ma zhugs gaṅgā 'dzin/ /'khor bar bcings pa'i tshul la kye ma hud/ /

143yang na mi phyed dad pas spyi bor ma mchod cing / /rnyed dka'i dam chos nyams su ma len par/ /mi shes tshoklo tshogs pa'i mun gling nas/ /ston pa zhing der gsheṭa pa'i tshul 'di phangs/ /yang na sri zhus slu med dam pa mchod ma nus/ /lag rkyang rnams la sbyin pa'i char mi phab/ /rang nyid spyad du mi phod 'jungs pa can/ /yi dwags gnas su lhung ba'i tshul la gziṭa/ /bcu dgu pa 'khyod pas 'gog pa ni/ dper na shes bya'i gnas la thos pa ma byas shing / /dge sdig blang dor gnas la bsas ma shes/ /dben pa'i gnas su ting 'dzin ma sgos par/ /kyi ma gshin rje'i pho nya 'gram du bslebs/ /

144lugang na dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa ma bsten cing / /bcas pa'i khrims kyis sgo gsum bsdams ma shes/ /sems ngo 'phrod pa'i man ngag ma thob par/ /rgas shing lus kyi dbang po mtha' dag nyams/ /yang na zla ba'i sring mo'i 'dzum zhal ma mthong bas/ /chos nyid bden pa rtoṭa pa'i blo yis phongs/ /gzhan phan bya gaspu tsam ma grub par/ /mi tshe rdzoṭa pas 'gyod sems stod du 'tshangs/ /yang na nges 'byung sems kyis 'khor ba'i bya ba rnams/ /ma spangs brtse bas pha ma'i zhabs tog med / /'chi khar phan pa'i gdengs tshad ma rnyed par/ /na tshod yol bas gtan don 'phyugs min nam/ /

145 nyi shu pa the tshom gyis 'gog pa ni/ dper na ci 'di brla med ngos kyi mtshams sprin nam/ / yang na rnam 'dren shākya'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /ngur sprig 'dzin rnams spos dang me tog soṭa/ /nam mkhar 'thor zhing 'dud pas mtshams sprin min/ /yang na lta bas mi ngoms 'dzum pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /yar tshes grib ma'i lus sam dbyangs can gyi/ /brtse ba'i zhal gyis gzigs sam 'phyang mo nyug / 'on kyang tshangs dbyangs sgrogs pas ston zla min/ /yang na rtse dga'i 'khri shing gsar par 'o byas pa/ /dngos sam kho bo'i gnyid lam min nam snyam/ /'on kyang lus kyi 'byung bzhi rab 'khrugs te/ /ngal dbugs stod du 'tshangs bas rmi lam min/ /

146yang na yud tsam mig gis mi bzod mtshar sdug 'di/ /'tsher byed yin nam yang na sgyu 'phrul sras/ /sprul skur bzhengs sam bdag yid som nyir gyur/ /'on kyang chos sgra sgrogs pas ri rab min/ /nyer gcig pa sbyar bas 'gog pa ni/ dper na ris med kun la chags sdang sems bral zhing / /gang 'dod yid kyi re ba skong byed pa'i / /shākya'i ljon bzang mi yul bzhuṭa bzhin du/ /lha yi sa brtol ljon pas dgos pa ci/ /yang na gting mtha' mi mngon zab cing rgya che ba/ /ji tsam spyad kyang 'dzad med 'byung ba'i khungs/ /mang thos rin chen 'byung gnas yod bzhin du/ /chu srin 'byung gnas gzhan gyis dgos pa ci/ /

147yang na lta na sdug pa yid dga' 'phel byed cing / /srid gsum dpal gyi phung po ma lus pa/ /'phrog pa'i bzhin gyi zla dkyil yod bzhin du/ /gnyis skyes rgyal pos dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /pagang na mthong bas mi bzod shin skyorno ngar can/ /kun dkris tshoṭa rnams thal bar rlag byed pa'i/ /zla med shes ragaral gyiyod bzhin du/ /bcos ma'i ral gri phal pas ci zhig bya/ /nyer gnyis pa don gzhan 'gog pa ni/ dper na gdod nas sgra dbyangs ma lus rdzoṭa pa'i gsung / /da dung srid gsum sgra dbyangs 'phrog 'di ci/ /'on kyang 'dzam gling mun sel srid pa'i mig /skar tshoṭa 'od rnams ma lus 'phrog la ltos/ /

148yang na las ngan bsaṭa pa'i rdog phres ches lci yang / /da dung mi dger 'bad pa'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /'on kyang rab dulci ba'i khab len rdo/ /lcaṭa zes ma lus 'dzin pa'i tshul la gziṭa/ /yang na mgon khyod 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rtser son kyang / /da dung legs bshad rngam pa'i brel tshab ci / /'on kyang zad med chu srin 'byung gnas can/ /ngoms med chu phran ma lus 'thung la ltos/ /pagang na 'dren khyod lo drug dka' thub spyad na yang / /ngal med chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /'on kyang rgyu skar lam gyi nyi zla zung / /dal gyis ri rab bskor bar ngal dugaci/ /

149nyer gsum pa rgyus 'gog pa ni/ dper na dzi ltar re ba skong ba'i sa brtol khyod/ /sbyin pa po zhes lha mi su yis bsngags/ /sngon bsaṭa spyi mthun bsod nams cher rgyas pa'i/ /mthu las smin pa'i 'bras bu kho nar nges/ / yang na gzhung rig kun la sbyangs pa mthar son cing / /'chad rtsod rtsomapas phyir rgol gnon to zhes/ /rtog ge khyod la mkhas pa su zhig bstod/ /ston pa gzhan gyi bka' drin khro nar zad/ /yang na spangs rtogs yostan srid zhir mngon mtho yang / /de la ya mtshan gsar pa su yis mthong / /rnam dkar tshogs gnyis byang chub lam chen gyis/ /bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu yin phyir bstod pa ci/ /

150 lugang na byams brtses bu bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal sras khyod/ /gzhan don sgrubapa po zhes su yis bsngags/ /sems can kun la pha mar zhen pa'i blos/ /skad cig yid la bzod thub med pa'i phyir/ / bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan ni/ brjod par 'dod pa'i dngos po 'ga' zhig sngon du bkod nas/ de sgrub par byed nus pa can gyi dngos po gzhan zhig 'god pa ste/ 'di la nangagases dbye ba brgyad yod pa las/ dang po kun khyab don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper na mnyam med rgyal bstan zhing sa bsil ldan lcongs/ /dus kyi 'pho 'gyur byung gsu yis 'gog /srid gsum dpal gyi phung po ma lus kun/ /yud tsam mi brtan 'jig pa'i tshul la soms/ /

151yang na dus gsum cig car gziṭa pa'i rnam 'dren mchog nami rtag lam du gsheṭa pa'i snang tshul gzigs/ /dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i 'khor sgyur bcas/ /'dus byas 'jig pa'i chos las 'gong nus su/ /yang na gzhung rig kun la thos bsam cher byas pas/ /'gran zla bral zhing mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur/ /mthun pa'i rgyu rkyen gcig skyotshogs pa las/ /'bras bu 'byung ba dngos po'i gshis luṭa yin/ /yang na mkhas pa'i rol gnas rgyal ba'i bka' bstan yang / /dus kyi 'gyur bas nyams pa'i tshul la ltos/ /rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i dngos po kun/ /mi rtag gzhan dbang yin phyir gzhan du ci/ /

152gnyis pa khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper na rang gi bde don bsgrub la ma dgyes par/ /na ma kun gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub par mdzad/ /srog la 'bab kyang gzhan don mi 'dor ba/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi khyad chos yin/ /yang na stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i rko shi gas/ /nor rdzas ma lus 'bangs kyi ston mor 'gyed/ /sa lam thob pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyis ni/ / gzhan don 'a byung na srog kyang phangs pa ci /yang na rgyal ba'i leṭa bshad zab mo'i bdud rtsi yis/ /skal ldan yid kyi dga' ston 'phel bar byed/ /rlung gi shing rta 'khrigs pa'i sgra brgya pas/ /

153gtsug phud can rnams gar gyis brel tshab gyur/ /yang na sgra dbyangs lha mos lus can ma lus pa/ /rtag duyol med phan bde'i dngos grub stsol/ / tshoṭa gnyis grangs med bsaṭa pa'i dge sbyong yang / /'gro rnams 'dren phyir rdzoṭa sangs rgyas min ci/ /gsum pa sbyar bcan gyi don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper na bcud 'dzin 'bur du rgyas pa'i smin leṭa mas/ /yid kyi shing rta can gyi 'dod pa 'jo/ /dri zhim me tog lam du gzhon nu rnams/ /bgrod par mi 'dod pa ni su zhig mchis/ /yang na ye shes gcig skyobasdus pa'i phung poyis/ /kun la blo yi bdud rtsis tshim par byed/ /

154 blo dang 'tsham par thuṭa rjes legs skyong na/ /bka' dren kun las lhag pa ma yin nam/ /yang na gangs lcongs chos kyi blon po thu mi yis/ / 'gro kun yid kyi sgo 'phar gsar du sdod/ /sngar med rgyal bstan sgron mes mun bsal bas/ /bod kyi thog ma'i mgon po min na ci/ /lugang na ngal ba du mas grub pa'i rnam 'dren khyod/ /'gro ba kun gyi mos pa'i bla na bsgyings/ /mnga' thang rgyas pa'i stobs ldan dgra bo yis/ /sa skyong gzhan rnams zil gyis gnon par byed / /bzhi pa 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/dper na gzuṭa dang mig dbang nyams pa'i 'phaṭa pa lha sa/ /

155 'phaṭa yul mkhas pa kun gyi rnam dpyod 'phrog /sa brtol ljon pa yid dbang mi ldan yang / / mkhar nyal rnams kyi 'dod pa'i re skong nus/ /lugang na skye ba shin spyadaman pa'i zla mdzes mas/ /kun dkris tshoṭa rnams zil gyis gnon par byed/ /'dabastong ldan rdzin khrod las skyes na yang / /sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhuṭa rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog /yang na bu ram shing pa lang tsho rgas na yang / /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las 'dren par byed/ /bem por gyur pa'i gnyis skyes dbang po yis/ /skye dgu rnams kyi yid dbang rab du'agugs/ /yang na sprang 'khyams sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin thos dga' yis/ /

156mkhas grub snyan pa'i graṭa pa phyoṭa bcur brdal/ /dpal gyi dum bu 'khyog 'gros nyer bzung yang / /bcos med lhan skyes dri ngad phyoṭa kun khyab/ /lnga pa mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper na 'gro la phan phyir rdzoṭa 'tshang bya ba'i rgyu/ /kun gyi gzhi ma bcas pa'i tshul khrims zhes/ /bla mas byams brtses sgrogs kyang rna lam du/ /rtsub pa'i lus can rnams kyi sdig 'di 'dra/ /yang na 'a phags bod paṇa grub mkhas dbang du ma yis/ /mdzad pa'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi mngar ba'i ro /myong na khrong du mi chud skyug bro ba'i/ /skal ngan rkang drug rnams kyi las 'di ci/ /yang na rkang gnyis gtso bos 'gro ba'i don dgongs nas/ /

157phan bde'i 'byung gnas slu med dam pa'i chos/ /thams cad skad du bden bzhi'i sgra sgroṭa kyang / /tshig gcig ma thos las ngan 'di ci lags/ /lugang na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dzi bzhin rtogs pa'i blo/ /zad med 'byung ba'i shes ragalha mo yis/ /tshangs dbyangs 'brug ltar sgroṭa kyang snyiṭa dus kyi/ /mi rnams nyon mongs 'phel ba'i tshul 'di ci/ /drug pa 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper na smin legs lang tsho gsar pa'i bzhin ras kyis/ /bdag lus ba spu'i 'khri shing g.yo bar byed/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i ston zla dang / / mtshungs chos 'dra bas rigs pa ma yin nam/ /lugang na bzhin bzang ma yi dga' ba'i bu ga yis/ /

158 dran pa'i poche na nyal ba'i gnyid lam dkrog /ze'u 'bru rgyas pa'i dpyid dpal gzhon nu dang / / mtshungs chos legs par brtags kyang 'gal ba ci/ /yang na rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags pa'i klu sgrub kyis/ / phyi rol rtogage'i rnam dpyod ma lus bsregs/ /chu yi phung po stem pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /rgod ma kha dang mtshungs chos gcig 〉snang / / yang na daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs pa shin 〉nyams ldan gyis/ /mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod myu gu gsar du skrun/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang blo yi bdag nyid can/ /de dang mtshungs chos khyad par ci zhig yod/ / bdun pa 'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper na sna tshoṭa gzuṭa kyis gzhan sems slu mod kyi/ /

159mchog gsum dam pas khram pa ci la byed/ /las 'bras log par lta bas spyod pa'i las/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis 'os sam ci/ /yang na glen pa'i yid kyis pha ma'i klad 'gem mod/ /rnam dpyod ldan pas mtshams med ci la byed/ /sgrib byed mig lhun gzugs kyis spyod pa'i las/ /rta bdun 'od kyis mi 'os pa min nam/ /yang na pha rol dgra bo'i tshig gis snying 'bigs mod/ /yid gcugs byams pa'i gtam gyis ci la khro/ /'od kyi shing rtas sreg par byed pa'i las/ /gangs chu bsil bas de ltar byed 'os sam lugarwarngo skyon nyon mongs can gyis gnod 'tshe byed mod kyi/ /

160 nyams rtogs 'phel bas ngan lan ci la byed/ /phyi rol mu stegs rnams kyiru'ispyod pa'i las/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis mi ring/sa pa min nam/ /brgyad pa mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ dper nu mi sdug bsgoms kyang yul la ② gas 'gyur na / /sgom med skye bos 'dod la cis mi sred/ /lho yi rlung gzhon gsar pas lus 'tshig na / /dmyal ba'i lcaṭa bsres rlung r+ha/sa gdung bar 'os/ /yang na graṭa thob rnams kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad la/ /mnyes par byed na rmyongs pagacis mi 'os/ /dal 'byor thogakyang mi dger ches brtson na/ /dud 'gro glen pas blang dor shes 'os sam/ /yang na tshe gcig thos bsam byas kyang ma shes na/ /

161thos med snyom las can gyis ji ltar rigs/ /bcu gnyis bdag pos mun pa mi sel na/ /ba lang mig la re ba'i go skabs ci/ / lugang na rab 〉byung yang bcas khrims mi ldan na/ /zhen chaṭa khyim bdag rnams kyis ji ltar bsrung / /mkhas pa'i dbang pos nye gnas mi skyong na/ /glen pas gzhan la 'chad nyan smos ci dgos/ /brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan ni/ dpe dang dpe can gyi dngos po gnyis mtshungs par brjod pa'i sgras dngos su zin pa'am/ mtshungs chos kyi sgra dngos su med kyang shuṭa bstan las rtoṭa pa'i sgo nas mtshungs par gyur pa gzhir bzhag nas/ slar yang 'byed byed kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig brjod pas mi mtshungs par ldog pa ste/ 'di la spyir dbye ga

162bzhi las dang po sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can la lnga yod pa'i dang po/ gcig gi ldog pa can gyi dpe ni/dper na brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i sku mnga' mtshan dpes mdze sa /tshangs dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrogs pa'i lha mo dang / /shes rab 'khor lo mtshungs mod tha dad pa'i/ /'byed chos sgra snyan phyag 〉ldan pas so/ /yang na 'chadra pa'i yon tan rtsad pa'i spobs pa dang / /rtogs pa'i nyams snang rtsos pa'i snyan grags kyis/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo thu mir mtshungs gyur kyang / /lcang lo'i zur phud ldan pas rnam par dbye/ / yang na mdzes sdug dri zhim dpal gyis rab phyug cing / /yid la gang 'dod re bskong byed pa'i/ /

163mgon khyod lha yi sa brtol shing mtshungs mod/ /'byed chos na bza' ngur sgrig 'chang bas so/ /lugang na yid 'phrog kun la phan bde ster ba'i gzugs/ /ngag dbang lha mo'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dang / / mtshan mo'i nor bu mtshungs mod khyod kyi zhal/ /smin ma'i ri mo rnam par bkra bas so/ /gnyis kyi ldog pa can ni/ dper na rkang drug myos pa'i skad dang dbyangs can gsung / /snyan 'jebs rna ba'i lam du sgrogs pa ste/ /de ni dpyod dpal gzhon nu'i ngos su dang / /gang gi gsung dbyangs stong gsum khyon grur brdal/ /yang na srid pa'i mig dang tshangs sras lha mo'i zhal/ /mthong bas gzi brjod 'od kyis gdung byed de/ /

164namakha'i nor bus 'dab brgya'i tshal bzhad cing / /ngang pa'i bu mos blo yi sgo 'phar 'byed/ /ste yang na lha yi rnga yab can dang shong ston rje / /gdung sel yid kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba ste/ /go bi dā ra 'chi med dga' tshal dang / /mgon khyod gangs can ljongs kyi khrod du gnas/ /yang nadabyar rnga sgrogs pa'i skad dang 'jam dpal gsung / /snyan brjid 'dzam gling 'ur sgra sgrogs pa ste/ /de ni rgyu skar lam gyi khor yug dang / /khyod gsung srid gsum skye dgu'i rna bar 'jug /gsum pa sbyar ba'i ldog pa can ni/ dper na tshangs sras lha mo khyod dang 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /bsil zer can gyi rjes bzung bdud rtsis tshim/ /

165khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi gter/ / ge sar can ni bung ba myos pa'i rdzas/ /yang na tsen tan rgya mtsho khyod dang brtul zhugs dbang / / dam pa'i chos la 'bung ba'i blo mtshungs kyang / /mgon po khyod ni theg chen lam nas gshegs/ /thos sgrogatso de ni theg dman lam nas rgyu/ /yang na shākya'i khyu mchog khyod dang legs bris gtso/ /yongs 'du shing gi rjes bzung dbul ba sel/ /mgon khyod dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin par brtson/ /stobs ldan dgra bos zang zing nor la 'bad / /yang na mtshan bzang rnam par bkra dang 'od can nyid/ /yid 'ong rnam bkra kun la phan bde ster/ /

166mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid dpal ni khyod gzuṭa la/ /de las gcig shos rgyu skar lam du snang / /bzhi pa 'gog pa'i ldog pa can ni/ dper na ngoms med lus can rnams kyi 'dod pa 'jo/ /lta na sdug cing kun gyis bkur na yang / /bgres rgud mi mnga' gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang ba/ /rgyal ba'i ma mar lus phras 'gran du ci/ /yang na blo mi ldan yang kun gyi yid 'phrog cing / /lhag par dpyid po'i dus su ches mdzes kyang / /gling bzhi mun pa'i sdug bsngal mi sel ba/ /'dab brgyas chu shel dbang por dzi ltar 'gran/ /yang na rtsub reg bral yang nyon mongs srog rtsa gcod/ /blo dang 'tshams par dam chos 'doms byed kyang / /

167spros bral stong nyid don la ma sgom pa/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis khyod la 'gran nus dben/ / yang na dkar gsal dwangs pa'i yon tan cha rdzoṭa kyang / / nag po ra ri'i dri ma ldan pa yi/ / spun zlar grub pa'i gnyis skyes rgyal po yis/ /tsan+d+ra go mi'i thugs la ji ltar 'gran/ /lnga pa gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can ni/ dper na dkar 'jam mdzes sdug mig zur g.yo ldan zhingad /gzhan sems 'phrog pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan mkhar/—kyang/ /ma rig 'dod chags dbang du gyur pa'i phyir/ /stobs med rgya mtsho'i lha mo khyod bas dman/ /yang na dri ngad ldang bas phyogs kun rab 'gengs shing / /kun gyis bsngaṭa par 'os pa'i dpal mnga' yang sto /

168'khyog 'gro can gyis rab du'akhyud pa'i phyir/ / tsan+dan shing de thub pa khyod bas dman/ /yang na zhe sdang drag po'i nga ro cher sgrogs shing / /phas kyi rgol ba rnam par gnon byed kyang / /dud 'gro glen pa yin phyir gdong lnga pa/ /sa skyong rgyal po khyod dang mtshungs pa min/ /yang na dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs rab sgrogs shing / /rnam sad rnams la chos kyi lung ston kyang / /blo ldan ma yin bem dngos yin pa'i phyir/ /shākya seṅge khyod dang tha dad snang / /drug pa rten gyi dbye ba'i ldog pa can ni/ dper na dbyangs can yal ga lnga pa'i rgyud mangs dang / /raḥyig gnyis pa sbrang rtsis myos pa'i skad/ /

169de ni dpyod dpal gzhon nu'i ngos su dang / /sgra snyan dbyangs can dpung pa'i 'dab mar gnas/ /yang na 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i zhale gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /yar tshes namakha'i rna ba 'di nyid kyi/ /'byed chos de ni khyod kyi sku la dang / /shar gyi thig le mkha' la gnas pas dbye/ /yang na ngal bsos po dang ha ri tsan+dan gnyis/ /snga ma lcang lo can gyi pho brang dang / /yongs 'du sa brtol rol gnas 'chi med kyi/ /ji ltar re ba skong ba'i khyad par 'byed/ /yang na rgyal ba'i ma ma khyod kyi tshems phreng dang / /skar ma go la'i bgrod kyi khyad par yang /

170gang gi thaṭa bzang mchu yi sbubs su dang / /gcig shos rgyu skar lam la brten pas so/ /bdun pa dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can ni/ dper na rlabs phreng can gyi gting mtha' gzhal ba'i tshad/ /rig par mi nus 'gro la snying rje dben/ /smra seng thugs kyis chos nyid rjen par gzigs/ /rmyongs pa rnams la lhag par blo gros ster/ /yang na khra ba'i rdul brtsegs ragadudakar ba la/ /mtshan bzang la sogs zur mig g.yo ba yi/ /rnam 'gyur bral zhing tshangs pa'i sras mo yi/ /'dzum zhal rab skyodakar ba nyid kyis brgyan/ /kunang na puṇ+ḍa rī kur ral pa'i lcang lo dang / /'dzum pa'i zhal g.yogs smin legs ldan pa med/ /

171zla ba'i sring mo'i sku yi khyad chos ni/ /mtshan dpe la sogs rgyan cha du mas spras/ /yang na u dum wa rar 'anād pa'i spobs pa dang / /mu stegs rgol bar lhod pa'i nus pa dben/ /bu ram shing pas rtsos pa'i khyad chos ni/ /so skyes rnams kyi blo yi yul las 'das/ /brgyad pa 'byed byed kyang mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can ni/dper na tshangs sras lha mo'i sku yi bkod pa dang / /pad+ma gzhon nu dkar po'i dpal 'dzin te/ /ngang pa'i bu mo theg gsum gdul byas 'khor/ /chu skyes 'di ni g.yu sbrang myos pas spyod/ /yang na 'dzum pa'i zhal dang yar tshes bco lnga'i zla/ /

172dkar mdzes mig la snang bas bde ster mod/ /gdong pa'i dkyil la 'dren byed zung gis mdzes/ /bsil zer dbus na ri bong gzuṭa kyis mtshan/ / yang na rgyu skar lam gyi dbang po'i mtshon cha dang / /mgrin sngon dkar ser dmar ba'i mdangs ldan mod/ rnyi/lha rgyal mtshon cha mi rtag pa yis bcom/ /gtsug phud can 'di dbyar rnga'i skad kyis myos/ /yang na thub pa khyod kyi thugs dang ti ma'i grong / /dri med dwangs shing pha mtha' bral ba ste/ /gang thugs dmigs med snying rjes yongs gang zhing / /ngogs can rin chen nor bu'i gter chen nyid/ /dgu pa mtshungs chos shugs las bstan cing 'byed byed sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can ni/

173dper na mtshan bzang rnam par bkra bas chos sku dang / /chu shel dbang pos rgyu skar lam la mdzes/ /lha mo'i sku ni zur mig g.yo ba dang / /lha yi rdzing ring skad cig 'od kyis spras/ /yang na thig le mchog mas mtho ris gnas bzang dang / /dri bzang khang pas rin chen snying po mdzes/ /sum rtsen gnas ni lha rnams 'byung ba'i khungs/ /nor 'dzin 'di ni lo tog skye ba'i gnas/ /yang na ngag dbang lha mos 'dun pa'i ngos su dang / /sna tshogs shing rtas rol pa'i gnas 'dir mdzes/ /mos pa'i blo 'di legs bshad nor bu'i dpal/ /sdig med gnas 'di longs spyod rgyas pa can/ /

174yang na lo tog phun tshogs gser gyi snying po'i rgyan/ /blo yi rnam dpyod gnyis med thugs kyi rgyan/ /dbyig gi blo gros 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i khungs / /thugs 'di legs bshad mi zad du ma'i mdzod/ /bcu pa rigs mthun ldog pa can ni/ dper na 'dzim bzo'i yal ga lnga pas ma bzos shing / /lha bris mkhan gyis ri mor ma byas pa'i/ /bcu drug lang tsho ldan pa'i dbyangs can gyis/ /srid gsum dpal gyi phung po ma lus 'phrog /yang na zhim mngar khra zas bzang pos mi phan cing / /'tsho byed ma khas pa'i sman gyis ma gsos pa'i/ /gdod nas yun ring 'grogs pa'i chags sdang 'dis/ /blang dor gnas la 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar 'geg /

175yang na phas rgol dgra yi dbang gis ma 'phrog cing / /g.yung po chom rkun jag pas mi rku ba'i/ /zur phud lnga pa'i thugs kyi mkhyen rab 'dis/ /shes bya'i gnas la rmyongs pa'i mun pa 'geg /yang na rtsi yi dbang pos reg bya mi bsil zhing / /ma la ya yi rlung gis skyob min pa'i/ / yid la mi bzod 'dod pa'i tsha gdung gis/ /sred ldan lus phra'i snying la zug kru skrun/ /dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan ni/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad la 'bras bu rang gi rgyur grags pa'i rgyu de bzlog nas rgyu de lta bu med kyang rgyu gzhan cung zad tsam dang 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo srid par ston pa yin la/'di la dbye ba gsum las/ dang po phyi'i rgyu gzhan cung

176 zad ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ dper na ma btab spang sbyongs bde mo rgyas pa'i ngos/ /ma bkod puṣā yi tshom bus mdzes/ /ma blugs sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi dga' ston che/ /sbyin min g.yu sbrang tshogs kyis kun 〉spyod/ /yang na btsugs min ljon shing yal ga phyogs su rgyas/ /bskul ba min yang legs bris lha yi tshogs/ /shes ldan ma yin yid la 'dod 'jo ba/ /yid bzhin nor bu ma yin sa brtol dbang / /yang na ma bkod nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan legs 'khrigs shing / /ma bsags sprin gyi me tog dal rgyun bcas/ /ma bskul skad gsang ldir ba'i dbyar rnga yis/ /mdongs mtha' can rnams dga' ba'i ston mo 'gyed / /

177yang na tshon gyis ma bskus dbyangs can 'dzum zhal dkar/ /rgyan gyis ma brgyan mtshan dpe'i ri mo mdzes/ /bskul ba min yang gsung dbyangs drug cu yis/ /skal ldan tshogs la blo yi ston mo 'gyed/ / gnyis pa nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ dper na ma phyis dkar ba'i mdangs ldan thags bzang dang / /ma bris smin ma'i ri mo rnam par bkra/ /tshon ma 'byug par mchu sgros dmar ba'i mdangs/ / 'di ni lang tsho ldan pa'i mtsho byung ma/ /yang na 'bad pa med pur chos sku lhun gyis grub/ /tsan+dan ma bskus dri ngad kun duldang / / ngo 'dris med kyang skye bo kun gyis groṭa/ /ma sgrub ngag dbang lha mo'i zhin ras snang / /

178yang na bcos min lang tsho lta na sdug pa'i skur/ /ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo rnam par gsal/ /ma mchod zhal 'dzum phyung pa'i lha mo kye/ /skal ldan bu la zag med shes rab stsol/ /yang na dar gyis ma 'thum shin du'ajam pa'i thugs/ /bskrad pa min yang dag pa'i zhing du bgrod/ /'khon min nyon mongs mgo bo gcod byed pa/ /bskal bzang skyes bu dam pa'i spyod tshul yin/ /gsum pa 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam bstan pa'i srid pa can ni/ dper na drangs pa med par chu ter chen po'i dbus/ /ma btab sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rab zhumatshar/ /bsgos pa med par dri ngad ldan pa'i mthus/ /

179ma bskul gzhon nu'i tshoṭa rnams ngang gis 'du/ /yang na bdud bzhi bcom pa med par gtsug tor mnga'/ /bcos pa min par mjug sgro'i ri mo bkra/ /rgyu med rlung gi shing rta 'khon du 'dzin/ /rgyu mtshan med par zlos gar bsgyur la spro/ /yang na chaṭa sdang ma bsgos zur mig g.yo la mkhas/ /mig snon ma bskus ral pa'i lcang lo nag /rin chen rgyan chas med kyang mtshan dpes mdzes/ /gnod sems bral yang nyon mongs rnam par gnon/ /yang na bskul ba min par ri rgyal lhun po skor/ /rgyu mtshan med par yid la zug rdzu skrun/ /tsha reg bral yang 'dod pa'i me ro slong / /

180'tshe sems bral yang pad+ma 'dzum par byed/ /bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po 'ga' zhig yid la bsam par byas nas/de dang chos mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan zhig bsdus pa'i tshul gyis ngag 〉rjod par byed pa de ni bsdus brjod du 'dod do/ 'di la dbye na spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po spyi'i bsdus brjod ni/ dper na ngur sgrig 'dzin pa mtshan dang dpe byad can/ /grib bzhin grolapa'i dge sbyong rnams spangs nas/ /thun mtshamasa'akhyud pa'i ljon shing mgon yin zhes/ /dbyibs la mtshan mar 'dzin pa glen pa'i yid/ /pagang na mi shes ma rig rmyongs pa sel byed pa'i/ /ngag gi dbang phyug sku la ma brten par/ /'khor bar bcings pa'i nam mkha'i skra can la/ /

181bdud kyis brlams pa'i lus can 'ga' zhig mchod/ /kunang na bsam pa'i re ba ji ltar skong byed pa'i/ /shing mchog ha ri tsan+dan mchog dor nas/ /'bras bu'i re ba spangs pa'i skyed tshal la/ /rnam sad 'ga' zhig gdung sel re ba mthong / /yang na mdzes sdug pad+ma'i kha sbubs sgrol byed pa'i/ /rta bdun dbang po'i 'od la ma brten par/ /srog chags srin bu'i kha yi sgron me la/ /dri bzang khang pa 'ga' zhig yongs su rgyu/ /gnyis pa bye brag dbye ba gsum gyi dang po khyad gzhi tha dad khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod ni/ dper na cha shas rdzoṭa pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam bkra bas/ /

182'gro ba kun la phan dang bde bas skyong / /ngo mtshar rmad byung 'od kyi skra can de/ / srid pa'i smag rum 'joms pa'i dpal du shar/ / kunang na bsil zhing dwangs la dri ma med pa yis/ /skye rgu'i lus sems thams cad gtsang bar byed/ /myang na gdung ba sel ba chu bo'i rgyun/ / nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par bdag gis 'thungs/ /yang na reg bya 'jam zhing ze'u 'bru rgyas pa yis /rkang drug bung ba'i lus stobs 'phel bar byed/ /'dab ma rgyas pa'i dpyod dpal gzhon nu 'di/ /khro bos nye bar spyad pa'i dpal du thob/ /lugang na g.yo med rtsa ba brtan cing bsil 'od kyis/ /

183ris med kun gyi tsha gdung 'jil bar byed/ /mngon mtho dri ma spari pa'i ke la sha/ / deng dus gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i dpal du shar/ /gnyis pa khyad chos tha dad dang tha dad min pa'i bsdus brjod ni/dper na rol mtsho las skyes bang rim mngon mtho zhing / /rin chen rdul brtseṭa phreng ba'i dpal dang ldan/ /'pho 'gyur 'phel 'grib mi mnga'i ngo mtshar can/ / zla ba'i ma ma mjal ba'i skal ba bzang / /lugang na rlabs phreng can gyi khyon ni mi chung zhing / /lan tshur bcas shing chu srin 'byung gnas can/ /mi zad rin chen byur bur gtams pa yi/ /chu gter chen bor 'jug pa'i khra rje bzang / /

184yang na mngon mtho shar gyi 'dzin byed rtser 'phaṭa shing / /'phur byed dbus gnas ri bong gzuṭa kyis mdzes/ /mdzes sdug bdud rtsi ldan pa'i bsil zer 'di/ /gdod nas khro bo'i yid la bde ba ster/ /yang na lo 'dab yal ga'i reg bya mi sra zhing / /rnam par bkra ba'i ge sar rgyas pa can/ /yid 'phrog sbrang rtsi'i ro brgya ldan pa 'di/ /g.yu sbrang gzhon nu rnams kyi yid du 'ong / /gsum pa sngon med bsdus brjod ni/ dper na ri dwags mtshan ma'i ra ri dang bral zhing / /nam mkha'i glang pos sgrib par mi nus pa'i/ /kye ma mig gsum pa yi gtsug gi nor/ / 'di ni bdag gi snying la ci yang sdug /

185lugang na 'phel ka can gyi tshogs dang mi ldan zhing / /rab skyomakhregs pa'i shun pa mi mnga' ba'i / /tsha gdung 'phrog pa'i dpal gyi dum bu ni/ /khro bos rtag 〉rtsen pa'i dpal du thob/ /yang na ldan ljin 'dam gyi khrod nas ma skyes shing / /rnyog ma ma 'gos bung bas mi 'khor ba'i/ /mthong ba tsam gyis gdung sel ut+pal tshogs/ / kye ma bag med gnyis 'thung dbang pos bcom/ /yang na mngon mtho gangs ri'i khrod du mi gnas cing / /dregs ldan gzhan gyi klad pa mi 'gems pa'i/ /'jigs pa dang bral gdong lnga'i dbang po ni/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i bdud kyis rnam par bcom/ /

186bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan ni/ yul de dang de'i yon tan la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi chos brjod par 'dod pa de 'jig rten na yongs su graṭa pa'i mtha' snyad kyi 34tshams las brgal bar gyur pa yi ngag sbyor 'ud chen por brjod pa yin ste/ 'di la dbye ba bzhi yod pa las dang po khyad 'phags phul byung ni/ dper na rab skyodakar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan cing / /lang tsho 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i 'dzum dang bcas/ /lha mi'i mgon du bzhugs pa'i 'jam dbyangs rje/ /snang byed 'od stong 'khrigs pa'i phung por 'dres/ /lugang na spangs rtoṭa yon tan phun sum tshoṭa pa'i gnas/ /byang zhing khong du chud pa'i thub dbang gi /mkhyen pa'i rnam dpyod rmad du byung ba la/ /

189 lcags sgrog de ni su zhig gis sgrol nus/ /gsum pa nges pa'i phul byung ni/ dper na shes bya lha lam yangs pa ma lus kun/ /gdod nas cig car rtoṭa pa'i 'jam dbyangs la/ /zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros mi ldan na/ /phas rgol nyon mongs dgra bo ji ltar 'joms/ /yang na mthong thos dran reg skye bo kun gyi yid/ / 'phrog par byed pa'i gshin rje'i sring mo yi/ /sku la rus pa'i sgal tshigs ma mchis na/ /sgreng ste 'gro ba'i don la ji ltar 'byon/ /yang na ston zla'i dkyil 'khor 'od las ches bkra ba'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su 'bar ba'i rten/ /bgres rgud mi mnga'i gzugs sku mi ldan na/ /

190mtshan dpe'i yon tan la sogs ji ltar gnas/ /yang na gang gi mkhyen rab lam la ma chud pa'i/ /zab cing rgyas pa'i shes bya'i chos kyi tshig /ci ste da dung lhag ma yod snyam na/ /thub pa'i mtshan la kun mkhyen ci'i phyir brjod/ /bzhi pa graṭa pa'i phul byung ni/ dper na smra seng khyod thugs spangs rtogs yon tan gyi/ /phung pos legs par gtams pa'i khur gyi ljid / /g.yo med 'degs par bzod pa'i 'gro byed zung / /chag grum skyon gyis ma gos ngo mtshar che/ /yang na rtsub reg bral ba'i zur phud lnga pa yi/ /zab rgyas mkhyen rab rgyu skar lam gyis kyang / /gzhal du med pa gzugs sku phung po'i nang / /

191chud pa'i rten 'di e ma ngo mtshar che/ /yang na chos kyi snying po yig drug yud tsam gcig /bzlas pa'i phan yon gzhal du mi phod ces/ /rgyal bas bsngaṭa kyang stong gsum 'jig rten khams/ /snod gyur tshul la snying nas ya mtshan che/ /yang na gang gi rnam dkar dge ba'i mdzad bzang las/ /rab skyobaskrun pa'i snyan grags phung po che/ /rin chen rdul brtseṭa kyis kyang mi bsgrun pa/ /'deṭa pa'i gdung ba bzod sran che la mtshar/ /bcu gnyis pa rab brtags kyi rgyan ni/ sems dang ldan mi ldan gang yang rung ba'i dngos po de'i dngos kyi rnam pa gzhan du gnas pa'i tshul la/gnas lugs de las rnam pa gzhan zhig skyobasgyur nas

192rab 〉rtog cing sgre brtags nas brjod pa'o/ 'di la dbye ba gsum las dang po sems ldan rab rtog ni/dper na ston ku'i zla bas skyong par byed pa yi/ /ngang pa'i bu mo skyed tshal khrod rgyu zhing / / de yi phyoṭa gyur steng 'thung dkar po rnams/ /gcog cing rmeg med 'joms par dgongs sam snyam/ /yang na mtshan bzang 'od kyis gzi brjod 'phrog pa yi/ /dgra sta'i dum bu gtsug lag khang rgyu zhing / /thub pa'i rjes 'jug 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams/ /rtsod pas pham par 'dod pa min nam snyam/ /yang na dbyar ka rkang drug myos pas 'tshe ba yi/ /gnyis 'thung dbang po dpyod dpal khrod 'jug cing / /

193bung bas zas su spyod pa'i sbrang rtsi rnams/ /'thung ste lhag med gcom par 'dod min nam/ /lugang na chu 'dzin zil pas rlan par byed pa yi/ /'dab chags rgod po skyed tshal khrod rgyu zhing / /de yi nye groṭa 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin rnams/ /rim bzhin gsod par 'dod pa ma yin nam/ /gsum pa bzhin sgra can ni/ dper na zla ba'i 'dzum zer sku la gsol ba bzhin/ /'khril bag ldan pa'i lang tsho rab skyomadzes/ /mkhyen brtse'i mdzad bzang 'gro la brdal ba'i mtha'/ /rgyu skar lam gyi khor yug 'dres pa bzhin/ /yang na gangs ri'i 'od dkar lus la byug pa bzhin/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /

194ri sa med 'gro la shar gamakhyen pa'i blo/ /sna tshogs shing rta'i char rgyun 'beb pa bzhin/ /lugang na lho yi rlung gzhon yid la bskus pa bzhin/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i ba spu 'i 'khri shing ldang / /'dod pa'i yid la re ba skong ba'i rdzas/ /dbyig 'dzin sprul gyi snying po'i char 'beb bzhin/ /lugang na 'khril ldem ci'adzum pa'i 'od dkar snang ba 'dis/ / brtse ba'i dga' ston yang yang rol pa bzhin/ /lta na sdug pa'i lang tsho rgyas pa yang / /rin chen snying po dpyod dpal rgyas pa bzhin/ /snyam sgra can ni/ dper na snyigs dus sems can las ngan mthu che bas/ /rgyal ba'i lugs bzang tshul bzhin mi spyad tshe/ /

195spyi mthun bsod nams las byung nyi zla yang / /skye ba'i tshul gyis gling bzhi skor ram snyam/ /yang na ngur sprig 'dzin rnams 'dod chags shuṭa che bas/ /'dul khrims la soṭa legs par mi srung tshe/ /bstan pa'i bdag po zas gtsang sras po yang / /thuṭa pham dbang gis mya ngan 'das sam snyam/ /yang na 'phaṭa yul tsha ba'i reg byas 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gdungs bas nyen te kho bo'i mgrin mtsho'i nang / /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i blu len bzhin/ /nyin mtshan g.yel med rkyal la rtson nam snyam/ /yang na dad pas lha mor zur mig g.yo ba la/ / phyoṭa bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis gziṭa/ /

196gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang 'phaṭa pa 'jam dpal yang / /khres pa'i tshul gyis thugs brtse dor ram snyam/ /rdugs sgra can ni/ dper na shākya seṅges mkhyen pa'i spangs rtogs chos/ /ma lus gcig skyobasgril te gshegs zin pas/ /skal ldan rnam dpyod phul du byung ba rnams/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gnas med 'khyams par rdus/ /nges sgra can ni/ dper na rnam kun srin bu 'joms kyis leṭa bskyangs pa'i/ /pad+mas sbrang rtsi bung bar sbyin pa'i gtam/ /thos pas ma bzod mdza' ba'i rta ldang can/ /sgra sgrogs gseb nas khros te song par nges /'dra ba ni/ dper na dri med 'od zer stong dang ldan pa yis/ /gsang chen theg pa'i bstan pa gangs ljongs 'dir/ /

197legs par gsal ba'i thugs rje'i khur chen po/ /'degs par ma bzod dbyig 'dzin 'dar ba 'dra/ /min nam gyi sgra ni/ dper na kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sngon med thu mi yis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam dkar dge g.yi/ /chos mtshungs 'dod nas rta bdun 'dir lhaṭa kyang / /'phel 'grib dbang gis skyongs par 'gyur min nam/ /bzhin sgra can ni/ dper na gdod nas 'khrul pa'i bdag 'dzin ma rig pas/ /yid la 'gos pa'i las nyon mthug po'i dri/ / 'o cag rnams kyis bkru bar mi nus zhes/ /dal 'gro thams cad thur du bros pa bzhin/ /yang na nyon mongs dgrar bzung rtag sdod dbyangs can ma'i/ /mtshan bzang 'phur byed 'od rnams yal ba'i tshe/ /

198 sprin gyi lcug ma dang 'grogs dbyar rnga'i skad/ /sgroṭa nas nam mkha'i mtha' kun 'tshol bzhin rgyu/ /yang na las kyis 'khor ba'i le lo'i gti mug gis/ /yid kyi dbang po sgrib pa'i mun pa'i smag /gyid lug rnams kyis sel bar mi nus zhes/ /nyi zla rnam gnyis mkha' la bros pa bzhin/ /yang na yun ring 'grogs pa'i yi sang mdza' bshes la/ /shin dumangon par zhen cing chags pa'i blo/ /snyigs ma'i skye bos spangs par mi nus zhes/ /dam pa thams cad dben par bros pa bzhin/ / gnyis pa sems med rab rtog ni/ dper na 'jam dpal gzuṭa sku snang stong sgyu ma'i gar/ /srid dang zhi ba'i khams su brdal ba'i zlar/ /

199ri bong 'dzin pas khron pa ji snyed kun/ /ga zuṭa brnyan 'bum phrag rnam par 'byed pa 'dra/ /yang na gang sku mtshan dpe'i 'od zer rab bkra bar/ /nyin mor byed pa sems kyis ma bzod nas/ /gling bzhi ri rab har gyis skor byed nas/ /rab skyo'agran pa'i thabs tshul sgrub pa bzhin/ /lugang na gtsug phud can rnams 'khrig pa'i 'dod chaṭa la/ /rol pa'i dga' ston rdzas la rab rtsen par/ /rgyu skar lam gyi chu 'dzin nyer langs te/ /'dod pas ma bzod mig chu shor ba 'dra/ /lugang na yid 'phrog lha mo'i zur mig g.yo ba'i nyams/ /srid gsum skye dgu'i yid la brdal ba'i zlar/ /

200dbang po'i mtshon chas kun gsal lam gyi ngos/ /re mo'i gzugs brnyan rab 〉'char ba 'dra/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan ni/ rgyu gang gis de'i 'bras bu sngar med bskyed pa sa bon lta bu dang / de med na de mi byung ba'i byed pa po gang yin shes par nus pa du ba'i rtags las me yod par rtogs pa lta bu ste/ 'di la spyir dbye ba dngos po dngos med mtshar ba'i rgyu dang gsum/ dang po dngos po'i rgyu la byed po shes byed gnyis kyi dang po byed po la yang 'grubabyed las rgyu gnyis yod pa'i dang po la/ gnyis kyidang po skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu ni/ dper na rig pa'i dbang phyug mtsho byung lha mo yi/ / phul byung mkhyen pa'i ye shes chen po des/ /bdag la shes bya'i chos rnams rto ṭa pa yi/ /zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros ci yang 'phel/ /

201yang na 'dod pa'i spu long mtshan mo'i rlung gzhon gyis/ /cha shas rdzogs pa'i ston zla gsar pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i 'od zer skyod pa 'dis/ /skye bo kun gyi yid la dga' ba skyed/ /yang na gdod ma'i mgon po mi yi shing rta can/ /kun mkhyen chos blon thu mi sam lho ṭas/ /yi ge'i dbyibs dang brda sprod gzhung luṭa kyi/ /snga na med pa'i rig lam gsar du spel/ /yang na dbyangs can yal ga lnga pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /rab dubakra ba'i rin chen be+e ḍūr+ya'i/ /rgyud mang dbyangs su byas pa'i snyan 'jebs 'dis/ /skal bzang spyod ldan rab dga' skyed par byed/ /

202gnyis pa nyams byed kyi rgyu ni/ dper na bdag cag ston pa bde bar gsheṭa pa yis/ /snyigs dus skye bor dam pa'i chos phung gis/ /yi da'ong srid gsum dpal gyi phung po la/ / bden par 'dzin pa'i blo ngan mtha' dag nyams/ /lugajig skyon sgra snyan 'chang zhing rgyud thag rab skyod pa'i/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i tshangs dbyangs drug cu yis/ /rgyu skar lam gyi sna tshogs shing rta rnams/ /yid la khengs pa'i dga' ba nyams par byed / /lugang na 'bras ldan dus su lha lam mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /bsil ba'i bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i 'od dkar can/ /yid du 'ong 'dis 'dod ldan gzhon nu yi/ /snying gi gdung mar brnag dka'i zug kru bskrun/ /

203yang na klu sgrub yab sras gzhung la legs sbyangs shing / /mkhas grub du ma'i thugs rjes nyer zin pa'i/ /mkhyen rab mchog gis chos kun 'bebs pa'i tshe/ /nga 'o snyam pa'i bdag 'dzin phal cher nyams/ / gsum pa rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu ni/ dper na nor bu rin chen brtsegs pa'i khang bzang dang / /dar sna'i gos dang ro brgya ldan pa'i zas/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus phra rnams/ /rab byung rnams la gshed ma'i gzuṭa bzhin snang / /yang na spangs rtogs phun tshogs mnga' ba'i thub dbang dang / /nyan cing gzhan la 'chad pa'i thos sgrog pa/ /sa bcu'i mthar son byang chub sems dpa' bcas/ /mu stegs rnams la blta ba'i dug 〉gyur/ /

204lugang na chags bral zhi ba'i tshangs pa gdong bzhi dang / /shing rta bzang mos bskor ba'i mig stong ldan/ /dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i 'khor sgyur bcas / /rgyal sras rnams la brtse ba'i yul du gyur/ /yang na gang sku'i mtshan dpe rnam par bkra ba dang / /zab rgyas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong can/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes bcas/ /nyon mongs dug gsum bsta ba'i dug 〉gyur/ /bzhi pa thob byed kyi rgyu ni/ dper na thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba thar par bkod 'dod nas/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor ston ku'i sprin 'dra ba'i / /mi rtag nges byung skyo ba'i tshul gyis gdams/ /

205yang na bskal pa grangs med bsod nams bsaṭa pa yis/ /tshoṭa gnyis rlabs chen mtha' dag leṭa bsgrubs pas/ /chos nyid rnal ma'i don la sbyar ba'i blo/ /dka' spyad ngal dub med par lhun gyis grub/ /lugang na na phra gzhon nu'i dus nas thos bsam la /ngal ba dang blangs brtson pa'i leṭa byes kyis/ / mkhas dbang du ma tshoṭa pa'i spyan snga ru/ /gtan du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i skal ba thob/ /yang na mngon mtho'i lam gyi rtsa ba rab bshad nas/ /dam pa'i chos la skul ma cher btab kyang / /dben pa'i nags su bshan pa'i bya ba la/ /zhugs pa'i sta gon ci yang rtsom par mthong / /

206 phyi dus go gshes byed kyirgyu ni/ dper na sngon shing thams cad yal 'dab bral gyur cing / /chu klung khron pa la sogs rim bzhin bri/ /nam mkha'i nor bu brel tshab che ba'i dus/ /bdag kyang me lha'i drung du yan lag brkyangs/ /yang na rta bdun dbang po'i yan lag drod nyams shing / / bsil ba'i reg bya'i lang tsho nge cher 'phel / /rtsi shing nags tshal gser gyi mdog dungom / /khro bo'i lus kyang tsha ba'i gdung ba zhi/ /yang na grib ma'i lus kyi 'dzum zhal ragadwangs shing / /rgyu skar tshoṭa rnams kun gsal lam du brdal/ /g.yu sbrang pho mo glu dbyangs len pa na/ /bdag kyang dbyangs can bos pa'i gdung shuṭa g.yo/ /

207yang na cha shas rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bkra ba yis/ /sngo bsangs lha yi lam gyi mtha' kun sel/ / shākya seṅge mngon /spro ra rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /lha mi thams cad dge ba'i las la 'bungs/ /gnyis pa nang shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ dper na mgon khyod bslab gsum yang dag ldan pa'i tshul/ /lus phras mig zur g.yos kyang mi dgyes shing / /ngan pa'i tshig gis smod kyang mi khre bar/ /bas mtha'i tshal du g.yo med bzhuṭa pas mtshon/ /yang na thub pa'i dbang po rdzogs sangs rgyas nga/'i tshul/ /lha mos dbyangs kyis mchod kyang mi dgyes shing / /bdud kyis mtshon cha 'phen kyang mi khro bar/ /byang chub shing drung mnyam par bzhugs pas mtshon/ /

208yang na mgon khyod tshe gcig gdod ma'i sar gsheṭa pa/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i mkhas brgyas mi rig cing / /grub pa'i rnal 'byor brgya yis mi rtogs pa/ /chos kun mnyam par gziṭa pa'i tshul 'dis dpog /yang na gzhung lugs kun la mkhas pa'i rtser son pa/ /ri ṭa gzuṭa la nga tsho mdzes pas mi dpog cing / /baṅgem pa bzang ngan dbye bas mi shes pa/ /gzhan la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa khro nas mtshon/ /dang po snga na med pa'i byed pa po'i rgyu ni/ dper na lung rtogs ldan pa'i bshes gnyen ma bsten cing / /sems ngo 'phrod pa'i man ngag bcud ma thob/ /mkhas pa'i leṭa bshad gzhung lu ṭa ma sbyangs pas/ /mu stegs ngan pa'i lta log rgyud la bskyed/ /

209kunang na rgyal ba'i gzhung la thos bsam ma byas shing / /phyi nang grub mtha' bzang ngan mi brtag la/ / rang lugs lta ba'i khyad par ma shes pas/ /lung ma bstan du 'khyams pa'i chos pa skyo / /yang na ral pa'i lcang lor mig sman ma bskus shing / /mu tig do shal phreng ba'i rgyan ma 'dogs/ /lang tsho mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur mi bstan pas/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig la bdud rtsir gyur/ /yang na dgra bcom 'phaṭa nga/'i thuṭa rgyud ma zi tshu cing / /dbang lung gdams ngag ngo sprod ma thob la/ /rnam rtog rags pa'i mgo bo ma gcod pas/ /'chi khar re ltos phongs pa'i mkhas pa sdug /

210gnyis pa zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ dper na tshe 'di'i snyan graṭa bsgrub pa'i blo zad cing / /srid pa'i nor la chaṭa pa'i zhen pa 'gags / /mdza' bshes nye du'i phyoṭa la dga' ba nyams/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub la yid dga' byas/ /yang na lus kyi lang tsho'i mdzes garim gyis nyams/ /sgyu rtsal stobs shuṭa la soṭa mthu chung zhing / /'dod pa'i gnas la dga' ba'ang zhi gyur nas/ /'du bral dben pa khro na yid la dran/ /lugang na chaṭa sdang phyoṭa ris zhen chaṭa gting nas chad/ / leṭa nyes shan byed rnam rtog rang mal zhi/ /nga khro snyam pa'i gces 'dzin gshis luṭa yal/ /gzhan don lhun gyis grub la e ma mtshar /

211yang na bsod nams las byung dpal 'byor mtha' dag zad/ /gdod nas mdza' ba'i chung ma tha dad bral/ /zang zing nor la brkams pa'i blo zad pas/ /khyim med rab 〉byung zhing brtul zhuṭa 'chang / /gsum pa phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ dper na dben pa'i brag phug rgyal po'i pho brang min/ /ri dwaṭa pho mo mdun na 'don min cing / /chos kyi gleṭa bam bsaṭa pa'i no rardzas min/ /de phyir ting 'dzin bsgoms pa'i snang ba skyed/ /yang na drang srong lhusgo ba'i tshal 'di skyes yul min/ /gtsug lag khang bzang pha khyim ma yin cing / /mkhas par brtsad cing dres pa ngan shags min/ /de phyir 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i nyams shig shar/ /

212yang na gcig 〉choṭa pa'i bshad grwa 'ching gnas min/ /mkhan po zhal lce gcod pa ma yin cing / /gros bsdur byas pa 'khon pa'i klan ka min/ /de phyir mkhas rlom gnon pa'i nyams snang spro/ /lugang na mtshan dpe'i gzuṭa sku 'dod pa'i phung po min/ /tshang sa dbyangs drug cu bab col blu ma yin/ /'dzum phreng bstan pa gzhan yid bslu phyir min/ /de slad khyod zhal mthong ba'i skal ba bzang / /bzhi pa spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ dper na tshe 'di'i snyan graṭa bsgrub pa'i dpal 'byor la/ /zhen chags skye ba'i blo ngan kun spangs pas/ /don gnyis phun tshoṭa ngang gis leṭa grub cing / /phrin las rnam bzhi rgyas la e ma mtshar /

213yang na zag bcas 'khor ba'i chos la bden 'dzin blo/ /byang sems 'phaṭa pa rnams la yod min pas/ /de phyir de dag rnams kyi thugs rgyud la/ / rnam dkar tshoṭa gnyis rgya mtsho ngang gis 'phel/ /jigangange ces sna tshoṭa thabs kyis gzhan sde 'joms byed pa'i/ / kun slong chos rgyal a sho ka la med/ /de phyir stobs 'byor mnga' thang cher rgyas pa/ /'dzig rten khams su snyan graṭa 'khri shing g.yo/ /lugang na ma brtags bab col smra ba'i nyetsho sa pa'i skyon/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung la yod ma yin/ / de phyir 'gro kun yid kyi zhing sa ru/ /phan bde'i lo tog myu gu gsar du bzhad/ /

214gnyis pa rgyu dngos med kyis 'bras bu dngos med bskyed pa bzlog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu ni/ dper na ngag gi dbang phyug lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /bdag gi mgrin par ma bzhuṭa pa min na/ /lung riṭa du mas phyug pa'i mkhas rnams kyi/ /khrod du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa bral/ /yang na dga' rab dbang phyug me tog mda' lnga po/ /gzhon nu'i lus la ma reg pa min na/ /yid la mi bzod ba spu'i 'khri shing rnams/ /rab dugayo bar byed pa'i chags pa zad / /kugang na sna tshogs mig gis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'khor ba'i 'jiṭa las skyob pa'i mthu med pas/ /gang gi bstan par zhugs pa'i rjes 'jug kun/ /

215 ngan song gsum las thar ba'i go skabs dben/ /yang na spangs rtoṭa yon tan rdzoṭa pa'i rnam 'dren khyod/ /'khor ba'i srid du ma bzhuṭa pa min myo/ / shin 〉skongs pa'i lus can mtha' yas pa /thar pa'i lam sna 'dren pa'i mgon skyabs bral/ /dang po ring 'bras kyi rgyu ni/ dper na gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang rdo rje rnon po yis/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing 'gying pa'i nyams dang bcas/ /nyon mongs g.yul du gsheṭa pa'i gtam thos pas/ /bdag rgyud ma rig rnams kyang gzhan du bros/ /yang na bdag cag ston pa bde bar gsheṭa pa yis/ /mnyam bzhag ngang nas bdud bzhi brlas byas pas/ /ma bcom bdud sde spungs pa'i tshoṭa rnams kyang / /

216brgyal zhing yid la brnag dka'i zug rdzu bskrun/ /yang na srid gsum dpal gyi bdag mo dbyangs can gyis/ /yan lag drug cu skal ldan gdul bya la/ / snyan par sgroṭa pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag nyid kyang / / cho sa kyi gnas luṭa sgrib pa'i mun pa 'gog /yang na mkhas pa'i rgyan mchog klu sgrub yab sras kyis/ /(ke shes chen po'ang rdzas su ma grub ces/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gtan la phab mdzad pas/ /mkhas rlom phal cher yid la bzod med 'khun/ /gnyis pa rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa ni/ dper na dri za'i bu mos tshangs dbyangs sgroṭa pa yis/ /ma rig gnyid sad pa dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor 'das chos kyi gnas luṭa ma lus pa/ /

217cig car rtogs pa'i blo gros ci yang 'phel/ /lugang na ston pa dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren byed du/ /'khrungs skabs srung mas zla bo stobs chung la/ /bsnun pas snying rje skyes dang dus gcig zhu /mtho ris lus rten thob pa'i skal bas sbom/ /lugang na 'phaṭa yul mkhas mchog dpal ldan zla ba yis/ /chos kun rang bzhin med tshul bsgraṭa thos pas/ /mnyam du bdag 'dzin mdud pa'i 'ching ba rnams / /grol ba'i tshul gyis gad rgyangs dbyar rnga sgroṭa/ / lugang na bu ram shing pas bskal pa grangs med du/ /rnam dkar tshoṭa gnyis rlabs chen bsaṭa pa yi/ /mthu las mngon par rdzoṭa dang lhan cig skyo /

218dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zag med ye shes thob/ /gsum pa 'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu ni/ dper na zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros ku mu da'i/ /khra sbubs grol zhing ze'u 'bru rgyas pa'i rjes/ /tshangs sras bzhin gyi ston zla gsar pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor slad nas 'dren byed lam du snang / /lugang na snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /'khrul med ji bzhin khong du chud pa'i rjes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran zla med pa yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa phyis nas mjal/ /yang na 'jam dpal dpa' bos ma rig dmag gi dpung / /gdod nas ming gi lhag mar bcom rjes su/ /rnam par 'gying zhing khro ba'i nyams dang bcas/ /

219ral gri mkha' la 'phyar ba'i tshul 'di ci/ /yang na gtsug phud can rnams 'dod pas yid myos nas/ /ca co sgrogs shing zlos gar bsgyur ba dang / /'khrig pa'i bya ba la sogs rdzogs rjes su/ /chu 'dzin nye bar langs te dbyar rnga sgrogs/ /bzhi pa rigs min gyi rgyu ni/ dper na bgres rgud 'pho 'gyur la soṭa mi mnga' ba'i/ /dbyangu can bzhin gyi shaX 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /rnam dkar gnyis skyes dbang po dang 'groṭa pas/ /skal ldan snyim pa'i ku mud zum 'di ci/ /yang na rgyal bas bcas pa'i tshul khrims dal 'gro yi/ /rgyun bzang bdag gi rgyud la bzhugs pa yis/ /thog med dus nas bsags pa'i las nyon gyi/ /

220mi gtsang 'dam rdzab khron pa skem par byed/ /yang na ris med kun la rang gi bu bzhin du/ /rtag 〉dus las yol med brtse ba'i thuṭa/ /nyin mor byed kyi 'od dang 'groṭa pa yis/ /ma rig 'dab brgya'i mig bu long bar byed/ /kunang na yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal sgo las byung ba'i/ /ngo mtshar leṭa bshad 'chi med bdud rtsi yis/ /deng sang snyigs dus skye bo phal che'i blo/ /rab 〉sreg par byed pa'i tshul 'di ci / /lnga pa rigs pa'i rgyu ni/ dper na mtshar sdug dpal las bltams pa'i zla mdzes ma/ /gdung shugs bos pas thuṭa rje'i rta ljang can/ /shes bya'i gnas la rmyongs pa'i ldong byed smag /

221cig car rmeg med 'joms par byed la dbang / /pagangur skyod daṇ+ḍi'i rnam dpyod lha yi rdzing ring las/ /snyan dber shar gyi zhig le 'di mthong bas/ /skye bo mkhas rlom dri bzang khang pa yi /ngag gi spobs pa zum pa'i mthu la dbang/ /lugang na 'phaṭa yul mkhas dbang phyoṭa kyi glang poyi/ /tshad ma seṅga'i nga ro thos pa'i tshe/ /mu steṭa ston pa gnyis 'thung rgyal po yang spobs pa'i klad pa ma lus 'gem par byed/ /kunang na chos kyi rgyal po sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi /zla med legs bshad g.yi rnga yab can/ /dbul zhing phongs pa'i 'gro balha dang yī /

222kun gyi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal la dbang / /bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan ni/ nang gi bsam pa go bar byed pa'i don du blos dpyad pa sngon du btang nas de mthun gyi brda zur tsam ston pa dang / blo sngon du ma btang yang phyi'i lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur tsam las nang sems kyi 'gyu ba mtshon nus pa'o/ 'di la dbyeb gnyis las dang po zur gyi phra mo ni/ dper na lang tsho rab 〉rgyas pa'i bzhin bzang mas/ /gcig ta'agroṭa pa'i gtam 'di mdza' bo la/ /tshoṭa pa'i dbus su brjod du ma phod pas/ /kun+da'i me tog rkang gcig bzhag nas song / /lugang na bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan ji 'dra zhes/ /nga rgyal dbang gis 'dri bar ma phod pa'i/ /

223som nyir gyur pa'i yid de mkhas pa yis / /rig nas phyag gi mdzub mo rgya mtshor gtad/ /yang na nyon mongs 'joms pa'i gnyen po su yin snyam/ /blo rtse gnyis su gyur pa glen pa'i yid/ /thos ldan rnam dpyod phul du byung ba yis/ /mkhyen nas ral gri phyag gis mkha' la 'phyar/ /lugang na phas rgol 'joms pa'i sa skyong thabs mkhas pas/ /mdza' ba'i tshul gyis dgra rnams mgron bos te/ /mtshon cha dgra bo'i mgo la bsnun pa'i brda/ /sha khrag ston mo drongs zhes tshoṭa su brjod/ /gnyis pa rnam pa'i phra mo ni/ dper na bdag gis snyan ngag lam nas bstod pa'i tshig /rtag dudabyangs su sgrogs pa'i dbyar rnga 'di/ /

224mtsho byung lha mos gsan nas 'dzu ma pa'i bzhin/ /rab skyodakar la dmar ba'i 'od mdangs chaṭa/ /kunang na skyed mos tshal du rol pa'i dga' ston la/ /lang tsho'i rnam 'gyur gsal ba da mar ba'i bzhin/ /mdzes sdug lha mo'i rjes song 'dren byed kyis / /mthong nas snying la dam bca'i ri mobris/ /yang na gang gi leṭa bshad yon tan rgya mcho'i gter/ / zad med chos kyi bdud rtsi cha shas tsam/ /myang ba'i mod la bdag lus spu long gi /gos ser g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug ci yang 'dzin/ /yang na snyiṭa dus byis pa'i blo can phal mo cher/ /leṭa bshad chos kyi 'bel gtam smras pa na/ /

225thos pa'i mod la bzhin ras mig sman gyis/ /byuṭa pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur gsal 'di ci/ /bco lnga pa cha'i rgyan ni/ cha'i zol tshig gi dngos po gang gi rang bzhin mi mdzes pa'i rnam pa nges par gsal bar gyur zin pa de bsgribs nas gzhan yin par bcos pa ste/ 'di la phred pa'i cha dang bstod smad kyi cha gnyis so/ dang po phred pa'i cha la yang gnyis kyidang po 'os pa'i cha rgyan ni/ dper na mkhas pa du ma'i khrod du lung rigs kyis/ /rtsod skabs bzhin las krul chu char ltar babs/ /rgyu skar lam gyi rta bdun dbang po yi /'od zer bkra ba'i tsha bas gdungs par shes/ /yang na ngan 'gro g.yang sa'i sdug bsngal dran pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi ba spu'i 'khri shing kun dugayo/ /

226lho phyogs ma la ya yi ri bo las/ /'ong ba'i rlung gzhon gsar pa yin par rig /yang na ngag dbang lha mo'i 'dzum zhal mthong ba'i tshe/ /skal ldan rnam dpyod sngar las rno bar byung / /mdo sngaṭa gzhung luṭa kun la g.yel med du/ /thos bsam sgom par rab skyobartson zhes gleng / /yang na mkhas par rlom pa'i skye bo phal mo ches/ /mang po tshoṭa pa'i dbus su 'chad pa'i tshe/ /rang mtshang gzhan gyis rig par ma bzod pas/ /ldab ldib glo nad yod pa'i ngang tshul byas / /gnyis pa mi 'os pa'i cha ni/ dper na gzhan gyi leṭa byas dpal 'byor phun tshoṭa pa/ /mthong nas skyo ba'i mchi ma zag pa yang / /

227srid pa'i dpal la snying po med pa yi/ /rang bzhin shes pa laṭa mod gzhan du ci/ /lugang na mu stegs ston pa'i rig byed bstan bcos soṭa/ /lta grub rnam par dag la shung pa'i tshig /chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i shes rab mthu/ /gsar du brnyes pa yin par zol gyis bsgraṭa/ /lugang na dam pa khyod kyis shes bya'i chos kun la/ /thoṭa med 'jug pa'i rnam dpyod gas/ra mthong bas/ /yid la sngangs shing ba spu g.yo byed par/ /ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long yin par skad/ /yang na rgyal srid dpal gyi khrod du zas gtsang sras/ /lus nyams snying rtsa la soṭa 'dar ba yang / /

228lus phra'i rgyan 'chang yu la de'i nyis pa yi/ /rang bzhin mkhyen pa nyid las gzhan du ci/ /dang po bstod pa'i cha las smad pa ni/ dper na lhag pa'i bsam pas rang gzhan kun don du/ /bcas pa'i khrims kyis rang gi rgyud btul nas/ /rtag 〉zang bring nor gyi dga' ston la/ /rol pa'i sdom brtson bstan pa'i bdag por 'os/ /lugang na mnyam par 'jog la 4 go bo mi 'khor bar/ /rgyun du 'chad rtsod rtsomal leṭa brtson cing / /snyan graṭa ro la chaṭa pa'i mkhas dbang che/ / sa bcu'i rgyal sras rnam sa kyis bsngaṭa par riṭa/ /lugang na sa skyong khyod kyis lang cho gzhon nu'i dus/ /tha snyad spun rdzob rig pa ma lus kun/ /

229sbyangs shing stobs 'byor mnga' thang cher rgyas nas/ /pha rol rab duganon cing rang phyogs 'dzin / /lugang na sna tshoṭa thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor dbyar gyi gaṅgā ltar/ /bsaṭa nas dga' skyid nyams kyis spyod pa yi/ /snyiṭa dus 'dren pa mchog 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /gnyis pa cha las bstod pa ni/ dper na dben pa'i gnas su sdom bu khro na yis/ /'tsho zhing mnyam par 'jog la brtson dgos zhes/ /tshig btsan rna ba'i bu gar dus kun zhu /gtser ba'i dge ba'i bshes kyis ci zhig bya/ /yang na gdod nas sgrib gnyis spangs pas chos rnams kun/ / lhag med gzigs kyang da dung chog shes dben/ /

230 rnam kun 'gro rnams 'dren pa'i brel tshab can/ /kye ma dge sbyong khyod kyi mdzad tshul ci/ /yang na 'gro ba ma lus thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung / /shes rab ral gris nyon mongs srog rtsa gcod/ /spangs rtogs me yis bdud dpung sreg byed pa'i/ /ngag gi dbang phyug brtse ldan ji ltar yin/ /yang na mang du thos pas sgra 'dzin dbang po 'on/ /bsas zhing 'cha da rtsod rtsom pas sgyu lus nyams/ /'jiṭa med dben pa'i nags su don sgos ste/ /gcig pur sdod pas bstan 'gro'i don chen ci/ /bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni/ brjod par 'dod pa'i dngos po sngon la rab skyobastan pa rnams kyi don de dang 'brel ba'i dpe dang yon tan

231 sogs rim pa bzhin go rim ma nor bar rjes su ston pa ste grangs bzhin zhes kyang bya'o/ dper na khyod kyi 'dzum zhal 'dren byed smin legs rnams / /rab dkar dkyus ring gnag snum g.yo ba yi/ /mdzes chos nya rgyas ut+pal 'khor 'gro yis/ /ma lus brkus par nges so dbyangs ldan ma/ /yang na dus gsum sa bcu'i dbang phyug thams cad kyi/ /'gyur med sku dang 'gag pa med pa'i gsung / /'khrul med thugs rnams rin chen rdul brtsegs dang / /tshangs dbyangs ston zla'i dpal yon 'dzin par nges/ /yang na thub pas drang srong tshi ba'i dga' tshal du/ /'khor bzang rnams la legs bshad stsol ba'i zla/ /sa bla steng gi 'jig rten grong khyer du/ /

232mkhar nyal rnams la phun tshogs 'phel bar byed/ /lugang na bstan pa'i sgor zhugs skal ldan skye bo yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi yon tan rmad po che/ /srid pa'i khams 'dir lha yi rdzing ring dang / /dbyar gyi rnga dang sna tshogs shing rtas mtshon/ /bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan ni/ rgyu gang las dga' ba khyad par can mchog dugyur pa skyes pa'i nyams brjod pa'o/ dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po dngos thob kyi dga' ba ni/dper na e ma rkang gnyis gtso bo rnams kyi gsung / /zab cing rgya che rin chen 'byung gnas la/ /rol pa'i dga' ston gsar pas yid myos pa/ /de 'dra gzhan du 'byung ba'i go skabs ci/ /

233yang na 'gyur med 'greng 'chag nyal 'dug kun spyod rnams/ /bzang ba'i snying groṭa 'gram du bslebs lta bu'i/ /spro nyams ba spu'i 'khri shing g.yo nus su/ / dus las yol med phebs dang bzhin bzang ma/ /yang na leṭa byas dpal las bltams pa'i zla mdzes ma/ /thuṭa brtses mi bzo da bdag mdun gsheṭa mdzad pa'i/ /dga' ba tshad med 'di 'dra sus ster nus/ /da dung lan brgyar phebs dang dbyangs ldan ma / /yang na thos ldan rnam dpyod phul du byung ba yi/ /drung las leṭa bshad blu dbyangs nyan pa na/ /bcos min bdag gi rgyud la dga' ba'i nyams/ /slar yang mjal na 'byung gi gzhan du ci/ /

234gnyis pa gzuṭa brnyan gyi dga' ba ni/ dper na las nyon mthug po'i chu 'dzin gyis bsgribs bdag /dbyangs can mngon sum mjal skal phra na yang / /gang sku'i rnam pa ri mor byas pa'i tshul/ /mthong bas yid la dga' ba tshad las 'das/ /yang na nyin mtshan chu bo'i rgyun ltar lha mo'i bzhin/ /yang yang yid la sgom pas rmi lam du/ /bdag la bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i rnam pa tsam/ /mthong ba'i dga' ba snying khong gting nas rgyas/ /lugang na phul byung mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i chos kyi sku/ /mngon sum dbang pos mthong na smos ci dgos/ /gang gi mdzad bzang skyes rabs rnam thar soṭa/ /thos pas sngon med dga' ba gsar du bskrun/ /

235yang na phan bde'i 'byung gnas bslu med riṭa gsum pa/ /dngos zhal dus kyi bskal bas bsgribs na yang / /'bur du bluṭa pa'i snang brnyan mthong ba yi/ / dga' bas bsam gtan dang po'i bde ba 'phrog /bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan ni/ sgeg pa sogs gang brjod kyang tshig gi nus pan/yed la 'bab pa'am yid du 'ong ba'i nyams dang ldan pa zhig ste/ 'di'i dbye ba brgyad las dang po sgeg pa'i nyams ni/ dper na zhi'achad rtsod rtsom pa'i ngo mtshar mtha' yas shing / /'phaṭa yul mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan klu sgrub kyi/ /gzhung las sems kyi rang bzhi na skye med pa 'i/ /zab rgyas don bzang khro bos rnyed de ci/ /yang na skyon gyis ma gos dpal kun 'dus pa'i sku/ /

236'dren byed lamagyi spyod yul ma gyur pas/ /yid la mi bzod gdung shuṭa bos pa yis/ /'dzum zhal bdag gi skal par thob 'di ci/ / yang na lus can kun la phan bde ster ba'i gzhi/ /mgon khyod skad cig 'bral bar ma bzod pa'i/ /sems kyis slar mjal dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur rnams/ /nam yang mi brjed rnam dkar ci yang skrun/ /yang na na phra'i dus nasalus sems lhan cig zhu /'groṭa pa'i snying mthun skad cig bral na yang / /dga' ba'i rnama'agyur ci yang rtsom pa las/ /slar yang bdag gis rol pa'i dpal du thob/ /gnyis pa rdzob 'phel ba drag shul gyi nyams ni / dper na ye shes kun gyi rang zugs lhag pa'i lha/ /

237khros pa'i rnam 'gyur lta bar ma bzod cing / /shes rab ral gri glog bzhin 'khyug pa'i sar/ /nyon mongs skad cig 'tsho ba'i go skabar dben/ /lugang na snang stong sgyu ma'i gar mkhan pad 'byung rje/ /gtum chen khro rgyal drag po'i skur bzhengs shing / /dpa' lus srid gsum g.yo ba'i mdun sa der/ /bdud sde snying rtsa ma 'dar rang dbang ci/ /lugajig skyon las mkhan gshin rje'i pho nya khor yug zhu /gtum chen 'bar ba'i rngam sgra cher sgroṭa shing / /zhe sdang khro mig phyoṭa bcur g.yo ba'i drung / /lus can skad cig bde ba'i gnas skabs bral/ /yang na bdud kyi mgon po khro gsum 'bar ba'i zhal/ /

238gdangs shing myur bskyod glog gi ro 'dzin g.yo/ / sdang ba'i spyan gsum yon por bltas pa yis 9dam nyams skad cig mche ba'i dus ston byas/ /gsum pa spro ba 'phel ba dpa' ba'i nyams ni/ dper na yi dam lha la gsol ba ma btab cing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa ma bsten la/ / gzhung rig gnas la thos pa ma byas par/ /chos kun lhag med khong du chud de ci/ /yang na sngon tshe mchog gsum dam par ma mchod cing / /lag rkyang rnams la sbyin pa'i char mi phab/ /gzhan phan bya ba spu tsa54 ma bsgrubs par/ /tshe 'dir bde skyid longs spyod ci las byung / /kunang na mgon khyod spros bral stong pa'i chos nyid la/ /

23924nyam par bzhag las snyan graṭa mi mnga' yang / /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rmad po che/ / srid pa gsum du graṭa pa'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /yang na 'gangs chen nor gyis re ba ma skong zhing / /snyan pa'i ngag gis gzhan sems ma bslus la/ /ngal ba drag pos sri zhu ma byas pas/ / mi chen dpon po'i cho lo thob 'di ci/ /ba/zhi pa mya ngan 'phel ba snying rje'i nyams ni/ dper na kuḍam lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin lus phra ma/ /tshod cig dam pa'i chos la mi sems par /kun graganyis sbyor bde la chags pa yis / /sgo med lcaṭa bsres khang par bzod med 'khun/ /yang na dar zab 'phyang 'phrul g.yo ba'i pho brang nang / /

240 ro mchog zas dang yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /gang 'dod longs su spyod pa'i mi'i dbang phyug /dmyal ba'i khro chu 'khol ma ji ltar 'thung / /lugangur skyed khrims 'gal bya bas 34gon skyabs bral ba dag /mgor nyal ba spu gzings shing 'dar ba'i lus/ /thal sbyar gzhan gyi rkang par 'dud byed cing / /dbang med btson rar tshud 'di snying re rje/ /lugang na sngon chad sbyin pa'i mthu las lus rten 'dir/ /zad med dpal 'byor ri rgyal lhun po ltar/ /spungs pa'i 'byor ldan yi dwags bkres skom gyi/ /gnas su lhung ba'i tshul la kye ma hud/ /lnga pa skyug bro 'phel ba mi sdug pa'i nyams ni/ dper na mal stan thog tu'agyel ba'i rgan 'khog rnams/ /

—241dri chen rang mal shor ba snyim pa'i nang / /'tsher cing rang gi mgo dang rkang lag sogs/ /byug nas gyen du 'greng ba'i brel tshab byed/ /lugang na bkres skom zas la rngam pa'i pre ta rnams/ /phan tshun gdong du tshoṭa shing 'thab 'dzing gis/ / mgrin pa'i sha 'bur brtol ba'i rnag khrag rnams/ /zas su skyod pa'i yi dwags skyug re bro/ /yang na sprin nag lta bu'i skra gzings smyon pa yis/ /kun gyi lhag 'phro mi gtsang bor ba rnams/ /nyul zhing gad snyiṭa khrod nas len pa'i zas/ /kha la za zhing lus kyis gar byed do/ /lugang na 'dzig rten byed po nam mkha'i skra can gyis/ /

242'gying pa'i rnam 'phrul sna tshoṭa nyams dang bcas/ /lto 'gro 'chang zhing dur khrod mi thod bzung / /dur sa byug pa'i lus kyis gar la rol/ /drug pa dgod bro 'phel ba bzhad gad kyi nyams ni/ dper na bgrang bya'i na tshod shin turnying pa'i lus/ /nyams shing 'deṭa 'jog g.yo 'gul ma thub kyang / /'dod pa'i 'khri shing bsgrengs dang lhan cig tu/ /nag mo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa gad mo'i gnas/ /lugangur skyed 'chad rtsod rtsom la shin gramakhas so zhes/ /khengs pa ngag gi lam nas brjod pa gang / /gab tshig yi ge'i sdeb sbyor 3 nga ngu tsam/ /bri ba'i spobs med dreṭa ldan zha ga'i yul/ /lugang na rtsa rlung gtum mor gdeng thob spyod tshul gyis/ /

243thor tshuṭa ras rkyang 'chang ba'i rlom ldan rnams/ /bsil ldan dus su mi bzod grang ngar gyis/ /so tham 'dar ba'i tshul la gad mo bro/ /yang na kye ma lang tsho'i 'khri shing smin legs ma/ /khyod kyi mthong ga'i ngos su sngon med pa'i/ /pa yo d+dha ra gsar du 'bur rdol ba/ /'jam pa'i stod g.yoṭa dag gis bskung par mdzod/ /bdun pa ngo mtshar 'phel ba rmad byung gi nyams ni/ dper na dben pa'i bya skyibs rnam rgyal khang bzang dang / / sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor mdzes pa'i lag bzang ma/ /chos kyi rang sgra lha yi rnga chen por/ / gyur pa'i skal bzang 'di 'dra ngo mtshar rmad/ /lugang na mgon po khyed sku rin chen rdul brtseṭa dang / /

244mtshan dpe nyi zla zung gis mgul nas bskor/ /thugs rje bkrin mtshungs med mju ra'i/ /tshal gyur snga na med pa'i ngo mtshar mtho/ /yang na 'dzum zhal 'dren byed lam la dga' ston dang / /rgyud mang snyan 'gyur sgra 'dzin dbang po'i bcud/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje de yang skal ldan gyi/ /snying gi dpal du gyur pa ngo mtshar che/ /lugang na mtshar sdug ngom pa'i gangs ri'i rwa ba yis/ /mtha' nas leṭa par bskor ba'i bod kyi ljongs/ /dag pa'i snang ngor phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /khyad par can gyi zhing du grub pa mtshar/ /brgyad pa 'jiṭa pa 'phel ba 'jiṭa rung gi nyams ni/ dper na thog med dus nas las rlung drag po yis/ /

245khyer zhing 'khor ba'i g.yang sa mtha' med par/ /spyi tshugs thur du lha'i ba'i sngon byung gtam/ /thos na lus can snying rtsa ma 'dar su/ /kunang na bde ba'i go skabs bral ba'i dmyal khams nang / /las kyi rnam smin chud mi za ba'i lus/ /sog les dum bur byas pa'i gtam rgyud tsam/ /gzhan gyis brjod kyang snying la bzod par dka'/ /yang na khro gtum sha dang khrag la brngams pa yi/ /bdud sdes rab tugang ba'i srin gling der/ /'gro na srog la bar chad smos ci dgos/ / cung zad yid la bsams kyang ba spu gzings/ /yang na brtan pa'i 'khor los ral gri rnon po yi/ /

246mtshon chas kun dkris tshoṭa rnams rlag byed pa/ /mthong yang dngos su 'gran par ga la zhig /bsams pa tsam gyis bdud dpung snying rtsa 'gas/ /bcu dgu pa gzi brjod can gyi rgyan ni/ rang nyid gzhan gyis mi brdzi bar mchog dumatho ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa'i tshig ro nyams ldan par brjod pa ste/dper na tshad ma seṅga'i nga ro cher sgrogs pas / /mkhas rlom mtha' dag spobs pa 'dzum byed par/ /'jiṭa par mi 'tshal gang gi zhabs skyes rdul/ /spyi bor len rnams riṭa pas tshar gcod min / /yang na thub pas snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun / /rang bzhin stong par gsungs la 'jiṭa mi 'tshal /bden 'dzin blo ngan spangs pa'i skal ldan la/ /

247zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi mi ster ci/ /lugang na smu ba'i rgyal pos ral gri 'phyar tsam gyis/ /srid gsum nyon mongs rdul du rlag byed par/ /'dzigs skrag mi dgos las can skye bo kun/ /byang chub bar du thuṭa rjes mi 'dzin gang / /lugang na snyan tshig 'dod pa'i me tog mda' lnga yis/ /yan lag mchog ldan rnams kyi snying 'biṭa zhes/ /dga' ston sa gzhi gzhan rnams sngangs mi dgos/ /bdag mdun phebs dang dngos grub stsol bar nges/ /nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ 'dod don dngos su ma brjod par de 'grub pa'i phyir rnam pa gzhan zhig thabs mkhas kyis brjod pa ste/ dper na lang tsho'i dus kyis rab dugadungs pa yi

248smin leṭa ma dang grogs khyod lhan cig tu/ /re zhig dga' spro'i gros mol gnang bar mdzod/ /bdag gis shing tog 'ga' zhig 'tshol du 'gro/ /lugang na rig pa'i gnas lngar sbyangs pa'i thos ldan rnams/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'bel gtam gleng bar byed/ /nges 'byung khyim med rab tubyung ba bdag /rang gi sems la cung zad lta bar bgyid/ /yang na thos bsam mig bu ldong ba'i sdom brtson la/ /sa thob ye shes ldan pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /mchog kyang bslu med dam chos tshig de'i ched/ /bshes gnyen du ma bsten pa'i tshul tsam gleng / /lugang na mal stan nye bar 'dzin pa'i snyoms las mdun/ /

249chos blon sam lho ṭa yi sku tshab sa /sngon med gsar du bkod pa rig gnas gzhung / /nyam/sa med deng mjal skal bzang nyid la bsngaṭa/ /nyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ bya ba 'ga' zhig rtsom pa la rang gi bsod nams kyi stobs las de sgrub byed kyi mthun rkyen 'bad med glo bur du byung ba ste/dper na gzugs mdzes nga rgyal che ba'i zur mig ma/ / tshig 'jam sna tshoṭa zas kyis slu ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la rlung gi shing rta rab 'khriṭa shing / /skad cig yid la mi bzod dbyar rnga sgroṭa / /yang na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas go 'phang bsgrub 'dod nas/ /tha snyad kun rdzob lam la 'bad pa'i skabs/ / sgeg nyams ras rkyang 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /

250 7rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag ma lus sbyin/ /yang na na phra'i dus nas rnam dkar dge ba la/ /rab 〉mos shing rgyal srid la gdung tshe / /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gzhan dbang 'og /'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du 'gro ba mthong / /lugang na bstan la 'tshe ba'i lha srin gdug can rnams/ /dzi ltar 'dul ba'i thabs tshul dran pa'i ngang /rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta pad byang rje/ /sna nga 'a༄sman lam dbang gas kha ba can du gsheṭa/ /nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/ bsam pa'am 'byor pa'i khyad par rgya chen po gong na med par brjod pa ste/ dbye ba gnyis las dang po bsam pa rgya che ba ni/

251dper na bod ljongs mun pa'i khab 'dir sngon med pa'i/ /rgyal bstan sgo 'phar gsar du phye ba'i slad/ /thon mis paṇa chen bsten pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /lus srog yal bar dor nas 'phaṭa yul brtol/ /yang na zla med rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ /'gro mang lnga lam g.yul ngor 'jug spobs pa/ /bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos 'tshe med zhi ba yi/ /ngang tshul gziṭa nas zhi bde'i ded dpon mdzad/ /gugeng na rnam kun gzhu yi thabs tshul sna tshoṭa kyis/ /las 'bras log par lta bas sdang byed kyang / /lus can kun la pha mar zhen pa'i blos/ /ngal ba du mas 'khor ba'i 'dam las 'dren/ /

252 4/nga na rgyal srid dpal la yid rton ma mchis shing / /lhag pa'i bsam pas spangs rtoṭa rtser phyin te/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshoṭa rmeg med bcom na yang / / mu steṭa rgol bas brnyas tshe bzod 'di mtshar/ /gnyis pa 'byor pa rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/ dper na 'jig rten so skye'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams lta na sdug /ye shes phung po rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /ngo bo gcig tu'adres pa'i ngo mtshar brjid/ /lugang na nga/ngas ri rwa bas bskor ba'i zhing khams der/ /rin chen las grub bsam yas gtsug lag gi /bkod dang nang gter sus kyang dpag mi nus / /ngo mtshar lha yi bsti gnas yid du 'ong / /

253lugang na 'chi med lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer dbus/ /bkod leṭa gzhal med khang bzangs rab skyobarjid/ /pu lo ma dgra lha mo 'khor tshogs bcas/ /rtag skyogang 'dod dpal la yang dag rtson/ /yang na rin chen du mas gtams pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /zad med bang mdzod dpal la rtag rol cing / /gzhan la 'dod dgu'i gru char 'bebs byed pa'i/ / mchod sbyin brgya par sa skyong 'gran nus su/ /nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor gyi rgyan ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs yin pa de min zhes bston nas don gzhan chos dang chos can gyi ngo bo cung zad ston pa ste/ 'dir dbye ba gsum las dang po chos la bston dor ba ni/

254da per na gnam bskos shākya'i rgyal riṭa las 'phos pa'i/ /zas gtsang sras pos chos 'khor rnam pa gsum/ /skal ldan rnams la bskor ces rab graṭa pa/ /ma yin rgyal ba'i phrin las grangs las 'das/ /yang na dus gsum cig car gziṭa pa'i drang srong che/ /stobs bcu kho na ma yin srid gsum gyi/ /'gro bkun las rnam par rgyal byed pas/ /stobs kyi khyad par grangs med yod par nges lugang na zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkyus ring 'dren byed zung / /khro nas rab skyomadzes zhes grags pa de/ /ma yin tshems phreng khur tshos dmar ba soṭa/ /mdzes pa'i chos kyi bye brag du ma snang / /

255lugang na bdag nyid chen pos ris med 'gro ba kun/ / skyob ces dam pa rnams kyis cher sgroṭa kyang / /bden min lus can gang la mos byed pa/ /de la skyob byed lha gzhan mang du yod / /gnyis pa yul la bston dor ba ni/ dpe ra na ston dus sngo bsangs lha yi lam gyi ngos/ /cha shas rdzogs pa'i rgyu skar mu khyud 'di/ /kun la bdud rtsi ster ba'i rang bzhin du/ /brjod mod bdag gi tsit+tar zug kru skrun/ /yang na bcu drug lang tsho 'dzin pa'i seṅge rtsen/ /las can rnams la phan bde'i bdud rtsi ru/ /mjal 'di gnas luṭa sgrib pa'i ma rig pa/ /rnams la rtag dugashed ma'i dgra ru snang / /

256yang na lang tsho gsar du rgyas pa'i dpyod dpal 'di/ /rkang drug gzhon nu rnams kyi dga' ston ces/ /kun gyis graṭa kyang 'dod ldan bdag la ni/ /mngon sum yid la mi bzod rlung bar byed/ /yang na rig lam gsar 'byed tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'di/ /thos ldan rab skyodaga' ba'i spyod yul zhes/ /smra bar zad mod bdag gi lha'i sgron mis/ / mthong ba tsam gyis grub pas dga' ba ci/ /gsum pa rang bzhin la bston dor ba ni/ dper na rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog /kun la stsol ba zla mdzes ma zhes bod/ /don du 'di ni ma yin srid gsum gyi/ /spobs pa ma lus 'phrog pa'i chom rkun laṭa/ /

257lugang na rab mdzes 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang sked med ma/ /'dzan pho rnams kyi yid la bde ster ba'i/ / rang bzhin nyid du brjod mod nges don du/ /sems la mi bzod sdug bsngal sna tshoṭa sbyin/ /lugang na lho yi rlung bzhin dga' ba gsar rgyas pa/ /bdud rtsi zag pa'i 'od dkar can zhes 'dod/ /don gyi 'di ni bdag srog rab 'phrog cing / /yid myos dug gi rang bzhin can du mthong / /lugang na sngon gyi gnod sbyin khyod ni 'dod pa'i nor/ /gang 'dod yid kyi re ba skong byed pa'i/ / bdag por kun gyis gleng mod don du sna/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'phrog par byed/ /

258nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/ sbyar ba ni rjod byed tshig gam sgra'i gzugs gcig dang ldan pas brjod bya'i don tha dad pa du ma'i don ston pa can te /'dir dbye ba dgu las dang po tshig tha dad min pa'am gcod mtshams tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/dper na rab dkar dri med dwangs pa'i snying sdug can/ /mthong mod kun la dga' bde'i dpal ster zhing / /gang 'dod re ba skong ba'i bdud rtsi'i char/ /'bebs byed mtsho byung yid kyi dpal du 'jebs/ /lugang nakun dga' pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru las bltams shing / /mi baX/na dgra bgeṭa thams cad dam la btaṭa/ /phan bde'i mdzad phrin rlabs chen spel mdzad pa'i/ /skyes mchog de la bdag cag snying nas 'dud/ /

259yang na dri ma kun bral phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rtag zhugayo ba med cing dpag par dka'/ /'gangs chen nor gyi bang mdzod spyad bya'i yul/ /zla med dpal la kun gyis bsngaṭa par 'os/ /lugang na srid gsum lus can kun gyi dga' ba'i gnas/ /lang tsho'i mdzes pa ngom pa'i gzi brjod kyis/ /dbang med yid kyi shes pa rab 'phrog pa'i/ /dpal gyi bdag nyid kun gyi yid khar 'ong / /gnyis pa tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba ni/ dper na mtha' med sngo bsangs lha lam yangs pa las/ /chu 'dzin dang groṭa ldir ba'i dbyar gyi rnga/ /snyan 'jebs rgyud mang dbyangs su byas pa las/ /dga' bas yid myos skal ldan gar gyis brel/ /

260yang na las kyi rlung 'tshub drag pos rjes 'ded nas/ /dbang med mkha' la shar ba srod ga'i zla/ /mdun blon ngan pas bskul ba'i sa skyong gis/ /rtag skyobazod med 'bangs la cis mi 'tshe/ /yang na phas rgol g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i mthu/ /phun tshoṭa mnga' ba 'chi med dbang po mchog /bdud bzhi bcom zhing spangs rtoṭa rtser son pa/ /stobs bcu'i bdag nyid chen por 'gran du ci/ /yang na lus can spyi mthun bsod nams las byung ba'i/ /gtsug rgyan rol pa'i gnas la rab 'phro ba/ / srid pa'i mig mchog mtha' 'khob mun pa'i smag /cig car 'joms pa'i bdag nyid ngo mtshar che/ /

261 gsum pa bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ dper na yi da'ong zur mig g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can/ /phyi nang thun mong bsten byar gyur pa'i yul/ /ngag dbang lha mo'i tshangs dbyangs drug cu dang / /stobs med mas kyang gzhan yid 'phrog par byed/ /yang na 'khor gyi khrod na gzi brjod mngon mtho zhing / / 'jiṭa med spobs pa'i nga ro cher sgroṭa pa/ /phas rgol rab duganon pa'i rtog ge dang / /gnya' ral can gyis pha rol klad pa 'gems/ /yang na skad cig mi brtan gya gyu'i rnam 'gyur can/ /rtag 〉kun gyi yid la 'dod pa'i gzhi/ /char dus chu klung rab turgyas pa'i skad/ /bu mos mdza' bo bos pa'i gdung shuṭa g.yo/ /

262yang na rab mdzes chu gter las 'khrungs 'dzum 'od 'phro/ /lang tsho'i cha shas rdzogs pa'i bdud rtsi can/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig dbyangs can dang / /mtshan mo'i nor bus 'gro ba'i mun pa sel/ /bzhi pa bya ba 'gal min gyi sbyar ba ni/ dper na 'khrul med yi ge'i sdeb sbyor rnam dag cing / /snyan 'jebs gzhan gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nyams/ /daṇ+ḍi'i legs bshad zab mo thos byas nas/ /kho bos blo gsar dga' ba'i blu dbyangs rtsom/ /yang na yid 'ong chags pa gsar du rab 'phel zhing / /bsil zhing 'jam pa'i reg bya dang ldan pa/ /ma la ya yi rlung gzhon legs jib ste/ / bdag gis dga' ston sa gzhi'i ༷gul nas 'khyud/ /

263yang na mdzes sdug lus kyirnam 'gyur stong ldan zhing / /sgra 'dzin lam du dga' ba'i dpal ster ba/ /sna tshogs shing rta'i mgrin blu thos gyur te/ /zla mdzes ma yi sgra dbyangs yid la 'khor/ /yang na sna tshogs rin chen nor gyi 'byung gnas can/ /gang 'dod kun la sbyin kyang zad mtha' med/ /yongs 'du rol pa'i gnas la mthong gyur nas/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug zhabs la gus pas btud/ /lnga pa 'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba ni/ dper na bri gang bral ba'i yon tan rdzoṭa pa'i mthus/ /phan bde'i 'od zer kun la khyab mdzad pa/ /sna tshogs shing rta ri rababaskor bas brel/ /don kun grub pa g.yo med mnyam par bzhag /

264yang na rnam dkar mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor lta na sdug /lus can kun la bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ba/ /snar ma'i bdag po kun gsal lam du brdal / /ngag dbang lha mo gdod ma'i dbyings su gsheṭa/ /lugang na dri zhim yi snyong lang tsho gsar pa'i gzugs/ /mthong bas lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba can/ /dpyid dpal gzhon nu 'dzin ma'i ngos su 'grengs/ /dga' ston sa gzhi skyes pa'i khrod du nyal/ /yang na spe thon por gnas shing kun gyis bkur ba'i yul/ /leṭa byas yon tan ldan pa'i gnyis skyes dbang / /ngade 'byung gtsug rgyan mkha' la rab turgyas/ /btsang sbra can gyi bram ze rim bzhin nyams/ /
