265drug pa nges pa can gyi sbyar ba ni/ dper na lang tsho'i 'khri shing dang 'brel bcud 'dzin gyis/ /brgyan cing dri ngad ldang ba'i rang bzhin can/ /dga' ba'i pad+ma can gyi chos de nyid/ / bzhin bzang ma yi lus la nges par gnas/ /lugang na yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rgyan gos bzang po yis /leṭa bcos 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin du/ /dus las yol med sgra snyan 'khrol ba de/ /rgyal yum shes rab lha mo kho nar nges/ / yang na skad cig g.yo 'gul mi mnga' klong yangs shing / /dkon mchog rin chen ma lus 'byung ba'i khungs/ /dri med dwangs pa bdud rtsi can gyi chos/ /bdag nyid chen po'i thugs la rab tuganas/ /

266yang na bri gang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzoṭa shing / /kun la phan bde ster ba'i gzhi ru ngom/ /mun pa drung nas 'byin pa'i mthu mnga' ba/ /rdo ji dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma yin su/ /bdun pa nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba ni/ dper na gang 'dod yid kyi re ba skong nus pa/ /lha yi ha ri tsan+dan 'ba' zhig mthong / /'on kyang shākya'i riṭa las rab 'phos pa/ /zas gtsang sras po yod ces tshad du graṭa/ /lugang na dran pa'i ka chen ngal ba'i mthu mnga' ba /smin leṭa 'dod pa'i khron pa las gzhan med/ /'on te yal ga lnga dang gzhon nu yi/ /brla yi 'khri shing 'jam pas ngal bar mthong / /

267yang na lus kyi ba spu'i 'khri shing cig car du/ /g.yo byed dga' ma'i reg bya kho na nyid/ /'on kyang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yid la gsar du dran pa rnams la'ang mthong / /yang na mnyam med zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa la/ /gnod byed dgra bo lhas byin kho na tsam/ / 'on kyang snyiṭa dus skye bo log rtog dang / /'dod pa'i me tog mda' yis 'tshe bar snang / /brgyad pa 'gal min gyi sbyar ba ni/ dper na gtsug phud can 'di yid dga' 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /'gro ba'i bla ma phan bde 'byung ba'i gter/ /gtsug rgyan bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yid du 'ong / /'gyur med 'khor gyi khrod du rab dumadzes/ /

268yang na 'phrog byed pha rol 'joms la dbang mtho zhing / /'gro ba'i tog khyod srid 'dir snyan graṭa mtho/ /sna choṭa gzuṭa can mthu dpal rmad du byung / /mi yi seṅge kun las lhag par brjid/ /yang na dbyangs ldan lus kyi rnam 'gyur rab mdzes shing / /mtsho byung rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bkra/ / mun pa'i dgra bo yol med nges 'phro zhing / /'dod 'jo mchog de skye dgu'i dpal du shar/ /yang na 'gro ba'i sgron me srid gsum dpal du ngom/ /g.yo med zab rgyas rin chen du ma'i mdzod/ /khra lo sgyur pa lhag bsam phan bde'i dpyid/ /mngon par mtho ba gzi brjod lta na sdug /

269dgu pa 'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba ni/ dper na mtsho byung yin kyang ra ri'i gzuṭa dang bral/ /dbyangs ldan yin kyang gzhan yid slu ba med/ /rnam 'gyur ldan yang gzhan la tshul 'chos spangs/ /lha mo yin kyang rigs drug sems can min/ /kunang na ral gri ldan yang gzhan srog gcod mi shes/ /gleṭa bam 'dzin kyang gzuṭa kyi phung po min/ /cha shas rdzoṭa kyang bem po'i skyon mi mnga'/ /mun sel yin kyang chur sgrog zum mi byed/ /yang na skyes dgu'i bdag po yin yang gdong bzhi bral/ /bde byed yin kyang 'phel ka ca na mi mnga'/ /rje bo yin yang bcu gnyis mig mi ldan/ / gzi brjid ldan kyang ku mud zum mi nus/ /

270yang na mgon po yin kyang 'khor ba'i skyon ma mchis/ /mnyam par bzhag kyang rgyud la nyon mongs med/ /phas rgol rab duganon kyang khengs pa bral/ /'dod 'jo yin kyang gtong phod sems dang ldan/ /nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ 'bras bu'i yul can gyi rgyu 'ga' zhig khyad 'phags phyal byung bstan pa'i phyir yon tan rigs bya ba rdzas sogs dngos gang zhig la ched kyis ma tshang ba nyid du ston pa'i ngag ste/ 'dir dbye ba lnga las dang po yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ dper na dge sbyong chen po'i thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /rtsub pa ma yin mkhres min rno ba'ang min/ /de lta na yang bdud bzhi'i dmag gi dpung / /ming gi lhag ma tsam du bcom 'di mtshar/ /

271kunang na klu sgrub yab sras zung gi mkhyen rabamachog /rab 〉tsha ba'i 'khyog 'gro mi ldan cing / /'od zer phyoṭa bcur 'phro ba ma yin kyang / /mu steṭa rgol ba'i rnam dpyod myu gu sreg /yang na thub pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i leṭa bshad 'di/ /mang ra skyur sin dhu skyes soṭa min mod kyi/ / 'gro kun de yi rjes su rab 'tshangs shing / /sgo gsum tshim pa'i tshul 'di e lamatshar /yang na rgyal ba'i gnang bkag tshul khrims bslabapa mchog /khra zas min la sman yang ma yin mod/ /de lta na yang lus stobs cher rgyas shing / /bsod nams gzi brjid 'bar ba ngo mtshar rmad/ /

272gnyis pa rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ dper naskyed byed smra ba'i khyu mchog ma yin cing / /ngang/ dbang lha mo'i mngal las ma skyes kyang / /darje'i rnam dpyod me tog rab bzhad nas/ /kun dga' sbrang rtsi'i blu dbyangs mgrin par 'khriṭa/ /yang na tshad ma'i skyes bu gnya' ral can gyi rigs/ /ma yin pu lo ma dgra'i rigs su yang / / 'khrungs pa min mod 'on kyang gzi brjod kyis/ /phas rgol rnam par gnon la rab skyodad/ /yang na skyabs rje mkhan po 'phaṭa yul phyoṭa glang dang / /chogagraṭa rigs las byung ba ma yin kyang / /dgag sgrub tshad ma'i lam srol ches mkhas pas /mkhas rlom zel gyis mi gnon rang dbang ci/ /

273 lugang na sa yi tshangs pa lha yi ljon shing dang / /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i riṭa las ma brgyud kyang / /rtag skyogazhan phan bya bar thuṭa spro ste/ /ris med kun la 'dod pa'i phun tshogs ster/ /gsum pa bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/dper na mdzes pa'i spyan zur 'khyog pos ma skul la/ /rin chen nor bu'i rgyan gyis ma ngom zhing / /gsung dbyangs drug cu'i dbyar rnga ma sgroṭa par/ /bdag yid dbang med 'phrog pa'i lha mor 'dud/ / yang na bri klog rig pa'i gnas la ma slob cing / /yi dam bsgrubs pa'i ngal ba ma byas kyang / /snang srid 'khor 'das 'dus pa'i chos mtha' dag /

274 lhag med cig car gziṭa pa'i blo gros rgyas/ /yang na shes rig rnam par bkra ba'i skye bo rnams/ /'gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzes sdug sna tshoṭa dang / /gya gyu'i dbyangs kyis snyan par ma bos kyang / /pad+ma'i bcud la 'khor 'gro bzhin du 'dus/ /kusdong na ngan sngags mthu yis gzhan la 'tshe ba dang / /phas rgol gnon pa'i thabs tshul du ma yis/ /g.yul gshom med kyang slob dpon dpa' bo la/ /deng dus mkhas pa yod dgu snying rtsa 'dar/ /bzhi pa rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/dper na bkod leṭa lta na sdug pa'i khang bzang dang / /mi zad 'dod dgu'i dpal gyi nor dben yang / /

275sprang 'khya'adi ras rkyang 'dzin pa'i tshul kho nas/ / srid 'dir snyan graṭa mtho gathos pa dga'/ /yang na rab dkar gdong bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang bral zhing / /'dren byed dbang po stong dang mi ldan kyang / /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i tshul tsam gyis/ / chos kun mnyam par gziṭa pa'i tshul 'di ci/ /yang na g.yul ngor 'jug pa'i dpung tshoṭa dmag med cing / /go mtshon 'phrul 'khor sna tshoṭa ma mchis kyang / /dzi mi snyam du bzod pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ /bdud bzhi bcom mkhas zas gtsang sras por 'dud/ /lugang na mdzes pa'i mu tig rdo shal phreng ba dang / /dar zab gos dang dpal gyi dum bu soṭa/ /

276dri bzang 'chang ba med kyang skye bo rnams/ / lta bas chog mi shes pa ci zhig lags/ /lnga pa rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad pā brjod pa ni/ dper na lang tsho'i dpal dang lus kyi stobs nyams shing / /gnas mal longs spyod shis phongs na yang / /mkhas grub tshi po'i rtser son mi la rjes/ /phyoṭa bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog /lugang na lo drug dka' thub ngal bas keng rus su/ /gyur zhing 'deṭa 'jog lta ci zas kyang dben/ /'on kyang slu med shākya'i khyu mchog gis/ / bdud bzhi'i dpung tshoṭa ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /yang na sgyu rtsal stobs shugs la soṭa ches phra zhing / /bcos ma'i rgyud ldan 'chang zhing rten dman yang / /

277ma bcos ngang gis byung ba'i zhal dkyil 'dis/ /srid gsum dpal gyi phung po 'phrog par byed/ /ya nga na cha shas rim par 'dzad pa'i rang bzhin can/ /nag nog ri bong gzugs kyis 'gribs gyur pa/ /de lta na yang bdud rtsi 'dzag pa can/ /zla bas 'gro kun yid dga' 'phel bar byed/ /nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ni/ dngos po gang zhig gi don brjod par 'dod pa'i dbang gis de dang cha 'dra ba'i yon tan te chos bzang ngan brjod don khyad par che yang mtshungs pa ltar byas te bstod pa'am smad pa'i don du bsgrags pa ste/ dbye ba gnyis las dang po bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/dper na 'phags yul a sho ka dang bsil ldan gyi/ /

278srong btsan rje dang 'chi med rgya la po dang / /deng dus gnam bskos mi yi dbang phyug kyang / /zla med snyan pa'i graṭa pa phyoṭa kun brdal/ /lugang na rtag sdod 'od dkar can dang dpyod kya'i dpal/ /rnam grol zla mdzes ma dang dri za'i glu/ /kun gyi yid la dga' ba'i bdud rtsi zhes/ /skye rgus mgrin lam gcig nas dbyangs su sgroṭa/ / yang na dag pa'i zhing du sa bcu'i dbang phyug dang / /dh+wa na ko sha'i pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog /da lta de yi bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi mngon par mtho/ /yang na snga 'gyur klong chen sa skya parji ta/ /

279 bka' brgyud mkhas grub rtse mo mar mi dwags/ /zhwa ser bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tsong kha pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las rnam thar mdzes/ /gnyis pa smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/ dper na rol pa'i gnas la 'char ba'i 'od dkar can/ /skye dgu'i tshe srog lang tsho mdzes pa'i dpal/ /dpyod ku'i me tog char ldan dus kyi chu/ /skad cig rnal du mi gnas 'phel 'grib mang / /yang na bslab ba/sum tshul khrims bral ba'i sdom brtson dang / nyams rtoṭa yon tan thongs pa'i grub brdzus can/ / log par 'khrid pa'i mkhas rlom bshes gnyen bcas/ /gnas skabs gong du bkur kyang mtha' mar phung / /yang na 'phyon ma'i yid dang gya gyu nam mkha'i glog /

2 80lha rgyal mtshon cha rlung gseb mar me rnams/ /re zhig mdzes chos gcig 〉snang na yang / /skad cig mi gnas g.yo phyir yid rton ci/ /lugang na las 'bras log par lta ba'i slob ma dang / /blo gtad med pa'i gsar 'groṭa mdza' na mo/ /mdzes pa'i ri mo bkra ba dbang po'i gzhu/ /mtshungs kyang don la snying po ci zhig mchis/ /nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan ni/ brjod don gang la bya ba la sogs pa 'gal ba du ma 'grogs kyang skyon med par khyad par brjod pa ste/ dbye ba drug las dang po gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba ni/ dper na shākya'i khyu mchog mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og /nyan thos dgra bcom sdug bsngal gyis gzir nas/ /

291gdung shuṭa drag pos bos la bdud sde rnams/ /langs te rab skyodaga' ba'i blu dbyangs len/ / yang na 'jam dbyangs lha ru zhen pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros ci yang 'phel/ /dbang phyug byed por 'dzin pa'i mu steṭa dag /gnas luṭa bsta ba'i rnam dpyod rim bzhin nyams/ /lugang na bsil ldan dus su chu log 'jiṭa pa yi/ /dreṭa bral gser mig can rnams spro nyams rgyas/ /gtsug phud can rnams chu 'dzin dbyar rnga soṭa/ /bral bas mya ngan ma gtoṭa 'dod nyams ci/ /yang na rang rgyud bdud kyis brlams pa'i skye bo rnams/ /mtshams med lnga yi las la rabaduspro/ /

282man ngag gnad du dril ba'i bshes gnyen kun/ /mi dge'i chos la zhen pa'i snang ba 'gog /gnyis pa gzhi gcig yon tan 'gal ba ni/dper na yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal sgo las gsungs pa'i/ /zab rgyas chos 'khor rnam pa gsum gyi sgras/ /skal ldan 'khor bzang rnam dkar dge ba'i tshoṭa/ /gsar du bskrun cing bdud dpung snying rtsa gas / /lugeng na dri zhim lho yi rlung gzhon gsar pa yis/ /char dus drod kyis gdungs pa'i skye bo rnams/ /lus la reg pas bsil zhing khyo bral dag /yid la mi bzod tsha ba skyed par byed/ /yang na dgung sngon lha yi lam la glo bur du/ /

283ldir ba'i dbyar rngas lus can skrag gyur tshe/ /rtag 〉'dod la brka mas pa'i mgrin sngon rnams/ /dga' bas zlos gar bsgyur cing ca co sgroṭa/ /kunang na 'khrig dus mkha' la shar ba'i kun phan gyi/ /'od kyis lang tsho gzhon nu pho mo rnams/ /chaṭa pa'i khra sbubs grol zhing 'dab stong ni/ /skad cig dbang med rab 〉zum par byed/ /gsum pa rdzas 'gal ba ni/ dper na lang tsho shin 〉phra zhing gsung dbyangs mtho/ /rnam dpyod rab rno brtse ba'i thuṭa rgyud 'jam/ /nyon zad rnam dkar 'phel ba'i leṭa bshad kyis/ /skal ldan yid la dga' ba cis mi byed/ /yang na 'dzum zhal rab dudakar zhing mgor nyal nag /

284mchu sgros dmar kyang 'dod pa'i khron pa spo /'khyog med gzuṭa nyid drang yang g.yo sems can/ /lus phras bslu ma thub pa'i skyes pa su/ /yang na mkhyen pa'i ye shes phyug kyang rgyaṭa pa dben/ /rgyal kun yab tugyur kyang gzhon nu'i tshul/ /sku la mtshan dpes mdzes kyang ngom pa'i sems/ /bral ba'i shes rab 'khor lor mi 'dud ci/ /lugang na nyon mongs rab 〉zad kyang shes rab rgyas/ /srid lam dor zhing dam pa'i chos lam blangs/ /ye nas rang don chung zhing bstan 'gro shi/ /don chen sgrub pa'i bla mas su mi skyabs/ /bzhi pa rdzas dang las 'gal ba ni/ dper na 'dab brgya'i bzhin la 'khor 'gro'i 'dren byed zung / /

285byi ru'i mkhur tshos dbang gzhu'i sprin ma bkra/ /sa 'dzin gzugs la tsan+dan dri 'thul ba/ /mdzes mas brtul phod rnams kyi yid gdung byed/ /yang na nam mkha'i thugs la dri med zla ba'i blo/ /sprin gyi gtsug phud nyi ma'i gzi brjid can/ /rgan po'i thig gi bla gos mdzes klubs pa/ /'jig rten mgon pos bdud kyi snang ba 'gog /yang na gangs ri'i sku dang gnyis skyes dbang po'i zhal/ /puṇ+ḍa ri kā'i tshems phreng chu skyes mig /skar tshoṭa rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan dpe can/ /tshangs pa'i sras mos nyon mongs ci phyir bsres/ /yang na lhun po'i gzuṭa sku rlabs phreng can gyi thugs/ /

296sprin gyi myu gu'i leṭa bshad dbyar rnga'i gsung / /thun mtshams na bza' 'chang ba'i dge sbyong gis/ /bdud bzhi'i snying la zug rngu ster min nam/ /lnga pa gzhi gcig gi bya ba 'gal gni/ dper na rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu mchog /'phaṭa yul mkhas pa'i rtse mo klu sgrub kyi/ /mkhyen rab snang byed 'od kyis ma reg kyang / / mkhas rlom mtha' dag zil gyis gnon par byas/ /lugang na dbyangs can khyod kyi yal ga lnga pa'i rtser/ /'chang ba'i rgyud mang dbyangs su sgroṭa pa'i sgra/ /kun dkris rna ba'i lam du ma bgrod kyang / /skad cig mi bzod zug krus mnar bar gyur/ /kunang na rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i rtser son pa/ /

287 zur phud lnga pa'i ral gri nam mkha'i thog /phas rgol rnams kyi mgo la ma 'bebs kyang / /nyon mongs dgra bgeṭa thams cad thal bar brlas/ /lugang na leṭa pa'i yostan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i spangs rtoṭa phun tshoṭa kyi/ /mtshon chas log 'dren tshoṭa la ma bsnun kyang / /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshoṭa ming gi lhag mar byas/ /drug pa sbyar ba'i 'gal ba ni/ dper na dga' ldan lha yi lam nas rab bskyod cing / /skye 'gro kun la phan bde ster ba'i gzhi/ / sus kyang rdzi med gzi brjod ldan pa yang / /'dzam gling 'di nas gsheṭa pa'i tshul la gziṭa/ /kunang na ngoṭa can las 'khrungs dkyil 'khor rab bkra ba/ /

288bdud rtsi'i dga' ston stsol ba'i phrin las can/ /gling phran gzhan la'ang brten pa'i sngon byung gtam / /'jig rten 'di na graṭa pa'i ngo mtshar mtho/ /lugang na snyan graṭa shin dumatho ba sna tshogs gzugs/ /phas rgol rnam par gnon la mthu che yang / /ya mu nā yi spun zla'i gzhan dbang can/ /de la yid rton byed pa'i lus can su/ /yang na rab skyodakar ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med/ /ris med 'gro ba kun la bdud rtsi ster/ /rnam par bkra ba'i 'od stong 'phro ba yis/ /mi mthun smag gi spobs pa zum par byed/ /nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan ni/bstod yul der bstod pa'i skabs bab min

289yang rang gi gnas skabs kyi 'dod pa dang bstun nas bsngags pa ste/ dper na 'char nub ngo bsrung khral min rang dbang can/ /gzhan phan bya ba 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /res mos rgyu skar lam la shar ba yi/ /nyi zla zung gi ngang tshul yid du 'ong / / yang na mchog dman kun la dren gzo mi dgos shing / /'o ma'i chu gter zab mo nyams dga' bar/ /rtag skyoganas pa gnyis skyes ngang pa'i tshoṭa/ /rtse dgar rol pa'i tshul 'di snying la sdug /yang na gnas mal longs spyod gzhan la mi re bar/ /stsol med dpyid dpal gzhon nu'i bcud kyis 'tsho/ /bar snang khams su dga' ba'i blu dbyangs kyis/ /

290brel ba'i sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs cis mi dga'/ /lugang na chung ngu'i dus nas mkhar 'gro goms pa yis/ /ngal med sto gos la sogs mi dgos par/ /yud kyis 'dod pa'i gnas su bgrod byed pa'i/ /e ma 'dab ma'i shing rta skal ba bzang / /nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan ni/ yul gang la brjod tshig gi rnam pa smad pa bzhin byas te don la bstod par byas nas brjod tshul skyon ltar snang yang ngo bo la yon tan thob pa zhig ste/ 'di la dbye ba gsum las dang po mthu phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/dper na lha mos rgyud mang dbyangs su byas pa yis/ /'gro ba kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog byed na/ /'phaṭa yul mkhas pa'i dbang po darje yis/ /

291snyan tshig blu dbyangs spel la mtshar du ci/ /yang na sa bcu'i dbang phyug dag pa'i zhing mchog zhu /gsheṭa kyang ris med kun la thuṭa rjes gziṭa/ /sa yi tshangs pa khyod kyis 'bangs rnams la/ /rtag 〉byams brtses skyong la rgyaṭa mi 'tshal/ /yang na leṭa bshad kun gyi 'byung gnas thub dbang gis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshoṭa lhag med bcom mdzad na/ /bden gnyis cig car gziṭa pa'i 'phaṭa pa lhas/ /mu steṭa rta dbyangs btul la ya mtshan ci/ /yang na mtsho skyes rgyal pos dam nyams sde brgyad rnams/ /'deṭa 'jog g.yo 'gul tsam med 'gog nus na/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rig sngags kyis/ /

292nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'gog la snyems ma mdzad / /gnyis pa dpa' ba phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/dper na lung rigs shis phyug pa'i 'phags pa lhas/ /mu steṭa rgol ba rta dbyangs tshar bcad nas/ /mi 'dod bzhin du nang pa'i grub mtha' la/ /tshig btsan dbang gis bcug pa ji ltar riṭa/ / yang na dus gsum mkhyen pa shākya'i khyu mchog gis/ /'dod pa'i mda' dang bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas/ /ming gi lhag ma tsam du bcom mdzad pa/ /snying brtse'i thuṭa kyis de ltar 'os sam ci/ /lugang na mkhar nyal 'dod pa 'jo ba'i sa brtol gyi/ /phun tshoṭa dpal rnams dbang med cig car du/ /

293 'phrog cing bdag gir bzung ba'i dbyangs can ma/ /khyod kyis mdzad tshul 'di ltar rigs sam kye/ /lugang na mang thos grub mtha' smra ba brgya phrag gi /rnam dpyod gcig 〉spungs pa'i ke la sha/ / 'phaṭa yul mkhas grub rtse mo klu skrub kyi/ /shes pa gcig gis bshiṭa des khyod la ci/ /gsum pa sbyar ba'i zol bstod ni/ dper na thos ldan khyod kyis 'dzum zhal dngos mthong ba'i/ /mtsho byung kun gyi thun mong nyid gyur nas/ /ci slad khyod kyi yin ces smra ba ni/ /bdag gir 'dzin pa'i khengs pa byed riṭa sam/ /yang na sa yi tshangs pa khyod kyi btsun mo yi/ /mdzes chos pad+ma'i bcud la spyod pa yis/ /

294mthong thos dran reg skye bo yid 'phrog snyam/ /rgyags pa'i rtse mor 'dzeṭa pa 'os ma yin/ /yang na kun gyi spyi thun rol gnas bcud 'dzin 'di / /sa skyong khyod kyis bdag spyadabang byas pa/ /ngom par mi rigs rdul phran gcig gi steng / /zhing khams grangs med 'dzin pa'i rgyal sras yod/ /yang na dgag sgrub g.yul ngor gzhug ched nyin mtshan du/ /sna tshoṭa gzuṭa la bsten pa'i dka' spyad brel/ /ngal ba du mas bsgrubs pa'i rta dbyangs kyi/ /rnam dpyod de la ngo mtshar 'dzin nam ci/ /sum cu pa nges bstan gyi rgyan ni/ gal te bstan bya las gzhan pa'i don gyi 'jug pa 'jig rten la graṭa pa gcig 'dod bya'i phan gnod kyi 'jug

295pa gang rung gi mtshon don du bstan pa ste/ dbye ba gnyis las dang po mchog gi nges bstan ni/ dper na kun la blo yi dpal ster zla mdzes ma'i /yal ga lnga pas legs par 'dzin pa yi/ /rgyud mangs rna ba'i lam du snyan sgroṭa des/ /mkhas pas gzhan la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i brda/ /lugatunge skyo na ston dus lha yi lam gyi phyoṭa mtha' kun/ /chu 'dzin dri ma bral zhing rnam dag pas/ /sa lam yon tan ma lus yongs rdzoṭa pa'i / /rgyud la nyon mongs zad pa'i skabs ston laṭa/ /yang na rgyu skar lam du sprin dbyangs sgrogs pa yis /mgrin sngon dga' bas ca co 'phel ba las/ /zas gtsang sras pos chos 'khor rnam pa gsum/ /

296bskor bas theg gsum gdul bya brel bar snang / /lugang na mkhar nyal rnams kyis rnga yab can gyi dpal/ /nyin mtshan g.yel med spyod la zad med 'dis/ /blo ldan rnams kyis mkhas pa'i leṭa bshad bcud/ /dzi tsam blangs kyang 'bri med nges par mtshon/ /gnyis pa mchog min gyi nges bstan ni/ dper na char dus rol pa'i gnas la rab shar ba/ /rgan po'i thig gi ri mo rnam par bkra/ /skad cig brtan med yal ba'i rnam pa yis/ /snyiṭa dus skye bo'i dam bca' nges par mtshon/ /lugang na yid 'ong dre zhim 'dab brgya gzhon nu yis/ /rtag 〉'khor 'gro'i tshoṭa dang rab 'brel bas/ /stobs dman ma rnams lnga skyes yod do cog /

297kun gyi dga' mgur spyod yul yin par shes/ /yang na 'jig rten mig gis shar ri las bltas pas/ /steng 'thung dkar po'i yan lag zum par gyur/ /me tog mda' lngas reg pa'i skye bo ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bzang bsnub pa'i dgra ru nges/ /lugang na 'od kyi shing rta'i zegs ma chung ngu yis/ /mirgyal lta bu'i rtsa phung bsres byas pas/ /leṭa byas bsod nams grangs med bsaṭa na yang / /zhe sdang khro sems phran bus gzhom par mtshon/ / so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ brjod don de'i yon tan dang las soṭa lhan cig ste mnyam du yod pa'am 'byung bar brjod pa ste/ dbye ba gsum las dang po yon tan lhan cig brjod pa ni/

298 dper na dkar phyoṭa mig gsum pa yi gtsug nor dang / /lhan cig zur phud lnga pa'i blo gros rgyas/ /ma la ya yi rlung gzhon gsar pa dang / /mnyam du gang gi tshul khrims rab skyobasil/ /kusdong na rlabs phreng can 'di kun mkhyen khyod thuṭa dang / /tshad gzhal mi mnga' lhan cig zab pa ste/ /dri med sna tshogs shing rta dang lhan cig /gnas luṭa rtoṭa pa'i ye shes mngon par gsal/ /lugang na cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i ston zla dang / /lhan cig shes rab lha mo'i bzhin ras dkar/ /dri zas rgyud mangs dbyangs su sgroṭa pa'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung dang lhan cig snyan/ /

299yang na 'khor bzang lnga sde'i mos dang thub dbang gi /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thuṭa rje lhan cig che/ /gdung shuṭa gsol ga'adebs pa'i nga ro dang / /lhan cig chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsung skad 'jibs/ /gnyis pa bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/ dper na rgyu skar lam nas dbyar rnga sgrogs pa dang / /lhan du gtsug phud can rnams glu dbyangs len/ /de dag dga' bas rol dang stabs cig zhu /nam mkha'i glang po de yang kun 〉rgyu/ /yang na kye ma bzhin bzang ma yi bcud 'dzin dang / /lhan cig bdag gi chags pa rab 〉rgyas/ /dbang gzhu'i ri mo 'dra ba'i smin ma dang / /mnyam du bdag gi 'dod pa'i 'khri shing g.yo/ /

300yang na bshes gnyen dam rma sa leṭa bshad 'doms pa dang / /slob ma'i rnam dpyod gsar pa lhan cig rgyas/ /dge sdig blang dor gnas la rmyongs pa yang / /log par rtog pa'i blo ngan mnyam du yal/ /yang na nyi mas 'dab brgya bzhad dang chabs cig zhu /lha mos skal ldan yid kyi sgo 'phar 'byed/ /rta ljang can gyis sa mos zum pa dang / /lhan du tshangs sras lha mos nyon mongs 'joms/ /gsum pa bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/ dper na zas gtsang sras po'i spangs rtoṭa yon tan dang / /rol pa'i gnas la 'char ba'i gnyis skyes dbang / /'gro ba lha mi'i rnam dkar dge ba'i cha/ /yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin mor lhan cig rdzoṭa/ /

301yang na sngon med rig lam spel ba'i mdzad bzang dang / /thos bsam sgom par brtson pa'i skal ldan blo/ /mkhas pas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i leṭa byas te/ /gsum po sngon dus lhan cig 'phel bar gyur/ /yang na sna tshogs dbyig gi rin chen gling bu dang / /dpyod kyi pho nya rab dumyos pa'i glu/ /lha mo'i phyag sor 'chang ba'i rgyud mangs te/ /gsum pos bdag gi rna bar dga' ston sbyin/ /yang na rkang 'thung gzhon nu'i dpal dang 'khor 'gro'i dbyangs/ /mtha' yas gaṅgā 'dzin dang ka dam pa/ / zlos gar mkhan gyi 'dod pa'i bya ba rnams/ /char ldan dus su lhan cig rgyas par 'gyur/ /

302 so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ brjod don gyi yon tan dang bya ba sogs kyi don rnams phan tshun bsnol ba ste brjes pa lta bur brjod pa ste/dper na mkhas dang grub pa'i rtse mo mi la rjes/ /mdo sngaṭa yongs rdzoṭa thuṭa su chud pa'i bcud/ /rnam thar man ngag zagamo stsal ba yis/ /srid gsum skye dgu ma lus yid dbang 'phrog /yang na tshangs sras lha mos rgyud mang skyod pa'i dbyangs/ /skal ldan sgra 'dzin dbang por sbyin pa yis/ /de dag ba spu'i 'khri shing rab g.yo zhing / /dad pa'i yid kyi dbang po khyod la shor/ /lugang na sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas dus kun skyo /

303bstod pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol zhing mchod pa las/ n+tungag dbang lha mo dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /gziṭa te blang dor 'byed pa'i blo mig stsal/ / lugangur skyed shes rab 'khor lo khyod kyis 'gro rnams la/ /zab gsal myur ba'i blo gros leṭa stsal nas/ /log par rtog pa'i blo ngan yod do cog /ming gi lhag ma tsam/ rda 'i cig car 'phrog /so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan ni/ yid la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po don du gnyer bya de 'grub par smon pa ste/ dper na ye shes gcig 〉rdzoṭa pa'i 'jam mgon dang / /sgra dbyangs mgrin par phyug pa'i lha mo yi/ /mtshungs med zla zhal gsar pa dngos mthong nas/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'khrul med rtoṭa par shog /

304yang na ngag gi 'dod pa 'bad med 'byung ba'i gter/ /tshangs sras dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dkar ba yis/ /bdag blo'i ma rig mun pa kun bcom nas/ /srid 'dir bstan 'gro'i don chen bsgrub par smon/ /lugang na mnyam med shākya'i bstan pa rin chen la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas yongs rdzoṭa nas/ / 'gro kun gtsug gi rgyan bkod phan bde yi/ /dge leṭa 'od kyis 'dzam gling khyab gyur cig /yang na nges byung sems kyis 'khor ba'i bya ba rnams/ /spangs shing bslab gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom brtson khyod/ /rtag 〉rgyal ba rnams kyis rjes bzung nas/ /bstan 'gro'i don du rnam mkhyen thob par smon/ /

305 so bzhi pa rab spel gyi rgyan ni/ tha dad pa'i rgyan rnams zhes rgyan gsum la sogs pa phan tshun stobs mnyam du bsres pa sbyor ba gcig la gnas pa ste/ dbye ba gnyis las dang po phan tshun bltos pa can gyi rab spel ni/dper na rab dkar dri med dwangs pa'i snying sdug can/ /gang gi 'dren byed ut+pal sngon po bzhin/ /'gag med gsung gi sgra dbyangs sgroṭa pa la/ /sgra ngan spangs rnams 'gran par 'dod min nam/ /yang na gang gi thugs su ma chud shwe bya 'ga'/ /da dung lhag ma yodamed som nyir gyur/ /ston zla ji bzhin mkhas pa'i leṭa bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsi myong yang nyon mongs 'phel 'di ci/ /

306yang na glog ltar myur ba dbyangs can rnam dpyod kyi/ /bskal mes nyon mongs cig car sreg pa'i zlar/ /bcu gnyis bdag pos 'od zer rab 'phro ste/ /chur sgrog rnams la tsha gdung ster min nam/ /yang na bdud rtsi ji bzhin rgyal ba'i leṭa bshad kyi/ /rlung gzhon gsar pa srid zhi dbyings su brdal/ /zla bas 'dab stong 'dzum par byed pa la/ /rkang drug khro zhing gad rgyangs sgrogs pa 'dra/ /gnyis pa stobs mtshungs rab spel ni/ dper na gang gi mkhyen rab lha lam yangs pa las/ /tho na pa'i leṭa bshad zab mo dbyar rnga bzhin/ /mgrin pa'i ngos las skyes sam rgyud mang sgra/ /ma yin 'di la bya dka' ci zhig mchis/ /

307lugang na chu gter skyeng par byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /lung rtogs nor bu skye dgu'i dpal du ngom/ /rgyud mangs dbyangs su byas pa'i snyan tshig gi /sgra las don bzang khro bos rnyed de ci/ /kunang na gnyis skyes dbang por yong sa smod dbyangs can gyi/ /bzhin gyi dpyid dpal mthong bas kun gyi yid/ /tshad med dga' brgyas pa'i legs byas 'di/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bde bas mtshon nus min/ / yang na mkha' ltar yangs pa'i 'jam dpal mkhyen rab la/ / daṇ+ḍis 'gran zhing legs bshad ston mor 'gyed/ /ma bos snyan ngag rgya mtshor blo ldan rnams/ /rtag 〉rol kyang zad med 'byung 'di mtshar/ /

308so lnga pa dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi bsam bya'i dgongs pa bya rdzogs kyi skad cig la 'grub pa'i lus yongs rdzogs la yod pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ dper na dakhri'i mkhyen rab shin 〉zab pa las/ /byung ba'i glu dbyangs phyi nang thun mong du/ /spel ba'i leṭa bshad ma tshang med pa'i rgyan/ /skal mnyam rnams la phan phyir dper brjod byas/ /yang na gang gi dgongs bcud don rgyan so lnga po/ /snyan tshig phreng bas leṭa par dper bkod pa/ /'di ni mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi'i rnam dpyod rtsal/ /yongs su rdzoṭa pa'i ngo mtshar ngom phyir yin/ /yang na 'khrul med dakhri'i dgongs don ā da0/ /

309thun mong 'dod pa sel ched mdzad pa'i gzhung / /ji bzhin dper brjod blo gsar dga' ba'i glu/ /rig pa'i lam srol mi nyams rgyas phyir brtsams/ /yang na bzhed don rtoṭa pa'i dper brjod rnga yab can/ / brjod 'dod lhag bsam gaṅgā ltar rgyas te/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa'i bstod tshiṭa su/ /drang srong tshi ba'i tshal du glu dbyangs shor/ /swa sti/ thos ldan rnams kyi rol gnas daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung / /skyes chen rnams la bsngaṭa dang bstan bcos soṭa/ /rtsom la med thabs med pa'i don gyi rgyan/ /tha na mdza' brtse'i yi ge bri la'ang mkho/ /tshig sbyor phun sum tshoṭa pa'i snyan nyams kyi/ /

310'dab brgyas shes ldan bung ba yid 'phrog pa'i/ /bcud bzang dpyod ldan dpyod ku'i dpal las te/ /bdag 'dra'i glen pa ya ma brla las ci/ / 'on kyang mtshungs med mkhas pa'i zhal sgo nas/ /tshig don 'khrul med thos pa'i bka' drin las/ /cha tsam rtogs pa bsas pas ma bzod par/ /sgos bzhin yi ge'i lam nas dper brjod bkod/ /daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs don rlabs phreng can gyi mtha'/ /bdag blo mgrin pa'i rdza rngas dpag dka' bas/ /log rtog sin dhu skyes sogs rnyog mchis na/ / dpyod ldan ke ta ka yis dwangs par mdzod/ /de ltar lhag blos don rgyan chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /

311blangs pa'i glu dbyangs dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba'i sgra/ /blo gsar rma byas cha tsam thos pa'i skal ba yis/ /rnam mkhyen dbyar gyi dpal mo'i mdzes pa ngom par smon/ /ces slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long ma de nyid/ gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang po 'gos pad+ma rgyal mtshan mchog gis 'dzin grwar lcags 'khrid gnang skabs/ snyoms las pa slob phrug khyon bstan 'dzin rang nyid kyis mi shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed de/ wā ṇa bod kyi ches mtho'i gtsug lag khang du/ gnam lo me pho stag spyi lo 1985lor brtsams pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lam/ /
